title: 《冰雪奇缘2》电影小说
blurb: F2 官方电影小说化：走向未知，寻找魔法的源头与真相。

paras.en: Far away, as far north as any man, woman, or child had ever been, once stood the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 在很远很远的地方，远到任何人——男人、女人或是孩子——所能抵达的最北端，曾经矗立着魔法森林。

paras.en: This beautiful forest was protected by the spirits of air, fire, water, and earth.
paras.zh: 这片美丽的森林由风、火、水、土四大精灵守护着。

paras.en: Among all this beauty dwelled a mysterious people called the Northuldra.
paras.zh: 在这片美景之中，生活着一个神秘的民族，名叫北乌兰德拉。

paras.en: They were nomads who lived off the land and followed their reindeer herds wherever they roamed.
paras.zh: 他们是逐水草而居的游牧民族，跟着驯鹿群去往任何它们游荡的地方。

paras.en: Because the Northuldra were in harmony with nature, it was thought that they were magical.
paras.zh: 因为北乌兰德拉人与大自然和谐共处，人们便以为他们拥有魔力。

paras.en: One day, ships arrived at the entrance to the fjord south of the Enchanted Forest—wooden ships full of people who were determined to create a home for themselves near the water.
paras.zh: 有一天，船只驶入了魔法森林以南的峡湾入口——一艘艘木船满载着决心在水边安家落户的人。

paras.en: Soon the kingdom of Arendelle came to be, and a magnificent castle was built for the royal family.
paras.zh: 不久，阿伦黛尔王国就此诞生，一座宏伟的城堡也建了起来，供王室居住。

paras.en: The newcomers were welcomed by the Northuldra’s ruler when he met with their king on a cliff as the sun set.
paras.zh: 日落时分，北乌兰德拉的首领在他们的国王会晤时，于悬崖之上迎接了这些新来的人。

paras.en: The leaders firmly shook hands, and the meeting was seen by others only in hazy silhouette as they cast great shadows across the land.
paras.zh: 两位首领紧紧握手，远远旁观的人只看见朦胧的剪影，他们把巨大的影子投落在土地上。

paras.en: To demonstrate their goodwill and friendship, the Arendellians built a mighty dam in the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 为了表达善意与友谊，阿伦黛尔人在魔法森林里修筑了一座雄伟的大坝。

paras.en: They placed it on the river that flowed into the Arenfjord, the deep blue body of water upon which Arendelle Castle had been built.
paras.zh: 他们把大坝建在汇入阿伦峡湾的河流上，那片深蓝色的辽阔水域，正是阿伦黛尔城堡坐落之处。

paras.en: The dam connected all the lands and made it easier for the Northuldra and their reindeer to roam.
paras.zh: 大坝连通了所有的土地，也让北乌兰德拉人和他们的驯鹿更容易四处游走。

paras.en: King Runeard, the leader of Arendelle, offered it to the Northuldra as a symbol of peace and cooperation between the two groups.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的统治者鲁纳德国王，将大坝赠予北乌兰德拉人，作为两个族群之间和平与合作的象征。

paras.en: When the dam was complete, the Arendellians threw a great celebration.
paras.zh: 大坝竣工之时，阿伦黛尔人举办了一场盛大的庆典。

paras.en: Northuldra from all over the land gathered at the base of the dam to mingle and feast with the Arendellians.
paras.zh: 来自四面八方的北乌兰德拉人聚集在大坝脚下，与阿伦黛尔人欢聚宴饮。

paras.en: For Prince Agnarr, the young son of King Runeard, it was the farthest from home he had ever been.
paras.zh: 对鲁纳德国王年幼的儿子阿格纳尔王子来说，这是他离家最远的一次。

paras.en: His eyes danced with wonder and excitement…until his father noticed.
paras.zh: 他的眼睛里跳动着惊奇与兴奋……直到父亲注意到他。

paras.en: King Runeard flicked Agnarr under the chin and gave him a look that the prince knew better than to challenge.
paras.zh: 鲁纳德国王轻轻弹了一下阿格纳尔的下巴，投去一个眼神——王子十分清楚，这个眼神绝不能违抗。

paras.en: He directed his son to stand straight and proud—to be regal. “Remember, Agnarr—you represent Arendelle.” Agnarr obeyed, as the king knew he would. “And mind Lieutenant Mattias,” his father advised, motioning to a young man in uniform.
paras.zh: 他示意儿子站得笔直而骄傲——要有王室的威仪。“记住，阿格纳尔——你代表着阿伦黛尔。”阿格纳尔顺从地照做了，正如国王所料。“还有，听马蒂亚斯中尉的话，”父亲指了指一个穿制服的年轻人，叮嘱道。

paras.en: Mattias stood at attention as the king walked away with his guards.
paras.zh: 当国王带着卫兵离开时，马蒂亚斯立正站好。

paras.en: The lieutenant knew the disappointment in Agnarr’s eyes.
paras.zh: 中尉看出了阿格纳尔眼中的失落。

paras.en: It wasn’t just that King Runeard had wanted him to act royally, like a diplomat instead of a boy.
paras.zh: 并不只是因为鲁纳德国王希望他像一个外交官而非孩子那样，表现得有王室风范。

paras.en: It was also that he had left Agnarr behind—away from the talk with the elders and the Northuldra leader.
paras.zh: 还因为父亲把他抛在了一边——远离了与长老和北乌兰德拉首领的交谈。

paras.en: But Mattias knew exactly what to do.
paras.zh: 但马蒂亚斯心里清楚该怎么做。

paras.en: He stepped up beside Agnarr and mused, “You’re getting taller.
paras.zh: 他走到阿格纳尔身边，若有所思地说：“你长高了。”

paras.en: Stop that.” He nudged the young prince with his elbow.
paras.zh: “别这样。”他用胳膊肘轻轻碰了碰小王子。

paras.en: Agnarr smiled and gave him a jab back. “Eh, I’m just kidding.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔笑了，也回戳了他一下。“哎，我开玩笑的。

paras.en: Come on.
paras.zh: “来吧。”

paras.en: Let’s go.” The two interlocked arms, jockeying for position in a friendly wrestling match on their way down to the festivities.
paras.zh: “走吧。”两人挽起胳膊，一边往庆典现场走，一边友好地互相较劲、摔起了跤。

paras.en: At the heart of the celebration, the Northuldra and the Arendellians intermingled, eating and drinking, talking and laughing as if they were the very best of friends.
paras.zh: 在庆典的中心，北乌兰德拉人和阿伦黛尔人融为一体，吃着喝着，有说有笑，仿佛是最好的朋友。

paras.en: The Northuldra even put on a show, demonstrating tricks on the backs of their reindeer.
paras.zh: 北乌兰德拉人还献上了一场表演，在驯鹿背上展示各种绝活。

paras.en: But something deeper in the forest caught Agnarr’s eye.
paras.zh: 但森林更深处有什么东西，吸引了阿格纳尔的目光。

paras.en: It was so amazing, it couldn’t possibly have been real.
paras.zh: 那景象如此神奇，简直不可能是真的。

paras.en: He thought he saw the silhouette of a girl about his age, spinning up and down in the air as she twirled with the leaves in the wind.
paras.zh: 他觉得自己看见了一个和他年纪相仿的女孩的剪影，随着风中的落叶旋转，在空中忽上忽下地飞舞。

paras.en: She wasn’t dangling from trees or clinging to vines, but somehow she floated as if she weighed nothing.
paras.zh: 她没有吊在树上，也没有抓着藤蔓，却不知怎的飘浮着，仿佛轻若无物。

paras.en: Mesmerized, Agnarr moved toward her.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔看入了迷，朝她走了过去。

paras.en: It was only after he heard the clashing of swords, shields, and staffs that the trance he seemed to have been in was broken.
paras.zh: 直到听见刀剑、盾牌和长棍碰撞的声响，他仿佛着了魔般的状态才被打破。

paras.en: He turned and saw that his people were being attacked!
paras.zh: 他转过身，看见自己的族人正在遭受攻击！

paras.en: The charm and magic of the Northuldra had only been a trick.
paras.zh: 北乌兰德拉人的魅力与魔法，不过是一场骗局。

paras.en: Agnarr gave the girl one last look, not wanting to believe that the fighting was real.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔最后看了那女孩一眼，不愿相信这场打斗是真的。

paras.en: But she was gone—as if she had never been there at all.
paras.zh: 可她已经不见了——仿佛从未出现过一样。

paras.en: The whoosh of an arrow passing Agnarr’s head froze him in his spot.
paras.zh: 一支箭呼啸着从阿格纳尔头顶掠过，把他钉在原地动弹不得。

paras.en: He had never been that close to danger before. “Get behind me,” Mattias said, and pulled Agnarr out of the way just before another arrow zipped by, right where his head had been.
paras.zh: 他从未如此接近过危险。“躲到我身后，”马蒂亚斯说着，在又一支箭擦着阿格纳尔刚才所在的位置嗖地飞过之前，把他拉到了一旁。

paras.en: Agnarr was dazed and could only watch as the brutal battle raged before them, arrows flying and shields defending.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔惊呆了，只能眼睁睁看着残酷的战斗在眼前爆发，箭矢横飞，盾牌抵挡。

paras.en: He froze when he saw his father, sword in hand, facing the Northuldra leader.
paras.zh: 当他看见父亲手持宝剑，正面对北乌兰德拉首领时，他僵住了。

paras.en: Mattias held tight to Agnarr as the prince yelled for his father.
paras.zh: 王子高声呼唤父亲，马蒂亚斯紧紧拉住阿格纳尔。

paras.en: All he wanted to do was help him.
paras.zh: 他只想冲上去帮父亲一把。

paras.en: The prince was able to free himself—but only after the king and the Northuldra leader had plunged over the edge of a cliff. “Father!” Agnarr roared like a soldier of old and rushed through the battle to get to the cliff’s edge and search for his father.
paras.zh: 王子挣脱了束缚——但那是在国王与北乌兰德拉首领一同坠下悬崖之后。“父王！”阿格纳尔像古时的战士一样大吼一声，穿过战场冲到悬崖边，寻找父亲。

paras.en: But fire erupted before him, and the flames and heat pushed him back.
paras.zh: 但火焰在他面前骤然腾起，烈焰与热浪把他逼了回去。

paras.en: A massive blast shot across the forest like a shock wave.
paras.zh: 一股猛烈的冲击波横扫过整片森林。

paras.en: The Northuldra and Arendellian soldiers ran for their lives as water crashed into the dam with a sound like thunder.
paras.zh: 当洪水如雷鸣般撞向大坝时，北乌兰德拉和阿伦黛尔的士兵们四散逃命。

paras.en: The wind began to rage violently while boulders fell from the sky like bombs.
paras.zh: 狂风开始猛烈呼啸，而巨石像炸弹一样从天而降。

paras.en: One landed at Agnarr’s feet, and the force of the impact tossed him through the air.
paras.zh: 一块巨石落在阿格纳尔脚边，撞击的冲击力将他掀飞到了半空。

paras.en: When he hit the ground, his head slammed against a rock.
paras.zh: 当他摔落在地时，头狠狠撞上了一块石头。

paras.en: As he began to lose consciousness and his vision faded, he noted sadly that the lush beauty of the forest had been destroyed.
paras.zh: 当他渐渐失去知觉、视线模糊时，他悲伤地意识到，森林那葱郁的美景已被摧毁。

paras.en: At the same time, he heard a haunting voice, like someone overcome with the grief of centuries, wailing an eerie melody.
paras.zh: 与此同时，他听见一个萦绕心头的声音，仿佛某个被数百年的悲伤压垮的人，正哀嚎着一段诡异的旋律。

paras.en: Agnarr had never experienced anything like it before.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔以前从未经历过这样的事。

paras.en: The Northuldra had mentioned that the dam was inhabited by the spirits of the people who had built it.
paras.zh: 北乌兰德拉人曾提到，大坝里住着建造它的人们的精灵。

paras.en: Is that voice a spirit?
paras.zh: 那个声音是精灵吗？

paras.en: Is it angry?
paras.zh: 它生气了吗？

paras.en: Agnarr asked himself.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔问自己。

paras.en: Somehow, the prince was moved out of the forest by an unseen force that floated him through the air while the chaos continued beneath him.
paras.zh: 不知怎的，一种看不见的力量托着王子穿过空中，把他移出了森林，而他身下，混乱仍在继续。

paras.en: Then the deafening roar fell silent as the angry spirits stopped raging, and a mist, as thick and impenetrable as stone, enveloped the forest, locking some people in and others out….
paras.zh: 随后，当愤怒的精灵停止咆哮，那震耳欲聋的轰鸣归于沉寂；一团如磐石般浓重、无法穿透的迷雾笼罩了森林，将一些人困在其中，将另一些人拒之门外……

paras.en: “And that night, I came home King of Arendelle,” King Agnarr said.
paras.zh: “那一夜，我回到家中时，已是阿伦黛尔的国王了。”阿格纳尔国王说道。

paras.en: The king’s candle cast flickering shadows on his face as he told his story to his young daughters, Anna and Elsa.
paras.zh: 国王向年幼的女儿安娜和艾莎讲述往事时，烛光在他脸上投下摇曳的阴影。

paras.en: The girls were huddled together on Elsa’s bed with their mother, Queen Iduna, listening to every word their father said, their eyes wide and their mouths hanging open.
paras.zh: 两个女孩和母亲伊杜娜王后一起偎在艾莎的床上，听着父亲说的每一句话，眼睛瞪得大大的，嘴巴张得合不拢。

paras.en: Their mother drew them close to her, all three of them gathered under the comforting weight of her burgundy scarf. “Whoa, Papa, that was epic,” Anna said, collapsing on the bed as she pictured everything that had happened. “Whoever saved you, I love them.” The king smiled at his little girl. “I wish I knew who it was.” “Were the Northuldra really magical?” Elsa wondered aloud.
paras.zh: 母亲把她们搂到身边，三个人的身影都笼罩在她那条酒红色围巾温暖的包裹中。“哇，爸爸，太震撼了，”安娜一边在脑海里浮现出刚才那一幕幕，一边瘫倒在床上说道，“不管是谁救了你，我都爱他。”国王对着小女儿微微一笑。“我真希望自己知道是谁。”“北乌兰德拉人真的有魔力吗？”艾莎出声地喃喃自问。

paras.en: She didn’t want to be anything like them.
paras.zh: 她可一点都不想变得和他们一样。

paras.en: She couldn’t imagine hurting her friends. “Like me?” “No,” King Agnarr assured her. “They were not magical.
paras.zh: 她无法想象自己会伤害朋友。“像我一样吗？”“不，”阿格纳尔国王向她保证，“他们并没有魔力。

paras.en: They just enjoyed the magic of the forest.” “What happened to the spirits?
paras.zh: “他们只是享受森林的魔力。”“那些精灵怎么了？”

paras.en: What’s in the forest now?” Elsa wondered if anyone else had made it out after the spirits had gotten angry and turned on everyone. “I don’t know,” King Agnarr replied. “The mist still stands.
paras.zh: “森林里现在有什么？”艾莎心想，在精灵动怒、转而攻击所有人之后，是否还有别人逃了出来。“我不知道，”阿格纳尔国王答道，“迷雾依然笼罩着森林。”

paras.en: No one can get in, and no one has come out since.” Queen Iduna locked eyes with her husband, warning him to be careful with his words.
paras.zh: “没有人能进去，也从那以后没有人出来过。”伊杜娜王后与丈夫目光交汇，示意他说话小心些。

paras.en: She wanted to make sure their daughters didn’t feel scared. “So we’re safe,” she said. “Yes,” King Agnarr agreed. “But the forest could wake again, and we must be prepared for whatever danger it may bring.” Queen Iduna watch a flood of worry wash over Elsa’s face at her father’s words, and she intervened. “On that note, how about we say good night to your father,” she said.
paras.zh: 她想确保女儿们不会感到害怕。“所以我们是安全的，”她说。“是的，”阿格纳尔国王表示同意，“但森林可能会再次苏醒，我们必须为它可能带来的任何危险做好准备。”听了父亲的话，伊杜娜王后看见担忧如潮水般漫上艾莎的脸庞，便插话道：“既然如此，我们不如跟你父亲道声晚安吧，”她说。

paras.en: Both girls were much too young to think about fighting of any kind…especially when she was trying to get them to sleep.
paras.zh: 两个女孩都还太小，不该去想任何打打杀杀的事……尤其是当她正想哄她们入睡的时候。

paras.en: King Agnarr stood, and his face held an apology for his wife. “Aw, but I still have so many questions,” Anna said, pouting as her father kissed Elsa on the forehead. “Save them for another night, Anna,” he insisted. “Urgh,” she said in frustration. “You know I don’t have that kind of patience.” She looked pointedly at Elsa, who nodded, clearly agreeing with Anna about her lack of patience.
paras.zh: 阿格纳尔国王站起身，脸上带着对妻子的歉意。“唉，可我还有好多问题想问呢，”安娜撅着嘴，父亲正亲吻艾莎的额头，她说道。“留到别的晚上再问吧，安娜，”他坚持道。“哎，”她懊恼地说，“你知道我可没那种耐心。”她意味深长地看向艾莎，艾莎点了点头，显然很认同安娜所说的——自己确实没什么耐心。

paras.en: Anna closed her mouth tight and scrunched her face.
paras.zh: 安娜紧紧抿住嘴，皱起了一张小脸。

paras.en: Her father kissed her on the forehead, knowing that was her version of trying.
paras.zh: 父亲亲了亲她的额头，心里明白，这已是她尽力克制的样子了。

paras.en: Then he walked out of the room.
paras.zh: 然后他走出了房间。

paras.en: As soon as the door shut, Anna started in with her questions again. “Why did the Northuldra attack us, anyway?” she asked her mother. “Who attacks people who give them gifts?” “Do you think the forest will wake again?
paras.zh: 门刚一关上，安娜就又开始问个不停。“话说回来，北乌兰德拉人为什么要攻击我们？”她问母亲，“哪有人会攻击送自己礼物的人呢？”“你觉得森林会再次苏醒吗？”

paras.en: What would the spirits think of my magic?” Elsa asked, glancing up at her mother.
paras.zh: “那些精灵会怎么看我的魔法呢？”艾莎抬起头望着母亲，问道。

paras.en: A soft look came across Iduna’s face as her own memory from the past swept through her mind. “I wish I had the answers.
paras.zh: 过往的记忆在伊杜娜脑海中翻涌，她的神色变得温柔。“我真希望自己能回答这些问题。”

paras.en: Alas, only Ahtohallan knows.” “Ahto-who-what?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “可惜啊，只有阿托哈兰知道。”“阿托——什么来着？”安娜问道。

paras.en: Queen Iduna laughed as she smiled at the upturned face of her youngest daughter. “When I was little, my mother would sing a song about a special river called Ahtohallan, which was said to hold all the answers about the past,” she said. “About what we are a part of.” The sisters looked at each other, and then two pairs of big blue eyes stared up at the queen. “Will you sing it for us, please?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜王后笑着望着小女儿仰起的小脸。“我小的时候，母亲总会唱起一首歌，歌里有一条叫阿托哈兰的神奇河流，据说它知晓关于过去的一切答案，”她说，“关于我们身处其中的一切。”姐妹俩对视了一眼，然后两双蓝色的大眼睛一起望向王后。“您能唱给我们听吗，求您了？”艾莎问道。

paras.en: Iduna looked toward the door, debating whether she should humor her daughters.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜望向房门，犹豫着是否该顺着女儿们的心意。

paras.en: After deciding there was no harm in letting the girls hear the song, she nodded to them. “Okay.
paras.zh: 她断定让女孩们听听这首歌并无大碍，便朝她们点了点头。“好吧。”

paras.en: Cuddle close.
paras.zh: “靠紧些。”

paras.en: Scooch in,” she said, pulling Elsa and Anna to her, tucking them all back under her scarf.
paras.zh: “挤进来，”她把艾莎和安娜拉到自己身边，重新把她们都裹进围巾里，说道。

paras.en: Queen Iduna’s voice was low and warm as it sang the lullaby her mother had sung to her.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜王后的声音低沉而温暖，唱起了母亲曾唱给她听的摇篮曲。

paras.en: It was the sound of love in the girls’ ears, and Anna was fast asleep even before the song was done.
paras.zh: 在女孩们听来，那是爱的声音，歌还没唱完，安娜就已经沉沉睡去。

paras.en: The queen picked Anna up gently, cradling her as she carried her across the room.
paras.zh: 王后轻轻抱起安娜，小心翼翼地抱着她穿过房间。

paras.en: She placed Anna softly on her own bed and pulled up the covers, tucking her in tight.
paras.zh: 她把安娜轻轻放在她自己的床上，拉起被子，把她严严实实地掖好。

paras.en: Queen Iduna returned to Elsa just as she finished the song. “Now sleep, my little snow,” she said, kissing both of Elsa’s hands.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜王后刚唱完歌，就回到艾莎身边。“现在睡吧，我的小雪人，”她吻着艾莎的双手，说道。

paras.en: The queen fluffed Elsa’s pillows, stroked her daughter’s long hair, and picked up the candle that flickered on the bedside table. “Mother?” Elsa said as the queen touched the door of the room. “Do you think Ahtohallan knows why I have magical power?” Her mother didn’t answer immediately.
paras.zh: 王后拍松了艾莎的枕头，抚了抚女儿的长发，又拿起在床头柜上摇曳的蜡烛。“母亲？”王后正要触碰房门时，艾莎开口了，“您觉得阿托哈兰知道我为什么拥有魔力吗？”母亲没有立刻回答。

paras.en: She thought carefully before she spoke. “If Ahtohallan is out there,” she said finally, “I imagine it knows that and much more.” Elsa leaned heavily into her pillow. “Someone should really try to find it.” Queen Iduna’s smile was bittersweet as she stepped into the hallway and closed the door behind her.
paras.zh: 她慎重地想了想才开口。“如果阿托哈兰真的存在，”她终于说道，“我想它知道的，远不止这些。”艾莎重重地靠进枕头里。“真该有人去把它找出来。”伊杜娜王后露出一丝苦涩的微笑，走进走廊，随手关上了门。

paras.en: With the echo of her mother’s lullaby in her ears, Elsa drifted off to sleep.
paras.zh: 母亲摇篮曲的余音还在耳边回荡，艾莎渐渐沉入了梦乡。

paras.en: She dreamed about finding Ahtohallan, and learning the answer to every question she’d ever had…and the answers to some of her sister’s questions, too.
paras.zh: 她梦见自己找到了阿托哈兰，解开了她曾有过的一切问题的答案……也解开了妹妹某些问题的答案。

paras.en: All of Arendelle was silent, and the night was still—even in the castle—until Anna tiptoed across the rugs of her bedroom floor.
paras.zh: 整个阿伦黛尔一片寂静，夜也静悄悄的——即便在城堡里也是——直到安娜踮着脚，从卧室的地毯上悄悄走过。

paras.en: It took the five-year-old more than one try to pull herself onto her sister’s bed.
paras.zh: 这个五岁的小女孩试了好几次，才爬上姐姐的床。

paras.en: But once she had made it, she crawled over and shook Elsa’s shoulder. “Elsa,” Anna said in what she thought was a whisper but what was really the furthest thing from one. “ Psst , Elsa.
paras.zh: 不过一旦爬了上去，她就爬过去摇了摇艾莎的肩膀。“艾莎，”安娜用她自以为的耳语——其实根本算不上耳语——说道，“ 嘘 ，艾莎。”

paras.en: Wake up, wake up, wake up!” Elsa hated to be awakened.
paras.zh: “醒醒，醒醒，快醒醒！”艾莎最讨厌被人叫醒。

paras.en: It made her grumpy. “Anna,” she protested, turning her back on her sister and tugging her covers up under her chin, “go back to sleep.” “I just can’t,” Anna complained, flopping on the bed like a young child who hadn’t gotten her way…and who refused to give up. “The sky’s awake.
paras.zh: 这让她脾气暴躁。“安娜，”她背过身去，把被子拉到下巴底下，抗议道，“回去睡觉。”“我就是睡不着，”安娜抱怨着，像个小孩子没如愿以偿似的往床上一倒……而且绝不放弃，“天醒着呢。”

paras.en: So I’m awake.
paras.zh: “所以我也醒着。”

paras.en: So we have to play.” Anna looked out the window at the dancing greens and blues of the Northern Lights that dominated the night sky.
paras.zh: “所以我们得玩。”安娜望向窗外，夜空中舞动的绿色与蓝色北极光占据了整个天幕。

paras.en: Then she looked back at her sister, who had buried herself under the covers.
paras.zh: 接着她回头看向把自己埋进被子里的小姐姐。

paras.en: She poked Elsa.
paras.zh: 她戳了戳艾莎。

paras.en: She prodded her.
paras.zh: 她又捅了捅她。

paras.en: She even tried to pull her blankets off. “If I agree to play with you for a little bit, will you let me sleep as long as I want when we are done?” asked Elsa’s muffled voice from beneath the blankets. “Yes!” Anna agreed enthusiastically, nodding.
paras.zh: 她甚至想把她的被子拽下来。“如果我答应陪你玩一小会儿，等玩完了，你能让我想睡多久就睡多久吗？”被子底下传来艾莎闷闷的声音，问道。“好啊！”安娜开心地连连点头，答应了。

paras.en: Even with Anna tugging at her, Elsa was a reluctant partner.
paras.zh: 尽管安娜拉扯个不停，艾莎还是一百个不情愿地陪着玩。

paras.en: She rubbed her eyes and dragged her feet as her sister pulled her to the Great Hall—and then her ice magic came out and a new chapter began for them.
paras.zh: 她揉着眼睛，磨磨蹭蹭地任由姐姐把自己拉去大礼堂——就在这时，她的冰雪魔法显露出来，她们崭新的篇章就此开启。

paras.en: One day years later, when the girls were grown, their parents were gone, and Elsa was Queen of Arendelle, the sun was shining brilliantly over the cliffs of the fjord.
paras.zh: 多年后的某一天，两个女孩都已长大，父母也已离世，艾莎成了阿伦黛尔的女王，阳光正灿烂地洒在峡湾的悬崖之上。

paras.en: Elsa stood on a rear castle ­balcony, waiting for her moment to rejoin the vis­iting dignitaries and wish them well on their journeys home.
paras.zh: 艾莎站在城堡后侧的一个阳台上，等待时机去送别来访的贵宾，祝他们归途顺利。

paras.en: She had already spoken to them about trade and commerce, as well as the Arendellian people and their goals for the kingdom.
paras.zh: 她已经和他们谈过了贸易与商业，以及阿伦黛尔人民和王国的发展目标。

paras.en: Anna liked to tell her that she was graceful and wise far beyond her years.
paras.zh: 安娜总爱对她说，她举手投足间的优雅与智慧，远超她的实际年纪。

paras.en: For people who didn’t know Elsa, it was strange at first, but the more she spoke, the more they would have agreed with Anna. “Your Majesty, they’re ready.” Elsa jumped, startled when she heard Kai, one of her most trusted advisers.
paras.zh: 对不了解艾莎的人来说，起初会觉得奇怪，可她越说，他们就越会同意安娜的话。“陛下，他们准备好了。”艾莎听到最信任的顾问之一凯的声音，吓了一跳，猛地一颤。

paras.en: Kai had known her since the day she was born.
paras.zh: 凯从她出生那天起就认识她了。

paras.en: He could tell that Elsa was nervous, but he kept this observation quietly to himself.
paras.zh: 他看得出艾莎很紧张，却把这份观察默默藏在心里。

paras.en: Her hands were wrapped around the balcony railing, and her emotional jolt instantly turned it to ice.
paras.zh: 她的双手紧抓着阳台栏杆，情绪上的震动瞬间把栏杆冻成了冰。

paras.en: She laughed nervously. “Oh, ha!
paras.zh: 她紧张地笑了笑。“哎呀，哈！”

paras.en: Excuse me.
paras.zh: “失陪一下。”

paras.en: I’m coming,” she said.
paras.zh: “我这就来，”她说。

paras.en: After unfreezing the railing, Elsa turned to follow Kai into the castle, but she was stopped by a haunting call, a voice that spoke to her in a wordless melody.
paras.zh: 解冻栏杆之后，艾莎转身跟着凯走进城堡，却被一声萦绕心头的呼唤拦住了脚步——那是一个用无声旋律对她诉说的声音。

paras.en: It was beautiful, yet sounded pained at the same time.
paras.zh: 那声音很美，却同时透着痛苦。

paras.en: She turned back toward the outdoors. “Do you hear that?” she asked Kai, wondering where the voice was coming from. “What?” Kai answered. “That voice,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: 她转过身朝向室外。“你听见了吗？”她问凯，心里疑惑那声音从何而来。“什么？”凯反问。“那个声音，”艾莎说。

paras.en: Kai’s brow furrowed. “What voice?” As soon as he said those words, the voice stopped as abruptly as it had started.
paras.zh: 凯皱起眉头。“什么声音？”他话音刚落，那声音就像它突然出现时一样，戛然而止。

paras.en: Elsa turned back to Kai and saw concern on his face.
paras.zh: 艾莎转回身看向凯，看见他脸上写满了担忧。

paras.en: She smiled to cover the unsettling feeling that washed over her. “Never mind,” she said, and followed him into the castle.
paras.zh: 她勉强一笑，掩饰住心头涌起的那种不安。“没事，”她说着，跟着他走进了城堡。

paras.en: Inside, Kristoff was performing daring tricks with Sven.
paras.zh: 城堡里，克里斯托夫正和斯文一起表演惊险的特技。

paras.en: He had already shared with the dignitaries some unusual facts about reindeer that could help them cultivate better crops and make traveling throughout Arendelle easier.
paras.zh: 他已经和贵宾们分享了一些关于驯鹿的奇闻，这些知识能帮助他们种出更好的庄稼，也让在阿伦黛尔旅行变得更容易。

paras.en: As Kristoff finished, Elsa approached the front of the room for her final goodbyes.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫表演完毕，艾莎走到房间前方，做最后的道别。

paras.en: Everything’s great , Elsa thought, regaining her composure with a smile.
paras.zh: “一切都好，”艾莎想着，微笑着重新镇定下来。

paras.en: Her muscles were tense with the urge to release her magic. “Thank you again for coming,” Elsa said to each dignitary as they passed. “It’s always great to see you.” Once she had completed her duty, Elsa exited the room and walked along the hallways and out the castle’s front door.
paras.zh: 她的肌肉紧绷着，满是想释放魔法的冲动。“再次感谢各位莅临，”每位贵宾经过时，艾莎都这样说道，“见到你们总是很开心。”待到礼毕，艾莎走出房间，沿着走廊，从城堡正门走了出去。

paras.en: She greeted the villagers and visitors scattered throughout the courtyard as she strolled toward the fjord.
paras.zh: 她一边朝峡湾漫步走去，一边向散落在庭院各处的村民和访客打招呼。

paras.en: Elsa passed small boats and magnificent ships tied to the docks.
paras.zh: 艾莎经过系在码头上的小船和宏伟的大船。

paras.en: She stayed calm as she went as far down the side of the fjord as she could, until there were no people or boats around.
paras.zh: 她努力保持平静，沿着峡湾岸边一直走到最深处，直到周围再没有人和船。

paras.en: This was where she went when she had to release extra energy.
paras.zh: 每当需要释放多余的能量时，她就会来到这里。

paras.en: Whoever or whatever the voice was that had spoken to her in its wordless melody had filled her with more energy and magic than she’d ever felt before.
paras.zh: 无论是谁、无论是什么，那个用无声旋律对她诉说过的声音，带给她的能量与魔法，都超过了她以往任何一次的感受。

paras.en: Elsa threw out her arms and let magic shoot from her fingers at full force.
paras.zh: 艾莎张开双臂，让魔力从指尖全力迸发。

paras.en: Ice and snow filled the air in front of her, then crashed into the fjord.
paras.zh: 冰雪填满了她面前的空气，随后轰然坠入峡湾。

paras.en: Elsa turned and covered her face, chuckling as water splashed all around her.
paras.zh: 艾莎转过身捂住脸，在四溅的水花中咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: Anna walked along the edge of the village and took a deep breath of the fresh autumn air as a bright red leaf blew past her.
paras.zh: 安娜沿着村庄的边缘走着，深深吸了一口清新的秋日空气，一片鲜红的叶子从她身边飘过。

paras.en: It was the perfect day to find the perfect pumpkin.
paras.zh: 今天是寻找一个完美南瓜的绝佳日子。

paras.en: She saw one of her favorite friends up ahead, and she couldn’t help the huge smile that took over her face. “Enjoying your new permafrost, Olaf?” she asked the talking snowman, who was sunbathing happily amid the pumpkins in the patch with a satisfied grin on his face. “I’m just living the dream, Anna,” he said, reaching out to catch the same brilliant red leaf as it flew by him. “Oh, how I wish this could last forever.” Anna closed her eyes as she took a moment to let the warm sunshine wash over her body. “Mmmm.” Suddenly remembering why she had come to the patch in the first place, Anna opened her eyes and set out searching for the perfect pumpkin.
paras.zh: 她看见前方有一位最要好的朋友，脸上不由自主地绽开了大大的笑容。“在享受你的新永冻层吗，雪宝？”她问那个会说话的雪人。雪宝正心满意足地咧着嘴笑，在南瓜地里快活地晒着太阳。“我只是在追逐梦想，安娜，”他说着，伸出手去接那片同样从他身旁飞过的鲜红叶子。“噢，真希望这一刻能永远持续下去。”安娜闭上眼睛，让自己沉浸在温暖的阳光里，感受它洒满全身。“嗯——”忽然想起自己最初来南瓜地的原因，安娜睁开眼，开始寻找那个完美的南瓜。

paras.en: It had to have no holes or cuts.
paras.zh: 它不能有洞，也不能有划痕。

paras.en: She also wanted one with a nice thick green stem.
paras.zh: 她还想要一个带着粗壮青绿梗的。

paras.en: And maybe one that wasn’t lopsided.
paras.zh: 或许最好也别是个歪瓜。

paras.en: Anna bent to knock on one with her knuckles.
paras.zh: 安娜弯下腰，用指节敲了敲其中一个。

paras.en: It sounded hollow.
paras.zh: 声音听起来是空的。

paras.en: She didn’t remember whether that meant the pumpkin was good or bad, but she supposed it really didn’t matter, since they weren’t planning to eat it.
paras.zh: 她记不清那究竟意味着南瓜好还是不好，不过她想，反正他们也不打算吃它，所以也无所谓。

paras.en: Still, she kept looking. “And yet change mocks us with her beauty,” Olaf said. “What’s that?” Anna asked, carefully inspecting each pumpkin she passed.
paras.zh: 可她还是继续找着。“然而，变化却用她的美丽嘲笑我们，”雪宝说。“你说什么？”安娜问，一边仔细打量着她经过的每一个南瓜。

paras.en: One had a bug hole.
paras.zh: 其中一个有虫眼。

paras.en: And the one next to that wasn’t quite the right orange for a perfect pumpkin. “Forgive me.
paras.zh: 旁边那个的颜色也不够那种完美南瓜该有的橙。“请原谅我。

paras.en: Maturity is making me poetic,” he mused. “Tell me—you’re older and thus all-knowing.
paras.zh: 成熟让我变得诗意了，”他若有所思地说。“告诉我吧——你年长一些，所以无所不知。

paras.en: Do you ever worry about the notion that nothing is permanent?” “Nope,” she answered right away, but she was only half listening.
paras.zh: 你有没有担心过‘没有什么是永恒不变’这件事？”“才不呢，”她立刻答道，但其实只听进去了一半。

paras.en: The perfect pumpkin was proving to be rather hard to find. “Really,” he said, bewildered by her response. “Wow, I can’t wait until I’m aged like you, so I don’t have to worry about important things.” Taking a break from her pumpkin hunt, Anna concentrated on Olaf’s question. “That’s not what I mean,” she explained. “I don’t worry, because…well, I have you and Elsa and Kristoff and Sven, and the gates are open wide, and I’m not alone anymore—” She lay down next to him, her head cradled in her arms, and looked up at the bright blue sky, wondering how to explain her thoughts to her friend.
paras.zh: 看来完美的南瓜还真不好找。“真的吗，”他被她的回答弄糊涂了，“哇，真等不及像你那样变老，那样我就不用为重要的事操心了。”安娜暂且停下寻南瓜，认真思考起雪宝的问题。“我不是那个意思，”她解释道，“我不担心，是因为……嗯，我有你，有艾莎，有克里斯托夫，还有斯文，城门敞开着，我不再孤单一人了——”她在他身旁躺下，头枕在臂弯里，望着湛蓝明亮的天空，琢磨着该怎么向朋友说清自己的想法。

paras.en: She had an idea and sat up, motioning to a rotting pumpkin in the patch.
paras.zh: 她有了主意，坐起身，指了指地里一个正在腐烂的南瓜。

paras.en: She explained that one day it would become fertilizer to help other pumpkins grow.
paras.zh: 她解释说，总有一天它会变成肥料，帮助别的南瓜生长。

paras.en: But Olaf still wasn’t sure what she was saying.
paras.zh: 可雪宝还是没太明白她在说什么。

paras.en: Taking his hand, Anna pulled him to his feet.
paras.zh: 安娜拉起他的手，把他从地上拽了起来。

paras.en: They left the pumpkin patch—and right next to the gate was the perfect pumpkin.
paras.zh: 他们离开了南瓜地——而就在大门旁边，那个完美的南瓜正等着呢。

paras.en: Anna grabbed it and held it as she and Olaf walked along the road into town.
paras.zh: 安娜一把抱起它，抱着它和雪宝沿着大路朝镇上走去。

paras.en: She tried to explain that while some things in the world changed, other things didn’t—those things could be counted on to always stay the same.
paras.zh: 她试图说明，世间有些事物会改变，有些却不会——那些不会改变的，可以永远信赖，始终如一。

paras.en: Anna hoisted her perfect pumpkin onto a cart led by a gray horse driven by a gray-haired villager.
paras.zh: 安娜把她的完美南瓜举上了由一匹灰马拉着、由一位灰发村民赶着的马车。

paras.en: She waved at the driver as he headed toward town.
paras.zh: 车夫朝镇上走时，她朝他挥了挥手。

paras.en: A big family, full of grandparents, parents, babies, and other children, called a greeting to Anna and Olaf.
paras.zh: 一个大家庭，祖辈、父母、婴儿和其他孩子济济一堂，向安娜和雪宝打了声招呼。

paras.en: Olaf wanted to point out to Anna that the people in the family had changed—some had grown old, and new members had been born.
paras.zh: 雪宝想向安娜指出，这家人已经变了——有些人老了，又有新成员降生。

paras.en: But before he began to speak, Anna pulled him over to a house that was being painted. “Don’t you love this color?” she said.
paras.zh: 可还没等他开口，安娜就把他拉到一所正在粉刷的房子前。“你不喜欢这个颜色吗？”她说。

paras.en: Anna asked the painter the name of it while Olaf tried to say that the house had been white and was now being painted blue, so that was changing as well.
paras.zh: 安娜问粉刷匠这颜色叫什么名字，而雪宝则想说，这房子原本是白的，现在正刷成蓝色，所以它也在变。

paras.en: Anna didn’t hear him. “See, Olaf?” she said with a smile, taking his hand in hers. “Some things never change.”
paras.zh: 安娜没听见他的话。“看到了吗，雪宝？”她微笑着握住他的手说，“有些事，永不改变。”

paras.en: The red leaf finally blew out of Olaf’s hand and traveled on until it passed Kristoff and his reindeer, Sven.
paras.zh: 那片红叶终于从雪宝手里飘走，一路飘去，直到掠过克里斯托夫和他那头驯鹿斯文。

paras.en: Kristoff was showing Sven a ring box. “Are you sure you’re ready to ask her the big question?” Kristoff asked in Sven’s voice. “Yes,” Kristoff replied to Sven, as if the reindeer had said the words himself. “I’m just not sure how to ask her in the most romantic way without messing everything up.” “Let me handle the details!” Sven’s voice said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫正给斯文看一个戒指盒。“你确定准备好向她提出那个大问题了吗？”克里斯托夫用斯文的嗓音问道。“是的，”克里斯托夫替斯文答道，好像那头驯鹿亲口说了这话似的。“我只是不确定，怎样才能用最浪漫的方式开口，又不把一切都搞砸。”“细节交给我来办！”斯文的嗓音说。

paras.en: Kristoff knew Anna was the one he was supposed to spend the rest of his life with, so he was confident he’d find the right words when the time was right.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫知道，安娜就是那个要和他共度余生的人，所以他相信，时机到了，自然能找到合适的词句。

paras.en: He swooned when he saw Anna walking down the street toward them with Olaf by her side, window shopping.
paras.zh: 当他看见安娜带着雪宝在街边逛着橱窗朝他们走来时，他简直要醉了。

paras.en: Kristoff held tightly to Sven to ease his nerves as he looked at her.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫紧紧抱住斯文，想借此平复望着她时的紧张。

paras.en: Maybe he wasn’t as confident as he thought.
paras.zh: 也许他并不像自己想的那么有信心。

paras.en: Kristoff pulled his best friend into a suit shop.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把最好的朋友拉进了一家西装店。

paras.en: He needed to find the last perfect touch for his outfit.
paras.zh: 他需要为自己的行头找到最后那一点完美的点缀。

paras.en: He looked through neckties and ascots.
paras.zh: 他翻看了领带和领巾。

paras.en: He saw ones with stripes and ones with dots, but they weren’t what he was looking for.
paras.zh: 他见了条纹的，也见了圆点的，可都不是他想要的。

paras.en: Then Sven found an ascot covered in carrots and nudged it toward him. “It’s perfect!” Kristoff declared.
paras.zh: 这时斯文找到一条印满胡萝卜的领巾，用鼻子把它拱到他面前。“太完美了！”克里斯托夫宣布。

paras.en: The red leaf flew farther through the air until it reached the castle, where a huge gust swept it through an open window into the library.
paras.zh: 红叶在空中飘得更远，一直飘到城堡，一阵大风把它从敞开的窗户卷进了图书室。

paras.en: The papers Elsa was working on flew off her desk and fluttered around the room.
paras.zh: 艾莎正在处理的文件从桌上飞起，在房间里四处翻飞。

paras.en: She stood and walked through the dancing papers to the window and looked down at the kingdom, wondering if the changing winds were signaling a big change to come.
paras.zh: 她站起身，穿过飞舞的纸张走到窗前，俯瞰着王国，思忖着这变化不定的风是否预示着即将到来的巨大改变。

paras.en: Maybe that was why she’d heard the haunting call.
paras.zh: 也许，这就是她听到那阵萦绕心头的呼唤的原因。

paras.en: When her eyes landed on Anna and Kristoff hugging after his trip to the suit shop, a smile immediately lit up her face.
paras.zh: 当她的目光落在安娜和刚从西装店出来的克里斯托夫相拥的画面时，她的脸上立刻绽开了笑容。

paras.en: Sven and Olaf weren’t far behind, laughing, snorting, and doing the things that reindeer and snowmen did when they were having fun.
paras.zh: 斯文和雪宝紧随其后，欢笑着、喷着鼻息，做着驯鹿和雪人玩得开心时会做的事。

paras.en: More than anything, Elsa wanted moments like this to stay the same.
paras.zh: 艾莎最最盼望的，就是这样的时刻能一直保持不变。

paras.en: They were so precious to her, she wished she could freeze them.
paras.zh: 它们对她如此珍贵，她真希望能把它们冻结起来。

paras.en: She realized the best thing she could do was join her sister and friends to seize the day and be part of the moment.
paras.zh: 她意识到，自己能做的最好的事，就是加入妹妹和朋友们，把握当下，成为这瞬间的一部分。

paras.en: Without another thought for her paperwork, Elsa rushed out the door.
paras.zh: 艾莎再也无心顾及手头的公文，冲出了门。

paras.en: Olaf, Kristoff, Anna, and Sven were in the center of the village when Elsa caught up with them.
paras.zh: 当艾莎追上他们时，雪宝、克里斯托夫、安娜和斯文正在村子中央。

paras.en: The people of Arendelle cheered for their queen, dancing and singing around her, celebrating the bounty that the season had brought to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的百姓为他们的女王欢呼，围着她又唱又跳，庆祝这个季节为阿伦黛尔带来的丰收。

paras.en: Anna danced with them and helped the villagers with the harvest they had set on the main table under the autumn sky.
paras.zh: 安娜和他们一起跳舞，还帮村民把收获的庄稼摆到秋日天空下的主桌上。

paras.en: As usual, she made sure everything was just right for everyone.
paras.zh: 像往常一样，她确保一切都让大家称心如意。

paras.en: Olaf even helped unload the fishing boats.
paras.zh: 雪宝甚至帮忙卸下了渔船上的鱼。

paras.en: The first person at the boat grabbed a fish and tossed it to the next person in line, and the fish was passed all the way down to the cooking area.
paras.zh: 船上第一个人抓起一条鱼，抛给队伍里的下一个人，鱼就这样一路传到了烹饪区。

paras.en: The system worked great—except Olaf was at the end of the line, and instead of passing each fish to the cook, he innocently tossed them back into the sea.
paras.zh: 这法子挺管用——只除了一点：雪宝站在队伍末尾，他不把每条鱼递给厨子，而是天真地又把鱼扔回了海里。

paras.en: Elsa found herself next to Anna as she proudly raised the Arendellian flag.
paras.zh: 当安娜骄傲地升起阿伦黛尔旗帜时，艾莎发现自己就站在她身旁。

paras.en: When the flag reached the top of the pole, it snapped in the wind, waving a welcome to all who saw it.
paras.zh: 旗帜升到杆顶时，在风里“啪”地展开，向所有看见它的人挥手致意。

paras.en: Anna took Elsa’s arm and they stood together next to the flagpole.
paras.zh: 安娜挽住艾莎的手臂，两人并肩站在旗杆旁。

paras.en: They were proud to live in a kingdom of plenty, under a flag that stood for the good of everyone.
paras.zh: 她们为自己生活在一个丰饶的王国里而自豪，那面旗帜代表着所有人的福祉。

paras.en: They promised their people, and themselves, that the flag would always fly.
paras.zh: 她们向百姓，也向自己承诺，这面旗帜将永远飘扬。

paras.en: The villagers laughed and chatted as they made their way to their places at the communal tables.
paras.zh: 村民们说说笑笑，走向公共餐桌各自的座位。

paras.en: They had more than they could have ever wanted, and they hoped for their good luck to last.
paras.zh: 他们拥有得超乎想象，只盼望这份好运能一直延续。

paras.en: The pumpkin Anna had picked sat on the head table, a perfect decoration for an amazing celebration.
paras.zh: 安娜挑的那个南瓜摆在主桌上，为这场精彩的庆典添了完美的一笔。

paras.en: Elsa stood behind her chair with the castle shining radiantly behind her.
paras.zh: 艾莎站在自己的椅子后面，身后是熠熠生辉的城堡。

paras.en: As queen, she was the first to take her seat.
paras.zh: 身为女王，她第一个落座。

paras.en: She quickly signaled for everyone else to follow.
paras.zh: 她随即示意其他人也坐下。

paras.en: Anna stood a moment longer, her warm gaze passing over the people and the kingdom she loved.
paras.zh: 安娜又多站了一会儿，温柔的目光掠过她所深爱的人民与王国。

paras.en: Friends and family passed food to one another as they talked excitedly.
paras.zh: 亲朋好友们一边兴奋地交谈，一边互相递着食物。

paras.en: Everyone was grateful for the time they had together.
paras.zh: 每个人都感激能有这样相聚的时光。

paras.en: As the sun set and the crowd dispersed, everyone with a full belly, Anna held the castle door open for her family—Elsa, Sven, Kristoff, and Olaf—as they stepped inside, one by one.
paras.zh: 夕阳西下，人群散去，人人都吃得饱饱的。安娜为她的家人——艾莎、斯文、克里斯托夫和雪宝——拉住城堡的大门，让他们一个接一个地走进去。

paras.en: Then she closed the door, excited for what they had planned next.
paras.zh: 然后她关上门，对接下来他们安排好的事充满期待。

paras.en: * In the castle library that night, the fire blazed in the hearth, the red and orange flames dancing brightly.
paras.zh: 那天夜里，城堡的图书室里炉火烧得正旺，红橙相间的火苗在欢快地跳跃。

paras.en: It was a warm and safe place to gather and have fun with family and friends—the opposite of the cold day during the eternal winter when Hans had put the fire out and left Anna there all alone.
paras.zh: 这里温暖又安全，是和家人朋友相聚玩乐的好地方——与那个永远寒冬里的冰冷日子截然相反，那时汉斯扑灭了炉火，把安娜独自一人留在那里。

paras.en: Elsa, Olaf, and Kristoff huddled together on a small couch.
paras.zh: 艾莎、雪宝和克里斯托夫挤在一张小沙发上。

paras.en: They were all trying to guess what Anna was acting out in a game of charades.
paras.zh: 他们都在努力猜安娜比划的哑剧猜词游戏里演的是什么。

paras.en: Sven was keeping score.
paras.zh: 斯文负责记分数。

paras.en: He was also in charge of ringing the bell when the time was up.
paras.zh: 时间到了，也由他负责摇铃。

paras.en: Elsa stared at her sister in confusion.
paras.zh: 艾莎困惑地盯着妹妹。

paras.en: She had no idea who or what Anna was trying to depict.
paras.zh: 她完全想不出安娜到底在演谁、又在表现什么。

paras.en: It could have been a lizard, or it could have been a ship.
paras.zh: 可能是蜥蜴，也可能是一艘船。

paras.en: She sat back, utterly stumped as she watched Anna make silly, monsterlike faces. “Okay,” Kristoff said, sure that he had the right answer. “Lion.” “Grizzly bear,” Olaf said. “Monster,” Kristoff guessed. “Brown bear,” said Olaf. “Angry face!” Kristoff yelled. “Black bear,” Olaf said, continuing his string of bear guesses.
paras.zh: 她向后一靠，彻底被难住了，眼看着安娜做着傻乎乎、像怪物一样的鬼脸。“好了，”克里斯托夫信心十足地说，觉得自己答案肯定对，“狮子。”“灰熊，”雪宝说。“怪物，”克里斯托夫猜道。“棕熊，”雪宝说。“生气的脸！”克里斯托夫喊道。“黑熊，”雪宝接着他那串关于熊的猜测说道。

paras.en: Anna knew she had to do something different or her family would never guess the right answer.
paras.zh: 安娜知道，她得换个花样，不然家人永远猜不中正确答案。

paras.en: An idea suddenly came to her.
paras.zh: 她突然想到了一个主意。

paras.en: She pretended to grab a sword and attacked the air in front of her as if it were an invisible enemy. “Hans!” Olaf shouted immediately.
paras.zh: 她假装抓起一把剑，朝面前的空气刺去，就好像那是看不见的敌人。“汉斯！”雪宝立刻喊了出来。

paras.en: They remembered the prince from the ­Southern Isles who had betrayed Anna—and all of Arendelle—three years before.
paras.zh: 他们想起了那个来自南方群岛的王子，三年前，他背叛了安娜——也背叛了整个阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Anna motioned to let Olaf know he almost had it. “Unredeemable monster,” Elsa said, referring to Hans, finally able to jump in. “Greatest mistake of your life!” Kristoff yelled. “Wouldn’t even kiss you!” Olaf added.
paras.zh: 安娜比了个手势，让雪宝知道他差不多猜到了。“无可救药的怪物，”艾莎指汉斯说道，终于也能插上话，“你这辈子最大的错误！”克里斯托夫喊道。“连吻都不肯吻你！”雪宝补了一句。

paras.en: Sven rang the bell, held delicately between his teeth, to let them know they’d run out of time.
paras.zh: 斯文轻轻用牙叼着铃铛摇了起来，告诉他们时间到了。

paras.en: Anna was surprised they hadn’t guessed correctly, but she liked how their answers had so accurately described Hans.
paras.zh: 安娜很意外他们居然没猜对，不过她挺喜欢大家给出的答案竟把汉斯形容得那么贴切。

paras.en: They looked at her expectantly. “Villain,” she said.
paras.zh: 大家期待地看着她。“反派，”她说。

paras.en: Groans filled the room.
paras.zh: 房间里响起一片叹气声。

paras.en: Hans was definitely a villain. “We all kind of got it,” Olaf said.
paras.zh: 汉斯绝对是个反派。“我们其实都差不多猜到了，”雪宝说。

paras.en: Everyone nodded as Anna took a seat on the couch next to Elsa. “Okay, Olaf,” Kristoff prompted. “You’re up.” “Okay,” the snowman said. “So much easier now that I can read!” He reached into the hat that Sven held to pick out a piece of paper and read what was on it. “Lightning round, boys against girls.” Kristoff was fired up. “I’m ready, I’m ready.
paras.zh: 安娜在艾莎身旁沙发上坐下，大家都点了点头。“好了，雪宝，”克里斯托夫催促道，“轮到你了。”“好，”雪人说道，“现在我会认字了，可轻松多了！”他伸手从斯文捧着的帽子里抽出一张纸条，念了上面的词。“闪电轮，男生对女生。”克里斯托夫顿时来了劲。“我准备好了，我准备好了。”

paras.en: Go!” Sven turned to reset the timer and then rang the bell.
paras.zh: “开始！”斯文转身重设计时器，然后摇响了铃。

paras.en: Olaf had an advantage in playing charades because he could rearrange himself to fit any answer, and that was exactly what he did now.
paras.zh: 雪宝玩猜词游戏有个优势——他可以重新摆弄自己的身体来配合任何答案，而此刻他正是这么做的。

paras.en: He pulled out his arms and legs and nose and put them in different places on his body to form different shapes and sizes.
paras.zh: 他把胳膊、腿和鼻子拔出来，安在身体不同位置，变出各种形状和大小。

paras.en: Almost as fast as Olaf assembled himself each time, Kristoff guessed the right answer. “Unicorn,” Kristoff said. “Ice cream.
paras.zh: 雪宝每拼好一次，克里斯托夫几乎瞬间就猜中了。“独角兽，”克里斯托夫说。“冰淇淋。”

paras.en: Castle!
paras.zh: 城堡！

paras.en: Oaken!
paras.zh: 奥肯！

paras.en: Teapot!
paras.zh: 茶壶！

paras.en: Mouse!
paras.zh: 老鼠！

paras.en: Oooh, Elsa!” Sven rang the bell to end the round.
paras.zh: “噢——艾莎！”斯文摇铃结束了这一轮。

paras.en: Time had flown!
paras.zh: 时间过得好快！

paras.en: The guys cheered.
paras.zh: 男生们欢呼起来。

paras.en: They hadn’t gotten a single one wrong.
paras.zh: 他们一道都没猜错。

paras.en: Anna didn’t believe it was fair. “I don’t think Olaf should get to rearrange,” she said, looking pointedly at both Olaf and Kristoff.
paras.zh: 安娜觉得这不公平。“我觉得雪宝不该能重新摆弄身体，”她说道，特意把雪宝和克里斯托夫都看了一眼。

paras.en: Elsa’s expression showed that she agreed. “Doesn’t matter.
paras.zh: 艾莎的表情表明她也这么认为。“没关系。

paras.en: This is going to be a cinch.
paras.zh: 这回准轻松搞定。”

paras.en: Two sisters, one mind.” Elsa didn’t have her sister’s confidence as she got to her feet to choose the paper from Sven. “Thank you,” she said. “Okay,” Anna said with conviction. “Here we go!
paras.zh: “姐妹同心，心有灵犀。”艾莎可没有妹妹那份自信，她站起身从斯文那儿抽纸条。“谢谢，”她说。“好，”安娜坚定地说，“我们开始吧！”

paras.en: You got this, Elsa.” She had no doubt they could still win.
paras.zh: “你行的，艾莎。”她毫不怀疑她们仍能赢下这局。

paras.en: Then Sven rang the bell and Elsa started acting out her first charade.
paras.zh: 接着斯文摇响了铃，艾莎开始比划她的第一个词。

paras.en: Anna immediately realized that picking charades for family game night had been a huge mistake.
paras.zh: 安娜立刻意识到，把猜词游戏选作家庭游戏之夜是个大错误。

paras.en: While Elsa was great with magic, she was horrible at charades.
paras.zh: 艾莎施展魔法是把好手，玩猜词游戏却糟透了。

paras.en: Nothing Elsa did made any sense.
paras.zh: 艾莎做的每一个动作都让人摸不着头脑。

paras.en: Every motion she made just seemed so…vague. “Any time.
paras.zh: 她做的每个动作都显得那么……含糊。“随时都行。”

paras.en: Just do it with your body,” Anna said, coaching her.
paras.zh: “用你的身体演出来就好，”安娜指导着她说。

paras.en: Then she simply started guessing. “Um…nothing.
paras.zh: 接着她干脆直接猜了起来。“嗯……没什么。”

paras.en: Air.
paras.zh: 空气。

paras.en: Tree.
paras.zh: 树。

paras.en: People.
paras.zh: 人。

paras.en: Treeple!
paras.zh: 树人！

paras.en: That’s not a word.
paras.zh: 那不是个词。

paras.en: Shovel boy.
paras.zh: 铲子男孩。

paras.en: Teeth?
paras.zh: 牙齿？

paras.en: Oh, pillow fort!” “Polar bear!” Olaf shouted, not wanting to be left out. “Hey!” Anna said.
paras.zh: “噢，枕头堡垒！”“北极熊！”雪宝不甘被冷落，大声喊道。“嘿！”安娜说。

paras.en: He wasn’t allowed to guess.
paras.zh: 他是不许猜的。

paras.en: And he already had a billion points with Kristoff.
paras.zh: 而且他跟克里斯托夫一组，分数早就多到数不清了。

paras.en: Besides, it was boys versus girls. “Sorry,” he said.
paras.zh: 再说了，这可是男生对女生。“抱歉，”他说。

paras.en: Elsa looked at the paper again, and as she tried to imagine how to act out the word, she heard the beautifully haunting voice again.
paras.zh: 艾莎又低头看了看纸条，正努力想象该怎么比划这个词时，耳边再次响起了那个美妙而诡异的声音。

paras.en: Her heart raced and her palms sweated.
paras.zh: 她心头一阵狂跳，手心也沁出了汗。

paras.en: She looked at her friends, but they were oblivious, still trying to guess what she was acting out.
paras.zh: 她望向朋友们，可他们毫无察觉，仍在努力猜她演的是什么。

paras.en: Elsa spun around, searching for the source of the voice. “Mountains,” Anna said. “Teeth.
paras.zh: 艾莎转过身，寻找着声音的来源。“山，”安娜说。“牙齿。”

paras.en: Did I already say teeth?
paras.zh: 我是不是已经说过牙齿了？

paras.en: Ooh.
paras.zh: 噢。

paras.en: Uh.
paras.zh: 呃。

paras.en: Distracted.
paras.zh: 走神了。

paras.en: Um, worried?
paras.zh: 嗯，担心？

paras.en: Panicking?
paras.zh: 慌神了？

paras.en: Disturbed.” Elsa didn’t even hear her sister.
paras.zh: “心烦意乱。”艾莎压根没听见妹妹的话。

paras.en: All she heard was the voice. “Oh, come on—you definitely look disturbed,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 她满耳朵只有那个声音。“噢，拜托——你看起来绝对是心烦意乱，”安娜说。

paras.en: The bell rang again, signaling that time was up.
paras.zh: 铃又一次响起，宣告时间到了。

paras.en: Anna groaned. “We won,” Kristoff announced to the room.
paras.zh: 安娜叹了口气。“我们赢了，”克里斯托夫向屋里宣布。

paras.en: Anna wasn’t ready to give in.
paras.zh: 安娜可没打算认输。

paras.en: She jumped off the couch, ready to go again. “Rematch?” she asked, already mentally adding a new rule.
paras.zh: 她从沙发上跳起来，准备再战。“再来一局？”她问道，脑子里已经开始盘算要加一条新规则。

paras.en: She would make sure the group agreed that Olaf couldn’t rearrange his body this time.
paras.zh: 她要让大家一致同意，这一回雪宝不能重新摆弄自己的身体。

paras.en: But even though it had stopped as suddenly as it had started, Elsa couldn’t help thinking about the haunting call.
paras.zh: 可尽管那声音来得突然、去得也突然，艾莎还是忍不住想着那诡异的呼唤。

paras.en: She knew she wouldn’t be able to concentrate on the game. “Oh, you know what?” she said. “I think I’ll turn in.” Where is the voice coming from?
paras.zh: 她知道自己没法再把心思放在游戏上。“噢，你猜怎么着？”她说，“我想我去睡了。”那个声音到底是从哪儿来的？

paras.en: Why am I the only one who can hear it?
paras.zh: 为什么只有我一个人能听见它？

paras.en: Anna could see that something wasn’t right.
paras.zh: 安娜看得出，有点不对劲。

paras.en: Elsa never went to bed early unless there was a major event in the morning.
paras.zh: 除非第二天早上有大事，艾莎从不早睡。

paras.en: And she never left early from family game night. “Are you okay?” she asked.
paras.zh: 而且家庭游戏之夜她也从不提前离场。“你还好吗？”她问道。

paras.en: Elsa paused in the doorway and nodded. “Just tired.
paras.zh: 艾莎在门口停了一下，点了点头。“只是累了。”

paras.en: Good night.” She smiled and moved down the hallway.
paras.zh: “晚安。”她微微一笑，沿着走廊走开了。

paras.en: Still surprised at Elsa’s leaving, Anna stared after her sister. “Yeah,” Olaf said. “I’m tired, too.
paras.zh: 安娜还因为艾莎的离开而惊讶，目送着妹妹的背影。“对啊，”雪宝说，“我也累了。”

paras.en: And Sven promised to read me a bedtime story—didn’t you, Sven?” Kristoff’s heart pounded.
paras.zh: “而且斯文答应给我读睡前故事了——是不是啊，斯文？”克里斯托夫的心怦怦直跳。

paras.en: He couldn’t leave yet—that wasn’t part of his plan. “Did I?” he asked, speaking in Sven’s voice.
paras.zh: 他还不能走——这可不在他的计划里。“我说过吗？”他学着斯文的声音问道。

paras.en: Olaf smiled at Sven. “Oh, you do the best voices.” He jumped up off the couch and headed for the door. “Like when you pretend to be Kristoff.
paras.zh: 雪宝对着斯文笑了笑。“噢，你学谁的声音都最像了。”他从沙发上跳下来，朝门口走去。“就像你假装是克里斯托夫的时候。”

paras.en: And you’re like, ‘I just need to go talk to some rocks about my childhood and stuff.’ ” Kristoff waved them away.
paras.zh: “你还会说：‘我就去跟那些石头聊聊我的童年什么的。’”克里斯托夫把他们挥走。

paras.en: He needed to be alone with Anna. “How about you guys start without me?” he said.
paras.zh: 他需要单独和安娜待着。“你们先开始，不用等我，行吗？”他说。

paras.en: Olaf and Sven looked at each other, nodded in agreement, then left.
paras.zh: 雪宝和斯文对视一眼，点头表示同意，然后离开了。

paras.en: Anna immediately started cleaning up the mess from their game.
paras.zh: 安娜立刻动手收拾游戏留下的乱摊子。

paras.en: She returned the bell to the cabinet drawer and set the timer back on its shelf.
paras.zh: 她把铃铛放回柜子的抽屉，又把计时器摆回架上。

paras.en: While her back was turned, Kristoff raced around the room to set his idea in motion.
paras.zh: 趁她转过身去，克里斯托夫在房间里忙活起来，要把自己的计划付诸行动。

paras.en: He threw fresh logs on the fire, then wound up a music box to set a relaxed mood.
paras.zh: 他往火里添了几根新柴，又上紧一个八音盒的发条，营造出轻松的氛围。

paras.en: He quickly chewed on a mint leaf to freshen his breath while he straightened his shirt and tugged at his collar, making sure his ascot adorned with carrots was perfectly in place.
paras.zh: 他飞快地嚼了片薄荷叶清新口气，同时把衬衫理平、拽了拽衣领，确保那条装饰着胡萝卜的领巾端端正正。

paras.en: Then he did exactly what he had planned to do.
paras.zh: 接着，他照着自己计划好的那样做了。

paras.en: Kristoff pulled the ring out of his pocket and stood behind Anna.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫从口袋里掏出戒指，站到了安娜身后。

paras.en: It seemed like the right time to ask her the one question he’d been waiting to ask.
paras.zh: 这似乎正是时机，可以问出那个他一直等着要问的问题。

paras.en: Just as he opened his mouth… “Did Elsa seem weird to you?” Anna asked, her back still to him.
paras.zh: 就在他张开嘴的一刻……“你觉不觉得艾莎有点不对劲？”安娜问道，背仍对着他。

paras.en: Kristoff wasn’t sure what she meant. “She seemed like Elsa?” he responded.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫不太确定她是什么意思。“她看起来就像艾莎啊？”他回应道。

paras.en: Then he took a deep breath and got down on one knee. “That last word really seemed to throw her.” Anna bent down to look through the discarded paper clues on the floor. “What was it?” “I don’t know,” Kristoff said in a scratchy voice that didn’t sound familiar.
paras.zh: 接着他深吸一口气，单膝跪下。“最后一个词好像真的把她难住了。”安娜弯下腰，翻看地上丢着的纸条线索。“那是什么词？”“我不知道，”克里斯托夫用一种陌生的沙哑嗓音说。

paras.en: He cleared his throat. “Ahem…” Then, in a deep voice: “I don’t know.
paras.zh: 他清了清嗓子。“咳……”接着，用低沉的声音说：“我不知道。”

paras.en: But, um—” Anna read all the game clues, but none of them seemed to be Elsa’s.
paras.zh: “不过，嗯——”安娜把所有的游戏线索都看了一遍，可没有一张像是艾莎的。

paras.en: Then she saw another, off to the side by the table.
paras.zh: 接着她看见另一张，在桌子旁边落在一边。

paras.en: She reached for it. “Ice?” she said in disbelief. “Oh, come on!” Anna threw her arms out in frustration, making Kristoff jump back in surprise.
paras.zh: 她伸手去拿。“冰？”她难以置信地说。“噢，得了吧！”安娜懊恼地张开双臂，吓得克里斯托夫往后一退。

paras.en: The ring flew out of his hand and slid under the couch.
paras.zh: 戒指从他手中飞了出去，滑到了沙发底下。

paras.en: He dove to get it back. “She couldn’t act out ice ?” Anna asked, confused.
paras.zh: 他扑过去想把戒指捡回来。“她连‘冰’都演不出来？”安娜困惑地问。

paras.en: Even if her sister was the worst charades player in the world, the one word she should have been able to depict was ice. “I better go check on her.” She stood and kissed Kristoff just as he got back on one knee. “Thanks, honey.
paras.zh: 就算妹妹是全天下最不会玩猜词游戏的人，唯一一个她应该能演出来的词也是“冰”。“我还是去瞧瞧她吧。”她站起身，就在克里斯托夫重新单膝跪下时亲了他一下。“谢了，亲爱的。”

paras.en: Love you!” And then she was gone without having seen what he had in his hand.
paras.zh: “爱你哟！”然后她就走了，根本没看到他手里拿着什么。

paras.en: Kristoff held the ring and looked after her.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫握着戒指，目送她离开。

paras.en: He sighed in disappointment. “Love you, too.
paras.zh: 他失望地叹了口气。“也爱你。”

paras.en: It’s fine.” The music box slowly wound down, echoing the deflated mood in the room.
paras.zh: “没关系的。”八音盒缓缓停下，呼应着屋里低落的气氛。

paras.en: Elsa stood at her bedroom window, deep in thought, while the Northern Lights shone blue and green around her.
paras.zh: 艾莎站在卧室窗前，陷入了沉思，北极光照着她，泛出蓝绿的光。

paras.en: She recognized Anna’s special knock on her door, the one her sister had been doing ever since they were children, and smiled. “Come in,” she said.
paras.zh: 她听出了安娜特有的敲门声——那是妹妹从小一直用的那种敲法，便微微一笑。“进来，”她说。

paras.en: Anna noticed something familiar as soon as she walked into the room.
paras.zh: 安娜一走进房间，就注意到一样熟悉的东西。

paras.en: Elsa had their mother’s beautiful burgundy scarf draped around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 艾莎肩上披着母亲那条漂亮的酒红色围巾。

paras.en: It brought back memories of how their mother had always wrapped them in it, held them close, keeping them secure and protected.
paras.zh: 这让她想起母亲总用这条围巾把他们裹起来，紧紧抱在怀里，让他们感到安稳和被保护。

paras.en: Anna remembered the feelings of comfort and of love. “Yep.
paras.zh: 安娜想起了那种安心与关爱的感觉。“没错。”

paras.en: Something’s wrong,” she said.
paras.zh: “不对劲，”她说。

paras.en: Elsa continued to stare out the window as if she were waiting for someone, or something, before she finally turned to look at her sister. “With you?” “No, with you,” Anna said. “You’re wearing Mother’s scarf.
paras.zh: 艾莎继续盯着窗外，仿佛在等着什么人或什么东西，过了好一会儿才转过身看着妹妹。“你？”“不，是你，”安娜说，“你披着妈妈的围巾。”

paras.en: You do that when something’s wrong.” It suddenly hit her and she gasped, realizing what the problem could be. “Did we hurt your feelings?
paras.zh: “你遇到不对劲的事时才会这样。”她猛地反应过来，倒吸一口气，意识到问题可能出在哪。“是我们伤了你的心吗？”

paras.en: I’m so sorry if we did.
paras.zh: “如果是这样，我真的很抱歉。”

paras.en: You know, very few people are actually good at family games.
paras.zh: “你知道，其实没几个人真的擅长家庭游戏。”

paras.en: That’s just a fact.” “No…that’s not it,” Elsa insisted.
paras.zh: “这是事实。”“不……不是因为这个，”艾莎坚持说。

paras.en: She paused, debating whether she should tell her sister about the voice she’d been hearing. “Then what is it?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 她顿了顿，犹豫着要不要把听到的那个声音告诉妹妹。“那到底是怎么了？”安娜问。

paras.en: Elsa hesitated a moment longer, then said, “There’s this…I just don’t want to mess things up.” Anna grabbed Elsa’s hands and led her to the bed to sit down. “What things?” she asked, her eyes full of concern. “You’re doing great!
paras.zh: 艾莎又迟疑了片刻，才说：“是有这么回事……我只是不想把事情搞砸。”安娜握住艾莎的手，带她到床边坐下。“什么事？”她满眼关切地问，“你已经做得很好了！”

paras.en: Oh, Elsa—when are you going to see yourself the way I see you?” Elsa knew her sister was right, and that made her feel good.
paras.zh: “噢，艾莎——你什么时候才能用我看待你的眼光来看自己呢？”艾莎知道妹妹说得对，这让她心里好受了些。

paras.en: She pressed her forehead against Anna’s. “What would I do without you?” Anna knew the answer without thinking about it. “You’ll always have me.” Elsa smiled back at her.
paras.zh: 她把额头抵在安娜的额头上。“要是没有你，我可怎么办？”安娜想都不用想就知道答案。“你永远都有我。”艾莎对她回以微笑。

paras.en: Anna climbed onto the bed and leaned back against the pillows. “I know what you need.
paras.zh: 安娜爬上床，靠在枕头上。“我知道你需要什么。”

paras.en: Come on, come here.” “What?” Elsa asked. “In Mama’s words: ‘Cuddle close…scooch in ,’ ” Anna said.
paras.zh: “来嘛，到这儿来。”“什么？”艾莎问。“用妈妈的话说：‘紧紧抱好……往里挤挤，’”安娜说。

paras.en: Elsa moved next to her sister and let Anna wrap the scarf tightly around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 艾莎挪到妹妹身边，让安娜把围巾紧紧裹在自己肩上。

paras.en: Anna sang the lullaby from their childhood to her, the one that never failed to remind them of their mother.
paras.zh: 安娜给她唱起儿时的摇篮曲，那首总能让他们想起母亲的歌。

paras.en: It had always soothed her sister, and she hoped it still did.
paras.zh: 这首歌一向能让妹妹平静下来，她希望现在依然如此。

paras.en: She rubbed Elsa’s forehead with her finger, like their mother had when they were young. “I know what you’re doing,” Elsa said, even as her eyes blinked sleepily and then closed completely.
paras.zh: 她用指尖轻轻揉着艾莎的额头，就像母亲在他们小时候常做的那样。“我知道你在干什么，”艾莎说着，眼皮却困得直眨，最后完全闭上了。

paras.en: It wasn’t long before she fell asleep.
paras.zh: 没过多久，她就睡着了。

paras.en: Anna smiled; their mother had always known best.
paras.zh: 安娜笑了；母亲永远是最懂他们的。

paras.en: She yawned and stretched her arms up.
paras.zh: 她打了个哈欠，伸长双臂。

paras.en: It was late, and she was tired, too.
paras.zh: 夜已经深了，她自己也累了。

paras.en: Without another thought, she lay down and fell asleep next to her sister.
paras.zh: 想也没多想，她便躺下，在妹妹身旁睡着了。

paras.en: Later that night, dreams filled Elsa’s head.
paras.zh: 那天夜里晚些时候，梦境填满了艾莎的脑海。

paras.en: She was walking through a forest filled with beautiful trees, covered in golden sunshine.
paras.zh: 她正穿过一片森林，美丽的树木沐浴在金色的阳光里。

paras.en: She heard a laugh and saw a young boy and girl playing in a pile of leaves.
paras.zh: 她听见一阵笑声，看见一个小男孩和小女孩在一堆落叶里玩耍。

paras.en: But the leaves they threw hovered high in the air, impossibly high, and they stayed there, not falling.
paras.zh: 可他们抛起的叶子悬在高高的空中，高得不可思议，就那样停在空中，迟迟不落下。

paras.en: A reindeer ran by.
paras.zh: 一头驯鹿从旁边跑过。

paras.en: Whether it was running to something or from something, Elsa couldn’t tell.
paras.zh: 它是奔向什么，还是在躲避什么，艾莎分辨不出。

paras.en: If Anna had been awake, she would have seen that the images from Elsa’s dream were suspended in the air above her sister, made from soft flakes of snow.
paras.zh: 要是安娜醒着，她就会看到，艾莎梦境中的画面正悬在妹妹头顶的空中，是由柔软的雪花凝成的。

paras.en: It was like a memory, playing for Elsa and anyone else in the room.
paras.zh: 那就像一段记忆，在艾莎和屋里其他任何人面前缓缓播放。

paras.en: But Elsa’s dreams had never physically manifested themselves in snow before.
paras.zh: 可艾莎的梦境，还从来没像这样真实地化作雪花显现过。

paras.en: Elsa suddenly woke and sat up, and her dreams dissolved into a snowfall that drifted down and covered the bed.
paras.zh: 艾莎猛地惊醒坐起，她的梦境化作了纷纷飘落的雪花，洒下来覆住了床铺。

paras.en: Where did this come from? she thought.
paras.zh: 这是从哪儿来的？她想。

paras.en: She looked around in the darkness and listened.
paras.zh: 她在黑暗中四下张望，侧耳倾听。

paras.en: At first, she didn’t see or hear anything.
paras.zh: 起初，她既没看见什么，也没听见什么。

paras.en: Then the voice began calling to her in its quiet melody.
paras.zh: 接着，那个声音用轻柔的旋律开始呼唤她。

paras.en: She glanced at Anna, but her sister was sound asleep.
paras.zh: 她瞥了安娜一眼，可妹妹睡得正熟。

paras.en: As quietly as she could, Elsa slipped from the bed and moved quickly to the window, hoping to find something outside that would tell her where the sound was coming from.
paras.zh: 艾莎尽量不发出声响，悄悄溜下床，快步走到窗边，希望在外面找到些什么，好告诉她这声音是从何处而来。

paras.en: She saw nothing out of the ordinary.
paras.zh: 她没看到任何异样。

paras.en: Elsa backed away from the window and out of the room.
paras.zh: 艾莎从窗边退开，走出了房间。

paras.en: The sound had never lasted this long before—it had appeared and disappeared just as quickly.
paras.zh: 这声音以前从没持续这么久——它总是出现得突然，消失得也快。

paras.en: Now it followed her as she raced along the hall.
paras.zh: 可现在，它一路跟着她，在她飞奔过走廊时也不曾离开。

paras.en: Even while looking for its source, she tried to ignore the call and wish it away.
paras.zh: 即便在寻找声源的同时，她也试着不去理会这呼唤，盼着它消失。

paras.en: Everyone she had ever loved was here in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 她所爱的人，全都在阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: She’d already had the biggest adventure of her life and didn’t want to risk following a voice into something unknown that might take them away from her.
paras.zh: 她已经经历过人生中最了不起的冒险，不想再冒险循着一个声音走入未知，怕那会把他们从她身边夺走。

paras.en: She almost managed to convince herself it was just a ringing in her ears.
paras.zh: 她几乎说服了自己，那不过是耳边的嗡鸣。

paras.en: As Elsa opened the castle’s back door and stepped outside, a thought occurred to her.
paras.zh: 艾莎打开城堡的后门走到外面时，忽然冒出一个念头。

paras.en: Maybe the call is coming from someone with magic.
paras.zh: 也许这呼唤来自某个拥有魔法的人。

paras.en: Though she would never admit it, deep down she felt she wasn’t meant to be queen.
paras.zh: 尽管她绝不会承认，但在内心深处，她觉得自己并不适合做女王。

paras.en: Every day, as she felt her power grow stronger, it became a little harder for her to deny her doubts and fears, which grew stronger every day.
paras.zh: 每一天，随着她感到自己的力量愈发强大，她也愈发难以否认那些与日俱增的疑虑与恐惧。

paras.en: Maybe the mysterious voice knew that and wanted to help her.
paras.zh: 也许那个神秘的声音知道这一点，想要帮她。

paras.en: Elsa decided to answer it, echoing its call.
paras.zh: 艾莎决定回应它，应和着它的呼唤。

paras.en: She heard the voice and responded.
paras.zh: 她听见那声音，便作出了回应。

paras.en: Every time it reached for her in song, she answered.
paras.zh: 每一次它用歌声向她伸出手来，她都予以应答。

paras.en: As she walked farther away from the castle, along the outskirts of the village and toward the waters of the fjord, Elsa tentatively used her magic as an answer to the voice.
paras.zh: 她越走离城堡越远，沿着村庄的边缘，朝峡湾的水面走去，艾莎试探着用起魔法，作为对那声音的回应。

paras.en: Power surged from her hands, and she threw snow up into the air.
paras.zh: 力量从她手中涌出，她将雪花抛向空中。

paras.en: The snow formed a forest that was just like the one from her dream— a dream she no longer remembered.
paras.zh: 雪花化作一片森林，和她梦中所见一模一样——那是她已记不起来的一个梦。

paras.en: Elsa walked through the fantastical snowy landscape, creating amazing imagery—a swirling wind full of leaves, a salamander, a water horse, and rock giants.
paras.zh: 艾莎漫步在这奇幻的雪景中，创造出令人惊叹的画面——一阵卷着落叶盘旋的风、一只火蜥蜴、一匹水马，还有岩石巨人。

paras.en: She chased the creatures, fascinated by what her magic had made.
paras.zh: 她追逐着这些生灵，对自己魔法所造之物满心着迷。

paras.en: And the beautifully haunting call led her every step of the way.
paras.zh: 而那优美又撩动心弦的呼唤，一步步引领着她前行。

paras.en: The voice led her farther north.
paras.zh: 那声音引领她继续向北。

paras.en: Elsa used her power to build a hill of ice that jutted into the sky over the fjord.
paras.zh: 艾莎运用魔力，筑起一座冰丘，高高地刺向峡湾上方的天空。

paras.en: As she climbed to the top, the voice began to fade.
paras.zh: 当她爬上顶端，那声音开始渐渐微弱。

paras.en: Elsa realized she didn’t want it to leave her.
paras.zh: 艾莎意识到，她并不想让它离自己而去。

paras.en: She wanted to follow the call into the unknown.
paras.zh: 她想要循着那呼唤，走入未知。

paras.en: She let her arms fall to her sides and looked at the sky, surrendering herself and her power to the voice.
paras.zh: 她任双臂垂落身侧，望向天空，将自己和自己的力量一并交付给那声音。

paras.en: Just then, a wave of magic shot out from her, freezing all the moisture in the air into small crystal symbols that spread across the land.
paras.zh: 就在这时，一股魔力从她身上迸发而出，将空气中的水汽尽数冻成小小的晶体符号，铺展向四面八方。

paras.en: Elsa looked at them in awe.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊叹地望着它们。

paras.en: Each of the crystals had one of four symbols on them, and she recognized them. “Air, fire, water, earth…,” she said aloud.
paras.zh: 每一枚晶体上都印着四种符号之一，而她认得它们。“风、火、水、土……”她大声念道。

paras.en: Something had awakened Anna, and she wasn’t sure what.
paras.zh: 有什么东西惊醒了安娜，可她弄不清是什么。

paras.en: Looking at the bed next to her, she saw that Elsa was gone.
paras.zh: 她看向身旁的床，发现艾莎已经不在了。

paras.en: In her place were soft flakes of freshly fallen snow. “Elsa?” she called.
paras.zh: 取而代之的，是柔软的、刚飘落的雪花。“艾莎？”她唤道。

paras.en: All she heard was silence.
paras.zh: 她听到的只有一片寂静。

paras.en: The light coming in the window seemed different.
paras.zh: 从窗外透进来的光，似乎有些不同。

paras.en: Curious, Anna stepped out onto the balcony, her mother’s scarf wrapped tightly around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 安娜好奇地走到阳台上，母亲的围巾紧紧裹在肩上。

paras.en: The air was full of frozen crystals as far as she could see.
paras.zh: 目之所及，空气里满是冻结的晶体。

paras.en: The crystals refracted the colors from the ­Northern Lights, sending them all around.
paras.zh: 晶体折射着北极光的色彩，将它们洒向四周。

paras.en: She looked in amazement—and then spotted Elsa far away, near the fjord.
paras.zh: 她惊奇地望去——接着远远地望见了艾莎，就在峡湾附近。

paras.en: Just then, a mighty blast of light appeared from the north.
paras.zh: 就在这时，北方亮起一道强烈的强光。

paras.en: The crystals began to fall in a cascade, starting from farthest away, crashing to the ground without mercy.
paras.zh: 晶体开始如瀑布般坠落，从最远处开始，毫不留情地砸向地面。

paras.en: The villagers of Arendelle came to their windows and doors, holding each other close as the ice shattered on the cobblestones in front of their homes.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的村民们来到窗前门口，紧紧依偎着彼此，看着冰碴在自家门前的鹅卵石路上碎裂。

paras.en: And then, one by one, the lanterns around the village went out, leaving the only light to come from the moon.
paras.zh: 接着，村子里的灯笼一盏接一盏地熄灭，只剩下月光作唯一的照明。

paras.en: Anna knew she had to help the villagers.
paras.zh: 安娜知道自己必须去帮村民。

paras.en: Eyes wide, she ran through the darkened castle, stumbling her way around before bursting out the doors right on the heels of Kristoff and Olaf.
paras.zh: 她瞪大双眼，跑过漆黑的城堡，磕磕绊绊地绕来绕去，终于冲出门外，正好紧跟在克里斯托夫和雪宝身后。

paras.en: She didn’t notice the lack of light—she just knew she had to find her sister.
paras.zh: 她没留意光线的消失——她只知道，自己必须找到姐姐。

paras.en: Running toward the fjord, Anna saw the water fountains drying up.
paras.zh: 朝峡湾跑去时，安娜看见喷泉渐渐干涸。

paras.en: She tried to make sense of it.
paras.zh: 她努力想弄明白这是怎么回事。

paras.en: The villagers tried, too, opening their doors to look for answers as she passed by.
paras.zh: 村民们也在努力，她路过时，他们打开门探出身来寻找答案。

paras.en: The wind whipped up and banged open shutters and windows.
paras.zh: 狂风骤起，砰地撞开了百叶窗和窗户。

paras.en: It was so strong, people were pushed from their homes and onto the streets.
paras.zh: 风势如此之猛，把人们从家里推到了街上。

paras.en: Anna, Kristoff, and Olaf did what they could to help, but they, too, were being blown across the streets and toward the bridge.
paras.zh: 安娜、克里斯托夫和雪宝尽力帮忙，可他们自己也被风刮过街道，吹向那座桥。

paras.en: In the stables, Sven watched all the water disappear from his trough and those of the other animals.
paras.zh: 在马厩里，斯文望着自己和其他牲口的饮水槽里的水全都消失了。

paras.en: He looked up and gave a confused grunt when a gust of wind blew the double doors in and they slammed against the wall.
paras.zh: 一阵狂风把对开的门板吹得撞向墙壁，他抬起头，困惑地哼了一声。

paras.en: Then he pushed his stall door open with his antlers and headed out to the village.
paras.zh: 接着，他用鹿角顶开圈门，朝村子走去。

paras.en: It was time to find Kristoff and the others.
paras.zh: 是时候去找克里斯托夫和其他人了。

paras.en: Elsa, who had raced back to the castle once the ice crystals had started falling, stopped suddenly. “The air rages, no fire, no water…the earth is next.
paras.zh: 艾莎在冰晶开始坠落时已飞奔回城堡，这时她忽然停住脚步。“空气在咆哮，没有火，没有水……接下来是土。

paras.en: We have to get out.” And just like that, the cobblestones began to ripple like wheat in a breeze and shuttled people down the village streets. “We’re being pushed out!” a villager shouted.
paras.zh: 我们得离开。”话音刚落，鹅卵石路面便像微风中的麦浪般起伏起来，把人们顺着村街推搡着送走。“我们被赶出去了！”一个村民喊道。

paras.en: His body was forced up a path that led to the cliffs.
paras.zh: 他的身体被推上一条通往悬崖的小路。

paras.en: Elsa ran deeper into the village to help the people of Arendelle get to safety. “It’ll be okay!” she shouted. “Evacuate to the cliffs!” “Oh, no!” Olaf yelled as he tried to hold on to a pole on the bridge. “I’m gonna blow!” Kristoff grabbed Olaf and as many children as he could just as Sven walked up.
paras.zh: 艾莎往村子更深处跑去，帮助阿伦黛尔的百姓转移到安全地带。“没事的！”她喊道。“撤到悬崖上去！” “哦，不！”雪宝一边拼命抓住桥上的一根柱子，一边大叫。“我快被吹散啦！”克里斯托夫一把抓住雪宝和尽可能多的孩子，正巧斯文走了过来。

paras.en: Kristoff had never been more grateful to see his best friend.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫从没像此刻这样，见到挚友这般庆幸。

paras.en: He placed his load on the reindeer’s back. “I’ve got you.
paras.zh: 他把怀里的一堆“货物”放到驯鹿背上。“我抓到你了。

paras.en: Wow, you’re heavy,” he said to Olaf.
paras.zh: 哇，你可真沉。”他对雪宝说。

paras.en: He nodded to the cliffs, where the others were gathering.
paras.zh: 他朝悬崖方向点了点头，其他人正聚在那里。

paras.en: Sven grunted and headed off.
paras.zh: 斯文哼了一声，迈步出发了。

paras.en: The parents of the children who rode on him followed right behind, refusing to lose track of them.
paras.zh: 骑在他背上的那些孩子的父母紧随其后，不肯跟丢孩子们。

paras.en: Anna joined Elsa and the others, helping to make sure everyone got out of the village safely.
paras.zh: 安娜赶上艾莎和众人，帮忙确保每个人都安全离开了村子。

paras.en: She couldn’t leave anyone behind in these dangerous conditions.
paras.zh: 在这般危险的境况下，她不能把任何人丢下。

paras.en: Kristoff called to the sisters to lead their people, because the Arendellians needed them.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫呼唤姐妹俩去带领她们的百姓，因为阿伦黛尔人需要她们。

paras.en: He stayed in the rear, aiding those who couldn’t keep up.
paras.zh: 他留在队伍后头，帮扶那些跟不上的人。

paras.en: Working together, Anna and Elsa finally got everyone to the top of the cliffs over the fjord.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎齐心协力，终于把所有人带到了峡湾上方悬崖的顶端。

paras.en: When Anna looked back for Kristoff, she was happy to see that he was near.
paras.zh: 安娜回头找克里斯托夫时，高兴地看到他就在近旁。

paras.en: Behind him, the Arendelle flag that always flew at the center of the village was ripped off its pole by the violent wind.
paras.zh: 在他身后，那面一向飘在村子中央的阿伦黛尔旗帜，被狂暴的风从旗杆上扯了下来。

paras.en: And as Anna gasped in surprise, the wind suddenly died.
paras.zh: 安娜惊讶地倒吸一口气，风却忽然停了。

paras.en: Everything went silent.
paras.zh: 万籁俱寂。

paras.en: The villagers formed small groups, whispering, shaking their heads, and patting backs as they comforted each other.
paras.zh: 村民们分成一个个小群，低声交谈、摇着头、拍拍彼此的背，互相安慰着。

paras.en: Children huddled close to their parents as everyone tried to make sense of what had just happened.
paras.zh: 孩子们紧紧依偎在父母身边，所有人都努力想弄明白刚才发生了什么。

paras.en: One half-asleep villager looked around in confusion, wondering why he was no longer in his bed but was instead standing on top of a cliff.
paras.zh: 一个半睡半醒的村民困惑地四处张望，弄不懂自己怎么不在床上，却站到了悬崖顶上。

paras.en: He blinked sleepily as Olaf and some of the Arendellian children twirled by, spun by the wind and covered in the ice crystals that had just fallen from the sky.
paras.zh: 他睡眼惺忪地眨着眼，这时雪宝和几个阿伦黛尔孩子被风卷着打着转儿经过，身上沾满了刚从天上落下的冰晶。

paras.en: The villager shook his head, thinking he was quite possibly having the weirdest dream he’d ever had.
paras.zh: 那村民摇了摇头，心想自己这会儿做的，大概是有生以来最离奇的一个梦。

paras.en: The sound of Sven’s hoofs on the stones of the cliff’s path announced his and Kristoff’s arrival.
paras.zh: 斯文的蹄子踏在悬崖小路的石子上，发出声响，宣告了他和克里斯托夫的到来。

paras.en: The reindeer’s back was piled high with blankets, which Kristoff passed out as the two comforted the villagers. “Yes, everyone’s out and safe,” he assured an older woman as he pressed a warm woolen shawl in her hands. “Take one of these.” As the duo made their way around the groups, they passed Olaf, who sat on the ground surrounded by children.
paras.zh: 驯鹿背上高高堆着毯子，克里斯托夫一边和老人安抚村民，一边把毯子分发出去。“是的，大家都撤出来了，都很安全，”他向一位老妇人保证道，把一条温暖的羊毛披肩塞进她手里。“拿一条这个吧。”两人绕着人群走动时，经过了雪宝——他坐在地上，被孩子们围在中间。

paras.en: The kids laughed as they found Elsa’s fallen ice crystals and pressed them into Olaf’s snow body.
paras.zh: 孩子们笑着捡起艾莎掉落的冰晶，把它们按进雪宝的雪身体里。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven shared a puzzled glance when they saw his bizarre decorations. “You okay, there, Olaf?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文看到他那副怪模样，交换了一个困惑的眼神。“你还好吧，雪宝？”克里斯托夫问道。

paras.en: The snowman nodded. “We’re calling this controlling what you can when things feel out of control.” Kristoff nodded.
paras.zh: 雪人点了点头。“我们管这叫‘在一切失控时，把控住你能把控的’。”克里斯托夫也点了点头。

paras.en: It seemed logical.
paras.zh: 这听起来颇有道理。

paras.en: Raised voices made him turn his head.
paras.zh: 一阵拔高的说话声让他转过头去。

paras.en: He saw Anna and Elsa standing close together, and neither looked happy.
paras.zh: 他看见安娜和艾莎并肩站着，两人看起来都不太高兴。

paras.en: He was torn between joining the sisters and giving them space. “Okay, I don’t understand—you have been hearing a voice and didn’t think to tell me?” asked Anna.
paras.zh: 他拿不准是该凑过去，还是给姐妹俩留点空间。“好吧，我真不明白——你一直听见一个声音，却没想到告诉我？”安娜问道。

paras.en: Elsa cheeks colored.
paras.zh: 艾莎的脸泛红了。

paras.en: She felt ashamed for keeping her secret. “I didn’t want to worry you,” she said. “We made a promise not to shut each other out,” Anna reminded her. “Just tell me—what’s going on?” Elsa sighed, and then blurted out, “I woke the magical spirts of the Enchanted Forest.” At a loss for words, Anna could only stare at her sister as Kristoff and Sven slowly approached. “Okay, that’s definitely not what I thought you were going to say,” Anna said, searching her memories. “The Enchanted Forest?
paras.zh: 她为自己瞒着这个秘密而感到羞愧。“我不想让你担心，”她说。“我们答应过彼此，不再把对方关在门外的，”安娜提醒她。“就告诉我——到底怎么回事？”艾莎叹了口气，终于脱口而出：“我惊醒了魔法森林里那些有魔力的精灵。”安娜一时语塞，只能盯着姐姐，克里斯托夫和斯文则缓缓走近。“好吧，这绝对不是我以为你要说的话，”安娜搜肠刮肚地回想，“魔法森林？

paras.en: The one Father warned us about?” “Yes,” Elsa said, nodding. “Why would you do that?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: 就是父王警告过我们的那个？”“是的，”艾莎点点头说。“你为什么要那么做？”安娜问。

paras.en: Nothing about the night was making sense. “Because of the voice,” Elsa said. “I know it sounds crazy, but I believe whoever is calling me is good.” Anna glanced sharply at her sister. “How can you say that?” she demanded, throwing an arm out toward the dark and empty village. “Look at our kingdom.” Elsa sighed.
paras.zh: 这一夜没有一件事说得通。“因为那个声音，”艾莎说。“我知道这听起来很疯狂，但我相信，呼唤我的那个人是善良的。”安娜锐利地瞥了姐姐一眼。“你怎么能这么说？”她逼问，朝漆黑空荡的村子扬了扬手臂。“看看我们的王国。”艾莎叹了口气。

paras.en: She understood what Anna was saying, but deep inside she somehow knew the voice meant them no harm. “It’s just that my magic can feel it.
paras.zh: 她明白安娜的意思，但在内心深处，她莫名地知道那声音对他们并无恶意。“只是我的魔法能感觉到它。

paras.en: I can feel it .” Anna stared at her sister.
paras.zh: 我能感觉到它。”安娜盯着姐姐。

paras.en: Her emotions wavered as many questions ran through her head.
paras.zh: 无数疑问在她脑海中翻涌，她的情绪起伏不定。

paras.en: But they all led to the same conclusion: her sister would do the right thing. “Okay,” she said.
paras.zh: 但这些疑问最终都指向同一个结论：姐姐会做正确的事。“好吧，”她说。

paras.en: Elsa smiled, grateful once again that Anna believed in her.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了，再次为安娜对自己的信任而心怀感激。

paras.en: Rocks began to dance on the ground just then, and the villagers panicked.
paras.zh: 就在这时，地面上的石头开始跳起舞来，村民们顿时惊慌失措。

paras.en: It was the second time in one night that their world had been shaken. “Oh, no,” said Anna. “What now?” But Kristoff knew that this movement was far different from what had happened before. “Trolls?” he asked in surprise.
paras.zh: 这是同一个夜晚里，他们的世界第二次被撼动了。“哦，不，”安娜说，“又怎么了？”但克里斯托夫知道，这次的晃动和之前发生过的完全不同。“是巨魔？”他惊讶地问道。

paras.en: He rushed to the mountain pass just as a bunch of familiar-looking boulders tumbled through.
paras.zh: 他冲到山口，正好撞见一堆看着眼熟的巨石滚了过来。

paras.en: The boulders rolled toward Elsa and Anna and popped open to reveal mountain trolls.
paras.zh: 巨石朝艾莎和安娜滚去，随后啪地裂开，露出了里面的山巨魔。

paras.en: They were thrilled to see Kristoff and Sven and jumped onto the two of them, knocking Kristoff over in their excitement. “Kristoff!” said Bulda, the troll who had raised Kristoff since he was very young. “We missed you!” “Grand Pabbie!” Elsa said, recognizing the wise leader of the mountain trolls as he rolled right up to her. “Well, never a dull moment with you two.
paras.zh: 看到克里斯托夫和斯文，它们兴奋极了，一下子扑到两人身上，把克里斯托夫撞翻在地。“克里斯托夫！”布尔达喊道——她是从克里斯托夫很小的时候起就把他带大的巨魔——“我们好想你！”“帕比长老！”艾莎说道，认出了那位睿智的山巨魔首领，他正滚到她跟前。“唉，有你们俩在，日子可从来都不平淡。”

paras.en: I hope you are prepared for what you have done, Elsa.
paras.zh: 艾莎，我希望你已经做好面对自己所造成这一切的准备。

paras.en: Angry magical spirits are not for the faint of heart,” the elder troll said. “Why are they still angry?” she asked.
paras.zh: 愤怒的魔法精灵可不是胆小的人能对付的，”年长的巨魔说，“他们为什么还在生气？”她问道。

paras.en: They couldn’t possibly still be mad over what had happened when Anna and Elsa’s father was a child—or could they? “What does this have to do with Arendelle?” “Hmm,” Grand Pabbie mused. “Let me see what I can see.” Grand Pabbie turned his gaze up to the sky.
paras.zh: 他们不可能还在为安娜和艾莎父亲小时候发生的事生气——还是说，他们真是这样？“这和阿伦黛尔有什么关系？”“嗯，”帕比长老若有所思地说，“让我看看我能看到些什么。”帕比长老抬起目光，望向天空。

paras.en: He waved his hands, stirring the Northern Lights into motion. “The past is not what it seems.
paras.zh: 他挥动双手，搅动起北极光，让它流动起来。“过去并不像看上去的那样。

paras.en: A wrong demands to be righted; the truth must be found.
paras.zh: 过错必须被纠正；真相必须被寻得。

paras.en: Without it…I see no future.” The words worried Anna. “No future?” Grand Pabbie lowered his hands and let the sky return to its normal patterns.
paras.zh: 没有它……我看不到未来。”这番话让安娜忧心忡忡。“没有未来？”帕比长老放下双手，让天空恢复了原本的模样。

paras.en: He focused on Elsa, concern in his eyes. “When one can see no future, all one can do is the next right thing.” “The next right thing is for me to go to the Enchanted Forest and find that voice,” said Elsa with resolve. “Kristoff, can I borrow your wagon…and Sven?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 他注视着艾莎，眼中满是担忧。“当一个人看不到未来时，他所能做的，只有眼下正确的事。”“眼下正确的事，就是去魔法森林，找到那个声音，”艾莎坚定地说，“克里斯托夫，我能借用你的马车……还有斯文吗？”艾莎问道。

paras.en: Kristoff raised an eyebrow. “I’m not very comfortable with the idea of that.” Anna refused to let Elsa go by herself. “You are not going alone,” she insisted.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫挑了挑眉。“这个主意让我不太放心。”安娜绝不让艾莎一个人去。“你不能自己去，”她坚持道。

paras.en: Elsa shook her head. “Anna, I have my powers to protect me.
paras.zh: 艾莎摇了摇头。“安娜，我有我的魔力保护我。

paras.en: You don’t.” “Wait, what, excuse me, pardon?” Anna asked, putting her hands on her hips and staring directly at her sister. “If I recall, your powers have mostly just gotten you into trouble.
paras.zh: 你没有。”“等等，什么，不好意思，你说什么？”安娜双手叉腰，直直地盯着姐姐，问道，“如果我没记错，你的魔力大多只是给你惹麻烦。

paras.en: Protecting you has been my job.” Grand Pabbie nodded in agreement. “She does have a point.” Anna smiled at the troll. “Thank you.” Then she turned to her sister. “I’m coming.” Kristoff chose that moment to enter the conversation. “Me too,” he added, not wanting to be left out of an adventure. “I’ll drive.” “I’ll bring the snacks!” Olaf said as the wind twirled him past them, the crystals that clung to him sparkling in the moonlight.
paras.zh: 保护你一直是我的职责。”帕比长老点头表示赞同。“她说的也有道理。”安娜对巨魔笑了笑。“谢谢你。”然后她转向姐姐。“我要一起去。”克里斯托夫挑了这时插话。“我也去，”他补了一句，不想被落在这场冒险之外，“我来赶车。”“我来带零食！”雪宝叫道，风托着他从他们身边打着旋儿飞过，身上附着的冰晶在月光下闪闪发亮。

paras.en: Elsa was reluctant to accept, but as she looked between Anna and Kristoff, she knew her only choice was to agree.
paras.zh: 艾莎本不情愿答应，但当她在安娜和克里斯托夫之间看来看去时，她知道自己别无选择，只能同意。

paras.en: She nodded before turning to Grand Pabbie. “Will you look after our people?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 她点了点头，然后转向帕比长老。“您愿意照看我们的百姓吗？”艾莎问道。

paras.en: She was eager to leave and make the kingdom safe again, but was concerned for what the villagers would do until that happened. “Of course,” Grand Pabbie said. “Please make sure they stay out of the kingdom until we return,” Anna added. “Thank you,” Elsa said, trusting the wise troll with the lives of her people the way her parents had trusted him with the life of her sister. “Let’s let them know,” she said to Kristoff, and the two of them rushed to tell everyone the news.
paras.zh: 她急着出发，好让王国重归安宁，却又担心村民们在那之前会做什么。“当然，”帕比长老说。“请务必让他们待在王国之外，直到我们回来，”安娜补充道。“谢谢你，”艾莎说，她像父母曾把妹妹的生命托付给这位巨魔一样，将百姓的安危也托付给了这位睿智的巨魔。“我们去通知大家吧，”她对克里斯托夫说，两人便急忙跑去把这个消息告诉大家。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie motioned for Anna to move close to him. “Anna, I am worried for her.
paras.zh: 帕比长老示意安娜靠近些。“安娜，我很为她担心。

paras.en: We have always feared Elsa’s powers were too much for this world.
paras.zh: 我们一直都担心，艾莎的魔力对这个世间而言太过强大。

paras.en: Now we must pray they are enough.” Anna nodded, unable to conceal the worry on her own face. “I won’t let anything happen to her.”
paras.zh: 如今我们只能祈祷，它们足够应付。”“我不会让任何事伤害到她。”安娜点点头，脸上掩不住的担忧。

paras.en: Early the next morning, as the sunrise painted the fjords of Arendelle in warm colors, Elsa, Anna, Olaf, Kristoff, and Sven set out on their journey. “Hyah!” Kristoff called, holding Sven’s reins.
paras.zh: 第二天清晨，日出将阿伦黛尔的峡湾染上温暖的色彩，艾莎、安娜、雪宝、克里斯托夫和斯文踏上了旅途。“驾！”克里斯托夫握着斯文的缰绳喊道。

paras.en: The reindeer trotted forward, pulling the wagon with the rest of the group in it.
paras.zh: 驯鹿小跑着向前，拉着载着其余伙伴的马车。

paras.en: Olaf broke the silence, not realizing that everyone was lost in their own thoughts of what might happen during their travels. “Who’s into trivia?” he asked gleefully.
paras.zh: 雪宝打破了沉默——他没意识到大家都沉浸在旅途可能遭遇种种的思绪里。“谁喜欢冷知识？”他兴冲冲地问。

paras.en: No one answered, so he responded to himself. “I am!
paras.zh: 没人回答，于是他自问自答。“我呀！

paras.en: Okay!” Anna caught Elsa’s eye across the snowman’s head.
paras.zh: 好呀！”安娜隔着雪宝的头顶，和艾莎对上了眼神。

paras.en: They smiled at each other and settled in for the trip, listening to Olaf spout off his fun facts.
paras.zh: 她们相视一笑，安下心来准备赶路，听着雪宝滔滔不绝地讲起他那些有趣的小知识。

paras.en: He had always been interested in unusual tidbits of information, but ever since he’d learned to read, his interest had grown tremendously. “Did you know that water has memory?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他向来对稀奇古怪的小知识感兴趣，而自从学会阅读后，这份兴趣更是与日俱增。“你们知道吗，水是有记忆的？”他问。

paras.en: His friends found some of his facts to be interesting, but some were just plain strange. “Did you know…gorillas burp when they are happy?” Olaf chirped.
paras.zh: 他的朋友们觉得他讲的一些知识挺有意思，但有些实在古怪得离谱。“你们知道吗……大猩猩开心的时候会打嗝？”雪宝叽叽喳喳地说。

paras.en: As the miles and hours went by, they passed the sparkling waterfalls in the mountains around the fjord as the sun beat down on them from its highest point of the day.
paras.zh: 随着路程和时光一点点流逝，他们经过峡湾群山间闪闪发亮的小瀑布，头顶的太阳正高悬在一天中最高的位置，炙烤着他们。

paras.en: Olaf continued with his never-ending list of facts.
paras.zh: 雪宝还在没完没了地讲着他那串知识。

paras.en: This time when Elsa caught Anna’s glance, they both slowly shook their heads and rolled their eyes.
paras.zh: 这回艾莎和安娜目光相遇时，两人都缓缓摇了摇头，翻了个白眼。

paras.en: When the sun began to set, they finally reached the magnificent ice palace Elsa had built for herself.
paras.zh: 太阳开始西沉时，他们终于抵达了艾莎为自己建造的宏伟冰宫。

paras.en: The sisters stared at it, remembering Elsa’s coronation day three years before.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩凝望着它，想起了三年前艾莎加冕的那一天。

paras.en: When Anna had approached her sister and asked for her blessing to marry Hans, she and Elsa had fought.
paras.zh: 当时安娜走近姐姐，请求她祝福自己嫁给汉斯，她和艾莎却吵了一架。

paras.en: Elsa had found it ridiculous that Anna wanted to marry a man she had just met.
paras.zh: 艾莎觉得，安娜想嫁给一个才刚认识的男人，简直荒唐。

paras.en: And because of that, Elsa’s magical secret, which she had worked so hard to keep hidden, was revealed during their spat, when Anna accidentally pulled off one of Elsa’s gloves and ice shot from her hand.
paras.zh: 也正因如此，艾莎费尽心思隐藏的魔法秘密，在那场争吵中暴露了——安娜不小心扯下了艾莎的一只手套，冰霜便从她手中迸射而出。

paras.en: Anna had felt so lost when Elsa ran off.
paras.zh: 艾莎跑掉时，安娜感到无比迷茫。

paras.en: But she didn’t blame Elsa.
paras.zh: 但她并没有责怪艾莎。

paras.en: If she had been accused of sorcery by the Duke of Weselton, Anna probably would have run away, too.
paras.zh: 如果换作自己被韦塞尔顿公爵指责施展妖术，安娜大概也会逃走的。

paras.en: But Anna didn’t care if her sister could freeze things, or even if she could set things on fire.
paras.zh: 但安娜不在乎姐姐能不能冰冻万物，甚至也不在乎她能不能点燃东西。

paras.en: She had just wanted to be with her and for the two of them to be sisters again.
paras.zh: 她只是想陪在姐姐身边，想让她们俩重新做回姐妹。

paras.en: Instead, all she could feel was the hurt that had consumed her after calling out to Elsa as her sister ran farther and farther away.
paras.zh: 相反，她满心都是那样的伤痛——当姐姐越跑越远，她朝艾莎呼喊，那份痛楚将她彻底吞没。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t imagine how lonely and afraid Elsa had been, too.
paras.zh: 安娜无法想象，艾莎当时又是多么孤独和害怕。

paras.en: As Elsa stared at her beautiful ice palace, her thoughts also returned to that day.
paras.zh: 艾莎凝望着自己美丽的冰宫，思绪也同样回到了那一天。

paras.en: She remembered how scared she’d been—scared she would hurt Anna and others with her power if she stayed, and scared that her people would think she was a monster once they saw what her powers could do.
paras.zh: 她记得自己当时有多害怕——害怕若留下来，会用魔力伤害安娜和他人；也害怕百姓一旦见识了她的力量，会把她当成怪物。

paras.en: She had held back tears as Anna called her name.
paras.zh: 当安娜呼唤她的名字时，她强忍着泪水。

paras.en: She knew her sister had wanted her to come back.
paras.zh: 她知道，妹妹是希望她回来的。

paras.en: But all Elsa could think about in that moment was running as far away from Arendelle as possible so she could protect Anna, like she’d always tried to do.
paras.zh: 但那一刻，艾莎满脑子只想着尽可能远远地逃离阿伦黛尔，好去保护安娜——就像她一直努力做的那样。

paras.en: Elsa’s confidence had grown when she realized the full extent of what she could do with her magic.
paras.zh: 当艾莎意识到自己魔法的全部潜能时，她的自信也增长了。

paras.en: It wasn’t until after Anna had sacrificed herself for Elsa, because of the true love she felt for her sister, that Elsa finally embraced the truth.
paras.zh: 直到安娜因为对妹妹的真爱而甘愿为艾莎牺牲自己之后，艾莎才终于接受了真相。

paras.en: Her magic wasn’t a curse.
paras.zh: 她的魔法不是诅咒。

paras.en: It wasn’t meant to hurt people.
paras.zh: 它本不是用来伤害人的。

paras.en: Elsa could do more than build snowmen and make beautiful icy patterns.
paras.zh: 艾莎能做的，远不止堆雪人和勾勒美丽的冰纹。

paras.en: She had constructed a magnificent ice palace that still stood strong today.
paras.zh: 她建起了一座宏伟的冰宫，至今依然傲然屹立。
