paras.en: Her magic was, and always had been, a gift.
paras.zh: 她的魔法，向来、且一直都是一份礼物。

paras.en: Olaf’s giggle pulled Elsa out of her memories. “Did you know men are six times more likely to be struck by lightning?” the snowman told whoever was still listening. “Sorry, Kristoff.” They kept going, over the ridge beyond the ice palace, farther north than they had ever gone before.
paras.zh: 雪宝的咯咯笑声把艾莎从回忆里拉了出来。“你们知道吗，男人被闪电击中的概率要高出六倍？”雪人冲着还在听的人说道，“抱歉，克里斯托夫。”他们继续向前，越过冰宫之外的山脊，朝着比以往任何时候都更靠北的地方走去。

paras.en: “Did you know we blink four million times a day?” Olaf blurted out. “Did you know wombats poop squares?
paras.zh: “你们知道吗，我们一天要眨四百万人次眼？”雪宝脱口而出，“你们知道吗，袋熊拉出来的屎是方形的？

paras.en: Did you know donkeys sink but mules don’t?” Kristoff didn’t mind that Olaf was full of facts, but his head was about to explode from all the talking.
paras.zh: “你们知道吗，驴子会沉下去，骡子却不会？”克里斯托夫倒不介意雪宝满肚子都是冷知识，但他脑子里快要被这些话炸开了。

paras.en: So he jumped in when Olaf took a breath. “Did you know sleeping quietly on long journeys prevents insanity?” Olaf thought about it. “That doesn’t sound true.” Elsa, Anna, and Sven immediately agreed with Kristoff, nodding vigorously. “It’s true,” said Anna. “It’s absolutely true,” said Elsa. “Gruunnt,” said Sven.
paras.zh: 于是趁着雪宝换气的空当，他赶紧插话：“你们知道吗，长途旅行时安安静静睡觉能防止发疯？”雪宝想了想说：“这听起来不像真的。”艾莎、安娜和斯文立刻附和克里斯托夫，使劲点头。“是真的，”安娜说。“绝对是真的，”艾莎说。“咕噜——”斯文也叫了一声。

paras.en: The snowman shrugged. “Well, that was unanimous, but I will look it up when I get home.” He lay back in the hay and watched as Elsa created an ice blanket for him.
paras.zh: 雪人耸了耸肩：“好吧，算是全票通过了，不过等我回到家要查查资料。”他仰面躺进干草里，看着艾莎为他变出一条冰毯子。

paras.en: She placed it over him, making sure he was completely covered.
paras.zh: 她把毯子盖在他身上，确保把他盖得严严实实。

paras.en: Then she kissed him on his forehead. “Good night,” she said.
paras.zh: 接着她在他额头上亲了一下。“晚安，”她说。

paras.en: After tucking the blanket under his chin, Olaf finally went to sleep.
paras.zh: 雪宝把毯子掖到下巴底下，终于睡着了。

paras.en: Elsa began to yawn when she saw Olaf snuggled in so cozily.
paras.zh: 艾莎看到雪宝蜷缩得那么舒服，自己也打起了哈欠。

paras.en: It had been a long night for everyone.
paras.zh: 对大家来说，这真是一个漫长的夜晚。

paras.en: She pulled her mother’s scarf out of Anna’s bag and wrapped it around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 她从安娜的包里取出母亲的围巾，披在自己的肩上。

paras.en: Then she nestled down in the hay and drifted to sleep next to her friend.
paras.zh: 然后她钻进干草堆，在朋友身旁慢慢进入了梦乡。

paras.en: Anna took the opportunity to climb from the back of the wagon up to the front bench and sit with Kristoff. “They’re both asleep,” she reported.
paras.zh: 安娜趁机从马车后车厢爬到前座长椅上，挨着克里斯托夫坐下。“他们俩都睡着了，”她报告说。

paras.en: She straightened her clothes, pulled hay from her hair, and checked to make sure her breath smelled fresh. “So, what do you want to do?” She snuggled up against him.
paras.zh: 她理了理衣服，从头发里揪出干草，还确认了一下自己口气清新。“那么，你想做些什么？”她依偎到他身边。

paras.en: Kristoff grinned. “I can think of something,” he said, tossing the reins to Sven before digging in his pocket. “Sven, keep us steady, will yah?
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫咧嘴一笑。“我倒能想到一件事，”他说着把缰绳丢给斯文，手伸进兜里掏着。“斯文，帮我们稳住车子，行不？”

paras.en: Sven’s gait changed to a romantic little prance as he grunted his support.
paras.zh: 斯文哼了一声表示支持，脚步也变成了一副浪漫的小碎步。

paras.en: Anna smiled, closing her eyes as she pursed her lips together and leaned in to Kristoff for a kiss.
paras.zh: 安娜微笑着闭上眼睛，嘟起嘴唇，倾身向克里斯托夫凑过去要亲吻。

paras.en: But Kristoff was so nervous, he missed her cue. “Anna.
paras.zh: 可克里斯托夫太紧张了，没接住她的暗示。“安娜。

paras.en: Ahem.” He cleared his throat and tried again. “Anna, remember our first trip like this, when I said you’d have to be crazy to want to marry a man you just met?” Anna’s eyes widened and she scooted far enough down the front bench that Marshmallow could have sat between them. “Wait, what?” she asked. “Crazy?
paras.zh: 咳咳。”他清了清嗓子，重新试了一次。“安娜，还记得我们第一次这样的旅行吗？当时我说，想嫁给一个刚认识的男人，你一定是疯了？”安娜瞪大了眼睛，在前座长椅上往远处挪了挪，挪得都能让棉花糖坐到他们中间了。“等等，你说什么？”她问。“疯了？

paras.en: You didn’t say I was crazy.
paras.zh: 你没说过我疯了。

paras.en: You think I’m crazy?” “No, I did.
paras.zh: 你觉得我疯了？”“不，我确实说过。

paras.en: You were…” He tried to explain, but stopped short at Sven’s warning grunt.
paras.zh: 你是……”他想要解释，却被斯文一声警告般的哼叫打断了。

paras.en: Kristoff wanted to save the moment, to bring it back on course.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫想把这一刻挽救回来，把气氛拉回正轨。

paras.en: He couldn’t mess this up again. “Not crazy, clearly,” he said dramatically. “Ha, just naive. ” But apparently being naive was even more offensive to Anna.
paras.zh: 他不能再搞砸了。“不疯，显然不疯，”他夸张地说，“哈，只是有点天真。”但显然，“天真”这个词更让安娜生气。

paras.en: She crossed her arms over her chest, leaned back in the seat, and gave Kristoff a long look.
paras.zh: 她双手抱在胸前，靠回座位上，久久地盯着克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Feeling confused, Kristoff glanced at Sven, who was shaking his head in dismay.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫一头雾水，瞥了斯文一眼，只见斯文正沮丧地摇着头。

paras.en: Kristoff scrambled for words to dig himself out of the ditch he had tumbled into. “Not naive.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫手忙脚乱地找词儿，想把自己从跌进去的坑里爬出来。“不是天真。

paras.en: Just new…to love.
paras.zh: 只是对……爱情还陌生。

paras.en: Like I was.
paras.zh: 就像我以前一样。

paras.en: And when you’re new, you’re bound to get it wrong,” he finished with confidence.
paras.zh: 而一个人刚开始的时候，难免会出错，”他自信地做结。

paras.en: But that confidence quickly deflated. “So you’re saying I’m wrong for you?” Anna asked, one eyebrow raised. “What?” Kristoff asked in alarm. “No.
paras.zh: 但这份自信很快泄了气。“所以你是说，我配不上你？”安娜挑起一边眉毛问。“什么？”克里斯托夫慌了，“不。

paras.en: No, no, no.” He took a breath to try to gather his thoughts. “I’m not saying you’re not wrong or crazy.
paras.zh: 不不不。”他深吸一口气，想理清思路。“我不是说你不对，也不是说你疯了。

paras.en: I’m saying that it’s—” Anna and Kristoff were so intent on their conversation that neither saw Elsa wake and sit straight up, her expression serious as she looked around, searching for something. “Kristoff, stop,” she said.
paras.zh: 我是说，这是——”安娜和克里斯托夫太专注于对话，谁也没注意到艾莎醒来，坐得笔直，神情严肃地四下张望，像在找什么。“克里斯托夫，停下，”她说。

paras.en: He reached for the reins and pulled on them as he asked Sven to bring the wagon to a halt. “Good idea,” he mumbled, knowing he had botched his chance to ask Anna to marry him, again. “I hear it.
paras.zh: 他伸手抓住缰绳一拉，让斯文把马车停下。“好主意，”他嘟囔着，明知自己又一次错失了向安娜求婚的机会。“我听见了。

paras.en: I hear the voice,” Elsa said firmly. “You do?” Anna asked, her attention now on her sister. “Olaf, wake up.” Elsa jumped out of the wagon and rushed over to a small rise at the edge of the road.
paras.zh: 我听见那个声音了，”艾莎坚定地说。“真的？”安娜问，注意力这下转到姐姐身上。“雪宝，醒醒。”艾莎跳下马车，冲向路边一个小土坡。

paras.en: What she saw overwhelmed her with emotion.
paras.zh: 眼前的景象让她百感交集。

paras.en: The others joined her and gasped in awe at what lay before them.
paras.zh: 其他人也跟了过来，望着眼前的景象惊叹地倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: The morning light shone on a magical mist that stood like a wall across a wide, flat plain down below them—a wall that barred them from going any farther.
paras.zh: 晨光洒在一片神奇的薄雾上，那雾像一堵墙，横亘在他们下方一片广阔平坦的原野上——一堵挡住他们去路的墙。

paras.en: Elsa wondered if it was the impenetrable mist that surrounded the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 艾莎心想，这会不会就是环绕魔法森林、无法穿透的那片迷雾。

paras.en: Have we finally reached it? she thought.
paras.zh: 我们终于到了吗？她想。

paras.en: It seemed possible.
paras.zh: 看起来有可能。

paras.en: The mist appeared to enshroud a forest of tall trees—the tops of which they saw poking out of the ceiling of the mist.
paras.zh: 迷雾仿佛笼罩着一片高大的树林——他们看见树梢从雾顶探了出来。

paras.en: But everything else in the Enchanted Forest was hidden behind the haze and the rolling particles of colored lights that flashed like lightning bugs as they danced through the mist.
paras.zh: 但魔法森林里其余的一切，都藏在那片朦胧之后，还有翻滚的彩色光点，像萤火虫般在雾中穿梭飞舞、闪烁不停。

paras.en: Elsa’s heart raced, and she couldn’t resist the pull she felt any longer.
paras.zh: 艾莎心跳加速，再也无法抵抗内心那股牵引。

paras.en: She quickly climbed down the side of the cliff, and the others followed.
paras.zh: 她飞快地顺着崖壁爬下去，其他人紧跟在后。

paras.en: Elsa ran across the plain, straight toward the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 艾莎跑过原野，直奔魔法森林。

paras.en: Anna did her best to keep up.
paras.zh: 安娜拼尽全力跟上她。

paras.en: Then Elsa stopped before she reached the cloudlike mass and stared at it in silence.
paras.zh: 跑到那团云状物跟前，艾莎停下脚步，静静地凝视着它。

paras.en: Kristoff was not as patient.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫可没那么有耐心。

paras.en: He walked past the two girls and approached the mist in wonder.
paras.zh: 他从两个女孩身边走过，满心惊奇地走近迷雾。

paras.en: He reached out a hand and pressed it against the gray surface.
paras.zh: 他伸出手，按在灰色的雾面上。

paras.en: His hand sprang back like it had hit a bouncy ball.
paras.zh: 他的手像撞上弹力球一样弹了回来。

paras.en: Olaf watched, fascinated.
paras.zh: 雪宝看得入了迷。

paras.en: What had happened to Kristoff’s hand gave him an idea.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫的手发生的事，给了他一个主意。

paras.en: He took a few steps back and charged at the gray cloud as fast as he could.
paras.zh: 他后退几步，然后使出全力朝那团灰云冲了过去。

paras.en: His body bounced off it as if he were hitting a balloon.
paras.zh: 他的身体像撞上气球一样被弹了回来。

paras.en: He giggled as he flew through the air and landed on the ground.
paras.zh: 他一边在空中飞，一边咯咯笑着，最后落在地上。

paras.en: All this time, he had thought the journey north would be dangerous.
paras.zh: 一直以来，他都以为北行之旅会充满危险。

paras.en: This was fun!
paras.zh: 这可真好玩！

paras.en: Olaf ran at the mist again.
paras.zh: 雪宝又朝迷雾冲了过去。

paras.en: He bounced back again, so he did the only thing he could—he bounced off the mist over and over, laughing hysterically each time.
paras.zh: 他又被弹了回来，于是他只能做唯一能做的事——一遍又一遍地从雾上弹开，每次都笑得前仰后合。

paras.en: Anna moved to stand next to Elsa as they stared at the rolling mist.
paras.zh: 安娜走到艾莎身边，两人一起盯着翻滚的迷雾。

paras.en: Elsa took a deep breath and grabbed Anna’s hand for strength, and the two of them approached.
paras.zh: 艾莎深吸一口气，握住安娜的手给自己打气，姐妹俩一起走上前去。

paras.en: For them, the mist sparkled and pulled back, revealing four towering stones with a symbol at the top of each one. “Air, fire, water, earth,” Elsa said, naming each one and knowing they were the same symbols she had seen on the ice crystals in the sky.
paras.zh: 对他们来说，迷雾闪着光往后退去，露出四块高耸的巨石，每块顶端都有一个符号。“风、火、水、土，”艾莎一边逐一念出，一边认出这正是她在天上冰晶上见过的符号。

paras.en: With every step they took, the mist parted further to let them through.
paras.zh: 他们每往前走一步，迷雾就分得更开，好让他们通过。

paras.en: Sven trailed after them and called out for Kristoff.
paras.zh: 斯文跟在他们身后，呼唤着克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Kristoff saw that the curtain of clouds had parted.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看到那道云帘已经分开。

paras.en: He caught Olaf’s attention, and they walked up behind the sisters with Sven. “Promise me—we’ll do this together,” Anna said to Elsa. “I promise,” Elsa agreed.
paras.zh: 他引起雪宝的注意，和斯文一起走到姐妹俩身后。“答应我——我们一起走，”安娜对艾莎说。“我答应你，”艾莎应道。

paras.en: Kristoff grabbed Anna’s hand and put an arm around Sven.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫握住安娜的手，一只胳膊搂住斯文。

paras.en: Olaf grabbed Elsa’s hand.
paras.zh: 雪宝抓住艾莎的手。

paras.en: As they all walked farther inside the mist together, it closed behind them and sealed them in.
paras.zh: 大家手牵着手一起往迷雾深处走去，迷雾在他们身后合拢，把他们封在了里面。

paras.en: The mist sparkled.
paras.zh: 迷雾闪闪发光。

paras.en: Swirling particles of color danced throughout it.
paras.zh: 漩涡般的彩色光点在雾中四处起舞。

paras.en: Sven watched, grunting nervously. “It’s okay,” Kristoff said to calm his friend. “Did you know that an enchanted forest is a place of transformation?” Olaf asked, his face full of joy. “I have no idea what that means, but I can’t wait to see what it’s going to do to each of us.” The flashes of color were mesmerizing, until the lights came together and formed ribbons behind the group.
paras.zh: 斯文看着，紧张地哼哼。“没事，”克里斯托夫安抚朋友道。“你们知道吗，魔法森林是会改变人的地方？”雪宝满脸欢喜地问。“我完全不懂这是什么意思，但我等不及想看看它会对我们每个人都有什么影响。”那些彩色闪光令人着迷，直到所有光点汇聚起来，在队伍身后化作一条条光带。

paras.en: The mist moved forward and touched them.
paras.zh: 迷雾向前涌动，触到了他们。

paras.en: But now when it connected with the friends, they didn’t bounce off.
paras.zh: 可这一次，雾碰到伙伴们时，他们没有被弹开。

paras.en: Instead, the mist shoved them forward!
paras.zh: 相反，迷雾把他们往前推！

paras.en: The group shouted out in a blur of voices. “Hey!” “What the—?” “No pushing!” “What is this?” “Too fast!” “Tree!” Kristoff grunted as he was pushed straight into a trunk.
paras.zh: 众人乱糟糟地叫成一片。“嘿！”“搞什么——？”“别推！”“这是什么东西？”“太快了！”“树！”克里斯托夫被直接推进了一棵树干，发出一声闷哼。

paras.en: As he untangled himself, the mist pushed him up to join his group.
paras.zh: 他刚从树干上挣脱开，迷雾又推着他去和家人会合。

paras.en: They stumbled over rocks and tree roots as they ran, getting turned around in confusion before the mist shoved them completely out of its grasp. “What was that?” Kristoff asked, thoroughly dazed as he stared at the wall of mist that now seemed as calm as when they had viewed it for the very first time.
paras.zh: 他们奔跑时踉踉跄跄地绊过石头和树根，晕头转向地转了好几圈，直到迷雾把他们彻底推出了掌控。“那是什么？”克里斯托夫呆呆地问，眼睛盯着那堵迷雾墙——此刻它又平静得像他们初见时一样。

paras.en: Olaf was back to bouncing on it like before.
paras.zh: 雪宝又像之前那样在雾上弹来弹去。

paras.en: The others banged their fists against it, hoping to find a way out. “Okay, it let us in, but it clearly doesn’t want to let us out,” Kristoff observed. “And…we are locked in here.
paras.zh: 其他人用拳头捶打着雾墙，希望能找到出路。“好吧，它放我们进来，但显然不想放我们出去，”克里斯托夫说，“而且……我们被锁在里面了。

paras.en: Probably should have seen that coming,” Anna added.
paras.zh: “早该想到的，”安娜补了一句。

paras.en: Elsa sighed and let her hands drop to her sides.
paras.zh: 艾莎叹了口气，双手垂在身侧。

paras.en: She decided to accept that going back through the mist wasn’t the way out.
paras.zh: 她决定接受这个事实：从迷雾穿回去不是出路。

paras.en: When she turned to see where they had been deposited, she realized they were in the middle of the Enchanted Forest. “This forest is beautiful,” she said in awe as she stepped forward.
paras.zh: 她转过身，想看看自己被送到了哪里，这才发现他们正站在魔法森林中央。“这片森林真美，”她一边敬畏地说，一边迈步向前。

paras.en: The others turned to see what Elsa was talking about.
paras.zh: 其他人也转头去看艾莎说的是什么。

paras.en: The most amazing, picture-perfect forest stretched before them.
paras.zh: 一片美得不可思议、如同画卷般完美的森林在他们眼前展开。

paras.en: They kept moving, captivated by the vibrant reds and yellows of the leaves.
paras.zh: 他们继续前行，被叶片上鲜亮的红与黄深深吸引。

paras.en: Elsa was amazed by the forest canopy that stretched into the mist-covered sky.
paras.zh: 艾莎惊叹于那片伸向迷雾笼罩天空的林冠。

paras.en: Sven darted from one tree to the next, scratching his back on the strong trunks.
paras.zh: 斯文从一棵树窜到另一棵，在粗壮的树干上蹭着背。

paras.en: Anna’s breath caught in her throat when she stepped over a rise and looked down at the dam her father had described to her and Elsa when they were children.
paras.zh: 安娜翻过一道土坡，低头看见那座水坝——父亲小时候曾对她和艾莎描述过它——顿时屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: It was covered in vines and other shrubbery, but it was tall and vast, and no water leaked through. “The dam.
paras.zh: 水坝上爬满了藤蔓和其他灌木，但它依然高大巍峨，没有一丝漏水。“水坝。

paras.en: It still stands,” she said. “It was in Grand Pabbie’s visions.
paras.zh: 它还立着，”她说，“这也是皮比大仙预见过的景象。

paras.en: But why?” Kristoff walked over to her. “Still in good shape…thank goodness.” “What do you mean?” Anna asked, looking up at him. “Well, if that dam broke,” Kristoff warned, “it would send a tidal wave so big, it would wash away everything on this fjord.” Anna couldn’t hide her worry. “Everything?
paras.zh: 可为什么呢？”克里斯托夫走到她身边。“状况还不错……谢天谢地。”“你什么意思？”安娜抬头问他。“唔，要是那水坝塌了，”克里斯托夫提醒道，“就会掀起巨大的海啸，把这条峡湾里的一切都冲走。”安娜掩饰不住担忧。“一切？

paras.en: Arendelle’s on this fjord.” “Nothing’s gonna happen to Arendelle, Anna,” Kristoff assured her. “It’s going to be fine.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔就在这条峡湾上。”“阿伦黛尔不会有事的，安娜，”克里斯托夫向她保证，“会没事的。

paras.en: Come here.” He wrapped an arm around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 过来。”他用一只胳膊搂住她的肩膀。

paras.en: She leaned in close to his touch and was able to relax.
paras.zh: 她靠上他的肩膀，终于放松下来。

paras.en: Together, they gazed at the beautiful dam.
paras.zh: 两人一起凝望着那座美丽的水坝。

paras.en: Kristoff realized how majestic everything was around them.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫意识到，周围的万物是何等壮丽。

paras.en: And he had an idea. “You know, under different circumstances, this would be a pretty romantic place…don’t you think?” “Different circumstances?” Anna asked, looking puzzled. “You mean like with someone else?” “What?
paras.zh: 他冒出了一个念头。“你说，要是在别的情境下，这儿该是个挺浪漫的地方……你不觉得吗？”“别的情境？”安娜不解地问，“你是说，跟别人一起？”“什么？

paras.en: No, no—” Kristoff said, fishing a hand into his back pocket for the ring he had already tried to give her twice.
paras.zh: 不不——”克里斯托夫说着，把手伸进后兜，掏出那枚他已经试过两次想送给她的戒指。

paras.en: But now seemed a better time than ever.
paras.zh: 可现在似乎比以往任何时候都更合适。

paras.en: He found it, pulled it out of his pocket, and put it behind his back. “I’m saying…” He cleared his throat to make sure the words came out right. “Just in case we don’t make it out of here—” Anna pulled away from him. “Wait, what?
paras.zh: 他找到了，从兜里掏出来，藏到背后。“我是说……”他清了清嗓子，确保话说得妥帖。“就怕我们走不出这里——”安娜从他身边退开。“等等，你说什么？

paras.en: You don’t think we’re going to make it out of here?” “No.
paras.zh: 你觉得我们走不出这里了？”“不。

paras.en: No!” he said. “I mean, we will make it out here.
paras.zh: 不！”他说，“我是说，我们能走出这里。

paras.en: Well, technically, the odds are kinda complicated.
paras.zh: 唔，严格来说，概率这事儿有点复杂。

paras.en: But my point is, in case we die—” “You think we’re going to die?” Anna asked, her voice getting higher. “No!” Kristoff insisted. “No, no, no, we will die at some point, but not at any recent time will we die—” Anna realized Elsa wasn’t with them.
paras.zh: 但我想说的是，万一我们死了——”“你认为我们会死？”安娜的声音拔高了。“不会！”克里斯托夫坚持道，“不不不，我们迟早会死，但绝不会在最近死——”安娜这时发现艾莎不在他们身边。

paras.en: If they were in danger, they all needed to stay together.
paras.zh: 若真有危险，大家必须待在一起。

paras.en: And Anna had made an oath to Grand Pabbie to protect her sister. “Where’s Elsa?” she asked. “I swore I wouldn’t leave her side.
paras.zh: 而且安娜曾向皮比大仙发誓要保护姐姐。“艾莎呢？”她问，“我发过誓不会离开她身边的。

paras.en: Elsa?” Anna ran off to search for her. “—but way far in the future, we will die!” Kristoff sighed.
paras.zh: 艾莎？”安娜跑开去找她了。“——但那是很久很久以后的事，我们总会死的！”克里斯托夫叹了口气。

paras.en: Why couldn’t he ever get it right?
paras.zh: 他怎么老是把话说岔？

paras.en: He’d blown it yet again.
paras.zh: 他又一次搞砸了。

paras.en: Then, as best friends do, Sven came to his side.
paras.zh: 然后，作为最好的朋友，斯文来到他身边。

paras.en: The reindeer nudged him.
paras.zh: 驯鹿用鼻子拱了拱他。

paras.en: Kristoff looked at him. “Sven, don’t patronize me.” Kristoff felt bad enough already.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看着他。“斯文，别安慰我了。”克里斯托夫已经够难受了。

paras.en: Elsa wandered among the tall trees, enjoying the beauty around her.
paras.zh: 艾莎在高大的树木间漫步，享受着周围的美好。

paras.en: She took in a deep, peaceful breath and closed her eyes, trying to forget her cares.
paras.zh: 她深深、平静地吸了一口气，闭上眼睛，想把烦忧都忘掉。

paras.en: But there was something…something she couldn’t put her finger on, and it made the hairs on the back of her neck stand up.
paras.zh: 可有什么……某种她说不清的东西，让她后颈的汗毛都竖了起来。

paras.en: Her eyes shot open, and she spun quickly when she sensed something rushing toward her.
paras.zh: 她猛地睁开眼，感觉到有什么东西朝自己冲来，迅速转过身。

paras.en: She was surprised to see it was Anna. “Elsa!” her sister said. “There you are.
paras.zh: 她惊讶地发现那是安娜。“艾莎！”姐姐喊道，“原来你在这儿。

paras.en: You okay?” “I’m fine,” Elsa replied, unsettled by what she had just felt.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”“我没事，”艾莎回答，心里还因刚才的感觉而隐隐不安。

paras.en: Anna was relieved.
paras.zh: 安娜松了口气。

paras.en: She took a moment to look around. “Okay.
paras.zh: 她环顾四周，定了定神。“好吧。

paras.en: Good.
paras.zh: 好。

paras.en: Where’s Olaf?”
paras.zh: 雪宝呢？”

paras.en: Olaf was happy to explore the forest.
paras.zh: 雪宝兴高采烈地在森林里探索。

paras.en: He didn’t even know he was lost.
paras.zh: 他甚至没意识到自己迷路了。

paras.en: He marched along, thinking his friends were right behind him. “Anyone else feel like we’re being watched.
paras.zh: 他大步往前走，以为朋友们就紧跟在身后。“还有谁觉得……我们被盯上了。

paras.en: Anyone?
paras.zh: 有人吗？

paras.en: No one?” Olaf turned around and saw only the forest. “I’m alone.” He peered deeper into the woods, trying to confirm that no one was with him. “Anna?
paras.zh: 没人？”雪宝转过身，只看见森林。“就我一个。”他往树林深处张望，想确认确实没人和他在一起。“安娜？

paras.en: Elsa?
paras.zh: 艾莎？

paras.en: Sven?
paras.zh: 斯文？

paras.en: Samantha?” He laughed. “I don’t even know a Samantha.” He continued laughing until a gust of wind blew at his backside. “Whoa,” he said in surprise.
paras.zh: 萨曼莎？”他笑起来，“我根本不认识什么萨曼莎。”他笑着笑着，一阵风忽然吹到他屁股上。“哇哦，”他惊讶地说。

paras.en: He spun around again, searching for the culprit.
paras.zh: 他又转了一圈，想找出那个捣蛋鬼。

paras.en: Seeing nothing, the snowman simply shrugged.
paras.zh: 什么也没看见，雪人只是耸了耸肩。

paras.en: The trees above him crackled, and a pile of leaves crashed on his head.
paras.zh: 头顶的树发出噼啪声，一堆叶子哗啦砸在他头上。

paras.en: Olaf pushed the leaves off and picked one out of his mouth. “That’s normal,” he said.
paras.zh: 雪宝把叶子拨开，从嘴里揪出一片。“这很正常，”他说。

paras.en: A rock flew out of the bushes as if from nowhere, and when Olaf turned to continue on his journey, he tripped over it and landed on his face.
paras.zh: 一块石头像凭空冒出来似的从灌木丛里飞出，雪宝转身要继续走时，被它绊了一跤，脸朝下摔在地上。

paras.en: A hot gush of water pushed him back up to his feet.
paras.zh: 一股热水喷涌而出，把他顶得重新站了起来。

paras.en: This is getting weird, he thought.
paras.zh: 这越来越诡异了，他想。

paras.en: Tree limbs shimmied above his head, rattling the leaves as something large scampered through them.
paras.zh: 头顶的树枝轻轻颤动，叶子沙沙作响——有什么大个儿的东西在枝叶间匆匆跑过。

paras.en: Olaf turned quickly to look behind him. “What was that?” he asked.
paras.zh: 雪宝迅速转身看身后。“那是什么？”他问。

paras.en: A large hole gaped in the ground before him, and he quickly stopped before he fell in.
paras.zh: 他面前地上张着一个大洞，他赶紧停下，没摔进去。

paras.en: He cautiously looked into what seemed to be a bottomless pit. “Samantha?” he called, his voice echoing as it faded into the nothingness.
paras.zh: 他小心地朝那个仿佛无底的深坑里望去。“萨曼莎？”他喊道，声音回荡着，渐渐消失在虚无中。

paras.en: No response.
paras.zh: 没有回应。

paras.en: Olaf backed away nervously.
paras.zh: 雪宝紧张地往后退。

paras.en: The snowman was confident that although there was no explanation at the moment, there would be one day.
paras.zh: 雪人相信，虽然此刻无法解释，但总有一天会真相大白。

paras.en: He just needed to be a bit older and wiser.
paras.zh: 他只需要再长大一点、再懂事一点。

paras.en: Then, when he thought back about everything strange that was happening to him now, he would realize it had all been completely normal.
paras.zh: 到那时，回想起现在发生在自己身上的一切怪事，他就会明白，那其实都再正常不过。

paras.en: A sizzling sound caught his attention, and he turned his head just in time to see a smoking blaze burn through the moss and race toward him.
paras.zh: 一阵滋滋声引起了他的注意，他及时转过头，正好看见一团冒着烟的火苗烧穿苔藓，朝他冲来。

paras.en: He didn’t know what it was, but he knew it couldn’t be good.
paras.zh: 他不知道那是什么，但他知道准没好事。

paras.en: He dove out of the way.
paras.zh: 他猛地往旁边一扑躲开。

paras.en: Olaf kept moving and soon reached a dark part of the forest, overgrown with vines and twisted branches all around him.
paras.zh: 雪宝继续走，很快来到森林中一处阴暗的地方，四周爬满藤蔓，枝条扭曲纠缠。

paras.en: He convinced himself that the fear he felt would seem childish in a couple of years.
paras.zh: 他劝自己，现在感到的恐惧，过几年再看会显得很幼稚。

paras.en: Creepy, unblinking white eyes peered out of the bushes everywhere he looked.
paras.zh: 无论他往哪儿看，灌木丛里都瞪着一双双诡异、一眨不眨的白眼睛。

paras.en: He tried not to think about anything but using his manners. “Excuse me,” he said, backing out of the small grove of trees.
paras.zh: 他努力什么也不去想，只管讲礼貌。“借过，”他说着，从小树丛里退了出来。

paras.en: Olaf scurried away and found himself in a small clearing by a brook.
paras.zh: 雪宝慌忙跑开，发现自己来到一条小溪旁的小空地。

paras.en: He knew he’d make it somewhere safe!
paras.zh: 他知道自己一定能到达安全的地方！

paras.en: He had been willing to face his fears, and look what had happened!
paras.zh: 他本来已经鼓起勇气面对恐惧了，结果看看发生了什么！

paras.en: Olaf believed that by looking down at his reflection in the water, he would feel even better.
paras.zh: 雪宝相信，低头看看水中自己的倒影，心情会好一些。

paras.en: What he saw was a distorted, rippling version of himself, but Olaf remained secure.
paras.zh: 他看到的是扭曲、荡漾的自己，但雪宝依旧安心。

paras.en: Even with the creepy face and eyes staring back at him, nothing could shake his courage—until that image was replaced by a big scary horse’s face! “AAAAAAHHHHHH!” Olaf screamed in terror.
paras.zh: 哪怕那张诡异的脸和那双眼睛正回瞪着他，也没什么能动摇他的勇气——直到那影像被一张巨大恐怖的马脸取代！“啊啊啊啊啊啊！”雪宝惊恐地尖叫。

paras.en: Then a nearby bush burst into flames.
paras.zh: 接着，旁边一丛灌木猛地燃起火焰。

paras.en: Olaf continued screaming until he ran out of breath, not even noticing that the fire in the bush went out the moment he stopped screaming.
paras.zh: 雪宝一直尖叫到没气为止，甚至没注意到，他一停下尖叫，灌木里的火就灭了。

paras.en: Everything went back to normal, and he reminded himself that in a few years, he would find explanations for all these strange things.
paras.zh: 一切恢复了正常，他提醒自己，再过几年，这些怪事都能解释得通。

paras.en: Olaf wasn’t even worried when he saw trees deeper in the forest bending to the ground as if they were pushed by a heavy wind. “This is fine,” he said confidently.
paras.zh: 雪宝看见森林深处的大树像被一阵猛风推着弯向地面，竟也不慌。“这没关系，”他自信地说。

paras.en: But it wasn’t.
paras.zh: 可事实并非如此。

paras.en: The heavy wind found him and swept him up into the roaring storm—one piece at a time.
paras.zh: 那阵猛风找到了他，把他卷进了咆哮的风暴——一次卷走他一块身体零件。

paras.en: Elsa, Anna, Kristoff, and Sven were able to track Olaf down when they heard him scream.
paras.zh: 艾莎、安娜、克里斯托夫和斯文听到雪宝的尖叫，循声找到了他。

paras.en: They rushed toward the whirlwind, shouting for their friend.
paras.zh: 他们冲向那股旋风，呼喊着朋友的名字。

paras.en: But the wild winds wanted more than the icy man.
paras.zh: 可狂野的风要的远不止那个冰雪人。

paras.en: Everyone else was swept up into the vortex with him.
paras.zh: 其他人也和他一起被卷进了漩涡。

paras.en: The gusts whipped their bodies around in circles, arms grabbing and legs kicking as they tried to find something stable to hold on to.
paras.zh: 一阵阵疾风把他们的身体甩着打转，大家手抓脚蹬，想抓住什么稳当的东西。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa reached for each other as Olaf’s body parts swung around them—first his midsection, then his head. “Hey, guys!” Olaf said, and then his feet passed, too. “Meet the Wind Spirit.” “Coming through,” Kristoff said as he swept past Elsa.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎伸手想抓住彼此，雪宝的身体零件在他们周围飞旋——先是他中段，接着是脑袋。“嘿，各位！”雪宝说，随后他的脚也飞了过去。“来认识一下风灵。”“借过，”克里斯托夫掠过艾莎身边时说。

paras.en: Anna’s skirt blew over her head and her hands were pulled from Elsa’s grasp.
paras.zh: 安娜的裙子被吹到头上，双手也从艾莎手里挣脱了。

paras.en: Anna spun wildly out of control. “I think I’m going to be sick!” she said. “I’d hold your hair back, but I can’t find my arms!” Olaf shouted as he sailed past her again.
paras.zh: 安娜失控地疯狂旋转。“我快吐了！”她说。“我很想帮你把头发拢起来，可我找不到自己的胳膊了！”雪宝又一次从她身边飞过时喊道。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven slammed into each other.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文撞在了一起。

paras.en: They all soared higher into the vortex, flailing and flapping, grumbling and groaning.
paras.zh: 他们在漩涡里越升越高，乱挥乱扑，嘟嘟囔囔，唉声叹气。

paras.en: Their bodies moved forward and back, up and down.
paras.zh: 他们的身体前前后后、上上下下地翻飞。

paras.en: Everyone looked like they were doing a ridiculous dance.
paras.zh: 每个人都像在跳一支滑稽的舞。

paras.en: But it wasn’t just the friends who were caught in the whirlwind—the debris that had been on the forest floor was everywhere.
paras.zh: 可被困在旋风里的不止朋友们——森林地面上的一切残枝败叶也到处翻飞。

paras.en: One large tree branch soared through the vortex, headed straight for Anna.
paras.zh: 一根粗大的树枝从漩涡中掠过，直冲安娜而去。

paras.en: Elsa threw out her hands and hit the branch with an icy blast right before it hit her sister.
paras.zh: 艾莎伸出双手，在树枝撞到妹妹前一刻用冰霜一击将它击退。

paras.en: The queen’s magic knocked the branch free of the wind’s grasp.
paras.zh: 女王的魔法让树枝脱离了风的掌控。

paras.en: After that, things seemed to change.
paras.zh: 之后，情形似乎变了。

paras.en: The vortex centered itself on Elsa’s hands. “Hey, stop!” she said, just before it pushed the others, including all of Olaf’s parts.
paras.zh: 漩涡把中心对准了艾莎的双手。“嘿，停下！”她说，就在它把其他人——包括雪宝所有零件——推开之前。

paras.en: Kristoff landed on a mound of star moss, which cushioned his fall.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫落在一堆星状苔藓上，苔藓缓冲了他的坠落。

paras.en: Olaf’s body parts fell back together in one piece on the end of log.
paras.zh: 雪宝的身体零件在一段木头的一端重新拼成了一整块。

paras.en: But there was a problem.
paras.zh: 可出了个问题。

paras.en: They were in the wrong order.
paras.zh: 它们拼的顺序不对。

paras.en: Sven dropped out of the sky on the other end of the log, and when he did, Olaf’s parts flew back up into the air.
paras.zh: 斯文从天上落在木头的另一端，他一落地，雪宝的零件又被弹回了空中。

paras.en: When they came down this time, everything was exactly where it was supposed to be!
paras.zh: 这一次落下时，所有零件都回到了该在的位置！

paras.en: Anna fell with a splash into the brook Olaf had discovered earlier.
paras.zh: 安娜扑通一声掉进了雪宝早先发现的那条小溪。

paras.en: But before she could get her bearings, a small ripple that turned into a wave rushed toward her.
paras.zh: 可她还没站稳，一圈小涟漪就化成一道波浪朝她涌来。

paras.en: Anna was so frantic to get back to her sister that she didn’t even notice.
paras.zh: 安娜一心只想回到姐姐身边，连这都没注意到。

paras.en: She jumped to her feet and moved to the bank of the brook.
paras.zh: 她跳起来，朝溪岸挪去。

paras.en: When she emerged on the shoreline, she began to run. “Elsa!” she called out, never noticing watchful eyes staring at her from the crest of the small wave. “Let her go!” Anna demanded of the Wind Spirit.
paras.zh: 她一上岸就拔腿奔跑。“艾莎！”她喊着，全然没发现浪尖上有双警惕的眼睛正盯着她。“放了她！”安娜对风灵喝道。

paras.en: Anna arrived near the vortex as Kristoff climbed out of the star moss, trying to pull off the green bits of shrubbery that clung to him. “Anna, be careful!” he called.
paras.zh: 安娜赶到漩涡附近时，克里斯托夫正从星状苔藓里爬出来，想扯掉粘在身上的绿色碎枝叶。“安娜，小心！”他喊道。

paras.en: They tried to get close to the vortex, but it wouldn’t let them in—it threw them back. “That’s my sister!” Anna shouted.
paras.zh: 他们想靠近漩涡，可它不让他们进——反而把他们弹开。“那是我姐姐！”安娜喊道。

paras.en: Elsa could see her friends through the rushing winds, and she knew they were doing their best to help her.
paras.zh: 艾莎透过疾风看见了朋友们，知道他们正尽全力帮自己。

paras.en: She also knew she had only one option left as the vortex swirled around her, refusing to let her out.
paras.zh: 她也知道，漩涡围着她打转，不肯放她出去，自己只剩一个选择了。

paras.en: Elsa moved her hands away from each other, as far as she could, and made a steady stream of snow to mix with the wind.
paras.zh: 艾莎把双手尽量向两边分开，让一股稳定的雪花之流与风交融。

paras.en: The vortex thickened with the snow’s weight, which slowed the spin Elsa was in.
paras.zh: 雪花加重了漩涡，也减慢了艾莎旋转的速度。

paras.en: She was sure she heard human voices, the sounds of animals, and echoes of the forest around her as the spinning continued to slow. “Prince Agnarr!” she heard a man yell.
paras.zh: 旋转越来越慢，她确信自己听见了人声、野兽声，还有森林的回响。“安格瑞王子！”她听见一个男人喊道。

paras.en: She closed her eyes and curled up as the slushy, ribbony whiteness overtook her.
paras.zh: 她闭上眼睛蜷起身子，那黏糊糊、如缎带般的白茫茫将她吞没。

paras.en: Without warning, Elsa threw open her arms, releasing all her magic, flooding the vortex with her power. “For Arendelle,” a deep voice intoned as a blast of snow filled the air with white.
paras.zh: 艾莎毫无预兆地张开双臂，释放出全部魔力，让力量灌满整个漩涡。“为了阿伦黛尔，”一个低沉的声音庄严地说道，一阵雪暴把空气染成白茫茫一片。

paras.en: The vortex had disappeared and peace was restored to the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 漩涡消散了，魔法森林重归宁静。

paras.en: As the snow slowly fell from the air, Anna looked around frantically for her sister.
paras.zh: 雪花缓缓飘落，安娜焦急地四下寻找姐姐。

paras.en: Then she saw Elsa standing in what looked to be a garden, surrounded by beautiful sculptures made from ice.
paras.zh: 接着她看见艾莎站在一处像是花园的地方，周围环绕着美丽的冰雕。

paras.en: The queen looked from one sculpture to the next, stunned.
paras.zh: 女王一座接一座地看着冰雕，惊呆了。

paras.en: Anna went to her side, taking Elsa’s hand. “Are you okay?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜走到她身边，握住艾莎的手。“你没事吧？”她问。

paras.en: Elsa squeezed her hand. “I’m fine,” she said. “What are these?” Kristoff asked when he arrived.
paras.zh: 艾莎握紧她的手。“我没事，”她说。“这些是什么？”克里斯托夫赶到时问。

paras.en: Awestruck, he circled the ice sculptures with the rest of the group, looking closely at the detail, the delicacy.
paras.zh: 他满心敬畏，和众人一起绕着冰雕打转，仔细端详其中的细节与精巧。

paras.en: As an ice harvester, he was a big fan of anything made of ice. “They look like moments in time,” Elsa said softly.
paras.zh: 作为一个采冰人，他格外偏爱一切冰做的事物。“它们像是一个个凝固的瞬间，”艾莎轻声说。

paras.en: Elsa’s words reminded Anna of something she had heard earlier.
paras.zh: 艾莎的话让安娜想起早先听过的一句话。

paras.en: Anna turned to the snowman. “What’s that thing you say, Olaf?” “Oh!” he replied. “My theory about advancing technology as both our savior and our doom?” “No, not the…not that one,” Anna said. “The one about—” “The one about cucumbers?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: 安娜转向雪人。“你常说那句什么来着，雪宝？”“哦！”他答道，“是说科技进步既是我们的救星也是我们的末日那个理论吗？”“不，不是那个……不是那个，”安娜说，“是那个关于——”“关于黄瓜的那个？”雪宝问。

paras.en: He had read so many books and had learned so much, there were hundreds of things he had talked about to anyone who would listen. “No, the thing about water,” Anna said, narrowing it down. “Oh, yeah,” Olaf said. “Water has memory.
paras.zh: 他读过太多书、懂得太多，跟谁都能滔滔不绝说上几百样事。“不，是关于水的那句，”安娜把范围缩小。“哦，对，”雪宝说，“水是有记忆的。

paras.en: The water that makes up you and me has passed through at least four or five people or animals before us.” Sven’s head jerked up at Olaf’s statement.
paras.zh: 构成你我的水，在我们之前至少已经流过四五个人或动物。”斯文听到这话猛地抬起头。

paras.en: His eyes were wide, his muzzle twisted in what appeared to be disgust.
paras.zh: 他瞪圆了眼睛，嘴脸皱成一团，一副嫌恶的表情。

paras.en: He glanced at the ice sculpture he had been licking and spit on the ground. “It remembers everything,” Olaf finished.
paras.zh: 他瞥了一眼自己刚才在舔的冰雕，朝地上啐了一口。“它什么都记得，”雪宝把话说完。

paras.en: The wind rustled the leaves, coming from nowhere and sweeping around Olaf. “Oh, the wind’s back,” he said. “I think I’ll name you…Gale.” Everyone braced themselves as the wind moved around Anna and then slipped up the leg of Kristoff’s pants. “Ooh, ah,” Kristoff called, dancing around a bit, hoping it would leave him alone. “Whoa, get out of there.” The Wind Spirit twirled in Anna’s hair and made her clothing flutter as if it was examining her. “Oh, aren’t you curious….” Then it moved on to Elsa and swept her up in its grip. “Oh!” she gasped.
paras.zh: 风沙沙地吹动树叶，不知从哪儿冒出来，绕着雪宝打转。“哦，风又回来了，”他说，“我想给你起个名字……就叫盖尔吧。”风绕着安娜转了一圈，又顺着陆克里斯托夫的裤腿钻了进去，大家都绷紧了神经。“哎哟，啊，”克里斯托夫叫着，扭动几下身子，希望它别缠着自己。“哇，快出来。”风灵在安娜头发里打转，吹得她衣衫飘动，像是在打量她。“哦，你不好奇吗……”接着它又挪到艾莎身边，一把将她卷了起来。“哦！”她倒吸一口气。

paras.en: But she quickly realized the Wind Spirit was no longer being aggressive.
paras.zh: 但她很快意识到，风灵不再有攻击性了。

paras.en: The group immediately stood around her, ready to protect her. “I’m okay.
paras.zh: 大家立刻围到她身边，准备保护她。“我没事。

paras.en: I’m okay,” she told them.
paras.zh: 我没事，”她告诉大家。

paras.en: Gale held Elsa aloft for only a few moments before setting her gently on her feet.
paras.zh: 盖尔只把艾莎托在半空片刻，便轻轻把她放回地上。

paras.en: Elsa smiled.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了。

paras.en: The Wind Spirit’s energy had lifted her mood and made her feel ready to take on any obstacle that came her way. “Did you want me to make these?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 风灵的力量让她心情大好，觉得自己能应对任何挡在前面的障碍。“这些是你希望我雕出来的吗？”艾莎问。

paras.en: The wind ruffled her skirts while she looked at the nearest ice sculpture.
paras.zh: 风轻轻撩起她的裙摆，她正望着最近的一座冰雕。

paras.en: But Gale didn’t answer.
paras.zh: 但盖尔没有回答。

paras.en: The Wind Spirit swirled around the sisters, then swept down through a small opening in the trees.
paras.zh: 风灵在姐妹俩身边打着旋，然后顺着树木间一个小缺口俯冲下去。

paras.en: Aloft in its breeze were leaves of red and orange hues, making it easy for the group to follow where it led.
paras.zh: 它的微风托着红红黄黄的树叶，让大家很容易跟上前去。

paras.en: Anna passed though the opening with the others.
paras.zh: 安娜和其他人一起穿过那个缺口。

paras.en: Gale had brought them to an ice sculpture that was set apart from the rest.
paras.zh: 盖尔把他们带到了一座与众不同的冰雕前。

paras.en: The sculpture depicted a couple swept up in a windstorm—a young girl helping a young boy.
paras.zh: 雕像刻画的是一对被风暴卷起的人——一个少女正扶着一个少年。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa approached the sculpture in disbelief.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎难以置信地走近那座雕像。

paras.en: They moved around it, looking closely from every angle. “Father?” Anna asked softly, recognizing the elements of the sculpture’s face. “That’s Father.”
paras.zh: 她们围着雕像转，从每个角度细细端详。“父亲？”安娜轻声问，认出了雕像脸上的某些特征，“那是父亲。”

paras.en: Elsa leaned closer to the young boy and nodded.
paras.zh: 艾莎朝那少年凑近一些，点了点头。

paras.en: It was definitely her father.
paras.zh: 那确实是她的父亲。

paras.en: She turned her focus to the girl holding him.
paras.zh: 她把注意力转向扶着他的那个女孩。

paras.en: There was something special about her, too. “This girl,” she said. “She’s saving him…,” Olaf said. “She’s Northuldra,” Kristoff added, recognizing that she wasn’t dressed in typical Arendellian clothing.
paras.zh: 这个女孩也不一般。“这个女孩，”她说，“她在救他……”雪宝说。“她是北地人，”克里斯托夫补充道，认出她的衣着不是阿伦黛尔常见款式。

paras.en: Suddenly, a whirring sound swished from the trees closest to them.
paras.zh: 忽然，一阵呼啸声从离他们最近的树丛里响起。

paras.en: Olaf squealed and hid behind Anna.
paras.zh: 雪宝尖叫一声，躲到安娜身后。

paras.en: He reached into her satchel and pulled Iduna’s scarf out far enough that he could wrap it over his head and shoulders, as if it could conceal him from whatever was coming their way. “What is that?” Anna asked. “Olaf, get behind me,” Elsa ordered.
paras.zh: 他伸手探进安娜的挎包，把伊杜娜的围巾扯出来，足够盖住头和肩膀，好像这样就能把自己藏在来犯之物面前。“那是什么？”安娜问。“雪宝，躲我身后，”艾莎命令道。

paras.en: Loud bangs joined the whirring, creating a rhythmic beat.
paras.zh: 响亮的撞击声加入呼啸，形成有节奏的鼓点。

paras.en: The noise filled the air, escalating in volume and tempo.
paras.zh: 喧闹声充斥空气，音量和节奏都越来越强。

paras.en: The bushes in front of them, next to the sculpture, rustled.
paras.zh: 他们前方、雕像旁的灌木丛沙沙作响。

paras.en: Anna had had enough.
paras.zh: 安娜受够了。

paras.en: Since they’d entered the Enchanted Forest, their experience had been anything but enchanting.
paras.zh: 自从进了魔法森林，他们的遭遇可一点都不“魔法”——一点都不美妙。

paras.en: Stepping forward, she reached toward another ice sculpture and broke off a sword. “What are you going to do with that?” Kristoff asked as the whirring intensified. “I have no idea,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 她上前一步，朝另一座冰雕伸手，掰下一把冰剑。“你拿那个要干什么？”呼啸声越来越急，克里斯托夫问。“我也不知道，”安娜说。

paras.en: But then she made a decision.
paras.zh: 但她随即下了决心。

paras.en: Holding the ice sword in front of her, she marched toward the bushes that had since stopped moving.
paras.zh: 她把冰剑横在身前，朝那丛已经不动了的灌木走去。

paras.en: With one swing, Anna cut the offensive bush down the middle.
paras.zh: 安娜一剑挥下，把那丛讨厌的灌木从中间劈开。

paras.en: It was time to reveal whatever danger lurked within!
paras.zh: 是时候让藏在里面的危险现形了！

paras.en: Then she saw a group of people crouched low to the ground.
paras.zh: 接着她看见一群人正低低地蹲在地上。

paras.en: Behind them stood a group of reindeer.
paras.zh: 他们身后站着一群驯鹿。

paras.en: Are they Northuldra?
paras.zh: 他们是北地人吗？

paras.en: Anna thought as she stared at their unfamiliar clothes.
paras.zh: 安娜盯着他们陌生的衣着，心中暗想。

paras.en: THUMP!
paras.zh: 咚！

paras.en: Anna spun at the loud sound.
paras.zh: 安娜被这巨响惊得转过身。

paras.en: More Northuldra dropped from the trees.
paras.zh: 更多北地人从树上跃下。

paras.en: Each person was swinging a round object on a string, which she saw was making the whirring noise. “Lower your weapon,” a young woman commanded.
paras.zh: 每个人都在甩动系在绳上的圆形物件，她看清了，那呼啸声正是它发出的。“放下武器，”一个年轻女子命令道。

paras.en: She was one of the Northuldra who’d dropped from the trees.
paras.zh: 她是从树上跃下的北地人之一。

paras.en: With a raised staff, she moved toward Anna and her friends.
paras.zh: 她高举着手杖，朝安娜和朋友们逼近。

paras.en: The other Northuldra moved behind her.
paras.zh: 其他北地人跟在她身后。

paras.en: Swords slammed against shields.
paras.zh: 刀剑撞上盾牌，哐当作响。

paras.en: Five newcomers appeared, looking different from the Northuldra, their swords at the ready. “And YOU lower yours,” the soldier in charge commanded the Northuldra.
paras.zh: 五个新面孔出现了，模样与北地人不同，剑已出鞘。“你，也放下你的，”带头的士兵对北地人下令。

paras.en: He stood strong in a uniform that showed the wear and tear of many years.
paras.zh: 他身姿笔挺，穿着一件显出多年风霜的制服。

paras.en: But it was still clearly an Arendellian uniform.
paras.zh: 但那显然是一身阿伦黛尔制服。

paras.en: He looked familiar to Anna. “Arendellian soldiers?” Anna asked her friends, wondering if it was possible.
paras.zh: 安娜觉得他面熟。“阿伦黛尔的士兵？”安娜问朋友们，心里怀疑这是否可能。

paras.en: She had always assumed that when the mist had closed around the forest, the only people who’d been trapped within had been their enemies, the Northuldra.
paras.zh: 她一直以为，迷雾合拢时被困在森林里的，只有他们的敌人——北地人。

paras.en: An older woman seemed to come from nowhere just then.
paras.zh: 就在这时，一位年长的妇人仿佛凭空出现。

paras.en: She stood at the soldier’s side, holding a staff.
paras.zh: 她站在士兵身旁，手执一根手杖。

paras.en: The soldier closed his eyes briefly, then opened them again and stared straight ahead. “Threatening my people again, Lieutenant?” the woman said.
paras.zh: 士兵短暂地闭了下眼，又睁开直视前方。“又来威胁我的人了，中尉？”妇人说。

paras.en: He regarded her like an old neighbor he had been squabbling with for years. “Invading my dance space again, Yelana?” he responded.
paras.zh: 他看她的眼神，像在打量一个吵了多年的老邻居。“又闯进我的舞场了，耶拉娜？”他回敬道。

paras.en: The two continued to bicker like old enemies, or friends—it was hard to tell which. “Why does that soldier look so familiar?” Anna wondered aloud.
paras.zh: 两人继续斗嘴，像老对头，又像老朋友——分不清到底是哪种。“那个士兵怎么这么眼熟？”安娜大声纳闷。

paras.en: She stared at the Arendellian soldier in charge and stepped forward with the ice sword still in her hand.
paras.zh: 她盯着那个带头的阿伦黛尔士兵，手里仍握着冰剑走上前。

paras.en: A soldier noticed Anna moving toward them and shouted, “Look out, Lieutenant!” The lieutenant spun his shield, trying to knock Yelana’s staff away from his side.
paras.zh: 一名士兵注意到安娜逼近，喊道：“小心，中尉！”中尉抡起盾牌，想挡开耶拉娜戳向他身侧的手杖。

paras.en: But Yelana countered his move. “Get the sword!” he ordered his soldiers.
paras.zh: 但耶拉娜化解了他的动作。“夺下那把剑！”他命令手下的士兵。

paras.en: They charged Elsa, Anna, Olaf, Kristoff, and Sven.
paras.zh: 他们朝艾莎、安娜、雪宝、克里斯托夫和斯文冲来。

paras.en: The Northuldra were close behind.
paras.zh: 北地人紧随其后。

paras.en: Elsa blasted her power at the ground to create a slick, glassy coating around her group.
paras.zh: 艾莎将魔力击向地面，在同伴四周凝出一层光滑如镜的冰面。

paras.en: The soldiers and the Northuldra slipped and slid until they all fell onto their backs and rear ends.
paras.zh: 士兵和北地人脚下一滑再滑，最后全都仰面朝天、屁股着地摔了下去。

paras.en: The lieutenant crashed next to Yelana. “That was magic,” he said in shock. “Did you see that?” “Of course I saw it,” she replied.
paras.zh: 中尉摔在耶拉娜身旁。“那是魔法，”他震惊地说，“你看见了吗？”“我当然看见了，”她答道。

paras.en: She’d hidden her surprise.
paras.zh: 她把惊讶藏了起来。

paras.en: Elsa and her friends stared at the two groups, now sprawled on the ground.
paras.zh: 艾莎和朋友们盯着地上那两群人——此刻都四脚朝天躺着。

paras.en: Anna leaned into her sister. “You chose a nice, cold greeting,” she said. “They’ve been trapped in here this whole time?” Kristoff whispered in disbelief. “What do we do now?” Elsa whispered back.
paras.zh: 安娜靠向姐姐。“你选了个挺冷——挺凉快的见面礼，”她说。“他们一直被困在这里？”克里斯托夫难以置信地低语。“我们现在怎么办？”艾莎低声回问。

paras.en: The history between the two groups in the forest was complicated.
paras.zh: 森林里这两群人之间的恩怨，说来话长。

paras.en: They’d met at the celebration for the dam completion.
paras.zh: 他们是在水坝竣工的庆祝会上相识的。

paras.en: And that was the day they’d become enemies.
paras.zh: 而那一天，他们成了仇敌。

paras.en: But Mattias had met Yelana long before then, during the negotiations on the cliff between the Northuldra ruler and King Runeard.
paras.zh: 但马蒂亚斯早在那之前就见过耶拉娜——当时北地人的首领和鲁尼德国王在悬崖上谈判。

paras.en: He didn’t need to be reminded how they were stuck in the forest.
paras.zh: 他无需别人提醒他们是怎么被困在森林里的。

paras.en: And Mattias woke every night in a cold sweat, remembering the day more than thirty-four years ago when his whole life had changed.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯每夜都冷汗涔涔地惊醒，想起三十多年前那个改变他一生的一天。

paras.en: Boulders had fallen from the sky with perfect aim.
paras.zh: 巨石从天而降，落点分毫不差。

paras.en: Fire had chased the soldiers and the Northuldra like a pack of hungry wolves.
paras.zh: 火像一群饿狼，紧追着士兵和北地人。

paras.en: Many men and women were injured, and others were lost.
paras.zh: 许多男女受了伤，还有一些人永远失散了。

paras.en: Mattias had been in battles before, but never one without an enemy to fight.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯打过仗，却从没打过这样一场没有敌人的仗。

paras.en: That wasn’t what bothered him the most, though.
paras.zh: 不过，最让他耿耿于怀的并不是这个。

paras.en: He had failed to protect the one person he’d thought of as his son: Prince Agnarr.
paras.zh: 他没能保护好那个他视如己出的人：安格瑞王子。

paras.en: Mattias and his soldiers had searched the forest for days for Agnarr.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯和手下在森林里找了安格瑞好几天。

paras.en: Even now, he didn’t want to accept that the prince had been lost forever the day the forest fell.
paras.zh: 直到现在，他仍不愿接受：森林崩落的那天，王子就已经永远迷失了。

paras.en: Mattias still held out hope that somehow, Agnarr had escaped.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯仍抱着一丝希望——或许安格瑞总算逃了出去。

paras.en: Mattias and Yelana had called a truce in the early years so they could work together.
paras.zh: 早些年，马蒂亚斯和耶拉娜曾达成休战，以便一同想办法。

paras.en: They had to find a way to get through the mist that had trapped them in the forest.
paras.zh: 他们得找到办法穿过那片把他们困在森林里的迷雾。

paras.en: They knew it would be better to partner in some ways, rather than to be stuck together as enemies.
paras.zh: 他们知道，与其作为仇敌困在一起，不如在某些方面联手。

paras.en: They didn’t always get along, but there were times when they respected each other.
paras.zh: 他们不总和睦，但也有彼此敬重的时候。

paras.en: The soldiers had been forced to become experts at using their swords to hunt.
paras.zh: 士兵们被迫练成了用剑打猎的高手。

paras.en: They created bows and arrows from sticks and rope.
paras.zh: 他们用树枝和绳索做成了弓箭。

paras.en: They gathered berries, acorns, and nettles to supplement their diet.
paras.zh: 他们采集浆果、橡果和荨麻来补充口粮。

paras.en: They didn’t share food with the Northuldra.
paras.zh: 他们不与北地人分享食物。

paras.en: And the Northuldra didn’t share their food with them.
paras.zh: 北地人也不把自己的食物分给他们。

paras.en: Mattias had volunteered when the soldiers constructed a catapult to fire something at the mist that first week.
paras.zh: 第一周，士兵们造了台投石机，想往迷雾里发射点什么，马蒂亚斯主动报了名。

paras.en: They didn’t know whether it was safe on the other side, but Mattias had been willing to give it a try.
paras.zh: 他们不知道雾的另一边是否安全，但马蒂亚斯愿意试一试。

paras.en: He remembered the exhilaration he’d felt when his soldiers had chopped the twisted ropes that held the catapult down.
paras.zh: 他还记得，当手下砍断固定投石机的扭曲绳索时，他心里那股兴奋劲儿。

paras.en: He’d laughed as he soared through the air.
paras.zh: 他腾空飞起时，还笑着。

paras.en: But his laughter changed to dread when he bounced off the mist, as if he’d hit an invisible wall.
paras.zh: 可当他像撞上隐形墙一样被迷雾弹回时，笑声变成了恐惧。

paras.en: His body flew back and crashed in a heap on the ground.
paras.zh: 他的身体飞回去，重重摔成一团。

paras.en: The fall left him with a heavily sprained arm that never worked properly again.
paras.zh: 这一摔，他的胳膊严重扭伤，从此再也没好利索。

paras.en: Just thinking about it made Mattias rub his shoulder.
paras.zh: 光是想想，马蒂亚斯就揉起了肩膀。

paras.en: The soldiers tested the catapult repeatedly over the next few months.
paras.zh: 接下来的几个月，士兵们反复试验那台投石机。

paras.en: A hammock was created to catch them when they bounced off the invisible wall.
paras.zh: 他们还做了个吊床，好在被隐形墙弹回时接住人。

paras.en: The volunteers were launched into different areas each time, but the results were always the same. “Hey, Yelana,” Mattias had called out one day. “Yeah?” she answered. “Four months, two weeks, and three days,” he said with a wink. “What’s that?” she asked, confused. “It’s how long we’ve been here,” he confirmed.
paras.zh: 每次志愿者都被发射到不同区域，结果却总是一模一样。“嘿，耶拉娜，”有一天马蒂亚斯喊道。“嗯？”她答。“四个月，两星期，又三天，”他眨眨眼说。“那是什么？”她不解地问。“是我们被困在这儿的时间，”他确认道。

paras.en: She shook her head. “Don’t remind me.” Yelana and the Northuldra had later come up with the idea of tunneling underneath the mist.
paras.zh: 她摇摇头。“别提醒我。”后来，耶拉娜和北地人想出了从迷雾底下打隧道的法子。

paras.en: Mattias had thought it was a great plan.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯觉得这主意不错。

paras.en: The Northuldra had provided them all with shovels made of wood and bone, and both sides had dug day and night for months.
paras.zh: 北地人给大家发了木头和骨头做的铲子，两边一连几个月日夜开挖。

paras.en: For years.
paras.zh: 一连好几年。

paras.en: But just like the invisible wall above the mist, there was one below the mist.
paras.zh: 可就像迷雾上方有堵隐形墙，下方也有一道。

paras.en: Their shovels bounced off it every time. “Hey, Mattias,” Yelana had crowed after some time had passed. “Yes, ma’am?” he asked. “Three years, seven months, one week, and two days.” He chuckled. “Don’t remind me.” A soldier had once tried to chop his way through the mist with an ax.
paras.zh: 他们的铲子每次都被弹回来。“嘿，马蒂亚斯，”过了一阵子，耶拉娜得意地喊。“在，长官？”他问。“三年，七个月，一星期，又两天。”他轻笑。“别提醒我。”曾有士兵想用斧头劈开迷雾。

paras.en: The ax had bounced back and flown out of his hand.
paras.zh: 斧头弹了回来，脱手飞出。

paras.en: Mattias had moved out of the way just as it sailed past his head.
paras.zh: 斧头擦着他头顶飞过时，马蒂亚斯刚好闪开。

paras.en: The two groups had refused to give up.
paras.zh: 两群人都不肯放弃。

paras.en: Again, the soldiers and Northuldra had worked together as areas of the mist were zoned for testing with axes.
paras.zh: 他们又合作起来，把迷雾划分成块，逐块用斧头测试。

paras.en: Only one person at a time had been allowed in each area, and every inch of the mist was tested for a weak spot.
paras.zh: 每块区域每次只允许一人进入，迷雾的每一寸都被试过，看有没有薄弱处。

paras.en: This had taken many years and caused many injuries.
paras.zh: 这花了许多年，也造成了许多伤。

paras.en: No signs of weakness in the mist were ever found. “Hey, Yelana!” Mattias had hollered at one point after receiving another ax scrape. “What?” she asked in an annoyed voice. “Seventeen years, eight months, three weeks, and five days.” She laughed and walked away.
paras.zh: 迷雾上始终没找到任何薄弱的迹象。“嘿，耶拉娜！”马蒂亚斯又一次被斧头刮伤后，有回大叫。“干嘛？”她不耐烦地问。“十七年，八个月，三星期，又五天。”她笑着走开了。

paras.en: The Northuldra were experts at climbing trees and mountains.
paras.zh: 北地人最擅长爬树攀山。

paras.en: Yelana had led them to the highest points to see how far up the invisible wall extended, but it didn’t matter how high they went, even up to the clouds.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜带他们爬到最高处，看那堵隐形墙往上延伸多高——可无论爬多高，哪怕爬到云端，都没用。

paras.en: Whenever they reached their hands out, their hands would always bounce back. “Hey, Mattias,” Yelana had growled after even more time had passed. “I know, I know,” he said with his hands up. “Twenty-four years, ten months, two weeks, and one day.” Yelana stared back at Mattias and wondered how he could be so naive.
paras.zh: 只要伸手去探，手总会弹回来。“嘿，马蒂亚斯，”又过了更久，耶拉娜低吼道。“知道知道，”他举起双手说，“二十四年，十个月，两星期，又一天。”耶拉娜盯着马蒂亚斯，心里纳闷他怎么还能这么天真。

paras.en: He had been there when King Runeard had arrived and promised her people friendship and cooperation.
paras.zh: 鲁尼德国王到来、向她的族人许下友谊与合作诺言时，他就在场。

paras.en: Together, they were supposed to have built a new world of greatness.
paras.zh: 他们本该携手建起一个伟大的新世界。

paras.en: She’d seen through the lies.
paras.zh: 她早就看穿了那些谎言。

paras.en: She’d seen the way King Runeard had looked at her people, as if he was better than them.
paras.zh: 她见过鲁尼德国王看她族人的眼神，仿佛他高人一等。

paras.en: When the children had danced and played with the magic of wind and fire, he had shaken his head and frowned.
paras.zh: 当孩子们借着风与火的魔法起舞嬉戏时，他摇头皱眉。

paras.en: She could sense his hatred.
paras.zh: 她能感觉到他的憎恨。

paras.en: But their leader had wanted to see the best in their new allies.
paras.zh: 可他们的首领却愿意相信新盟友善良的一面。

paras.en: He’d blindly agreed to their terms and let them in.
paras.zh: 他盲目地答应了对方的条件，把他们放了进来。

paras.en: Yelana didn’t understand why Mattias believed that nature had rewarded Elsa with magic.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜不明白，马蒂亚斯为何相信是自然把魔法赏赐给了艾莎。

paras.en: She felt sorry for him.
paras.zh: 她替他感到悲哀。

paras.en: Maybe he didn’t know any better and really believed he’d served a great king.
paras.zh: 也许他只是不懂，真心以为自己侍奉过一位伟大的国王。

paras.en: Yelana had never fully trusted him or any of the soldiers, but she had been willing to work with them so she could keep them close.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜从没完全信任过他或任何士兵，但她愿意与他们合作，只为把他们留在眼皮底下。

paras.en: She’d instructed her people to stay away from the soldiers during any other times—they’d interacted only when sharing tools and ideas to escape the mist.
paras.zh: 她叮嘱族人在其他时候远离士兵——只有交换工具、商讨逃出迷雾的计策时，双方才打交代。

paras.en: She alone had dealt with Mattias directly.
paras.zh: 只有她一个人直接跟马蒂亚斯打交道。

paras.en: As the years passed, Mattias truly seemed to accept her people and want to help.
paras.zh: 年复一年，马蒂亚斯似乎真的接纳了她的族人，想要帮忙。

paras.en: But Yelana had always remembered how she had thought King Runeard had seemed like a good man, too.
paras.zh: 可耶拉娜始终记得，自己也曾以为鲁尼德国王是个好人。

paras.en: And with him she’d made a mistake—one she would never make again.
paras.zh: 而在他身上，她犯过一次错——一个她绝不会再犯的错。

paras.en: “I got this,” Olaf said confidently as he moved out from behind Elsa and waddled forward. “Hi, I’m Olaf.” The Northuldra and Arendellians alike screamed, shouted, and slipped as they attempted to get away from the walking, talking snowman.
paras.zh: “交给我，”雪宝自信地说着，从艾莎身后挪出来，一摇一摆走上前。“嗨，我是雪宝。”北地人和阿伦黛尔人齐声尖叫、惊呼，拼命想躲开这个会走会说的雪人，脚下直打滑。

paras.en: Olaf looked down at himself, and then back up at the frightened people. “Oh, sorry,” he said. “Yeah, I just find clothes restricting.
paras.zh: 雪宝低头看看自己，又抬头看看那些受惊的人。“哦，抱歉，”他说，“是啊，我只是觉得衣服太束缚了。

paras.en: But you’re wondering who we are and why we’re here.” As if he were on a stage, performing a one-snowman show under a spotlight, Olaf started his dramatization. “It began with two sisters.
paras.zh: 但你们一定想知道我们是谁、来这儿干什么。”雪宝仿佛站在舞台上、聚光灯下演独角戏，开始了他的表演。“故事从两姐妹开始。

paras.en: One born with magical powers.
paras.zh: 一个生来就有魔法。

paras.en: One born powerless.” The Northuldra and the Arendellian soldiers stared. “Anna, no!
paras.zh: 一个生来毫无魔力。”北地人和阿伦黛尔士兵愣愣地看。“安娜，不！

paras.en: Too high!
paras.zh: 太高了！

paras.en: BLAST!” Olaf fell to the ground, then quickly got back to his feet and channeled Elsa. “NO!
paras.zh: 爆裂！”雪宝扑倒在地，又迅速爬起，模仿起艾莎。“不！

paras.en: Mama, Papa, HELP!” Mattias looked on as the snowman continued to act out key moments in the sisters’ lives. “SLAM!
paras.zh: 爸爸妈妈，救命！”雪人继续演绎姐妹俩人生中的关键片段，马蒂亚斯在一旁看着。“砰！

paras.en: Doors shutting everywhere!
paras.zh: 到处是关上的门！

paras.en: Sisters torn apart!” Olaf walked around, taking on the gait and mannerisms of each person he was portraying. “Well, at least they have their parents,” Olaf said in a soft voice.
paras.zh: 姐妹被拆散！”雪宝走来走去，学着他扮演的每个人的步态和神态。“唔，至少她们还有父母，”雪宝轻声说。

paras.en: Then his voice changed and became completely void of emotion: “Their parents are dead.” Next, he dramatized Elsa’s little sister. “Hi, I’m Anna.
paras.zh: 接着他换了一种声音，毫无感情地说：“她们的爸妈死了。”随后，他演起艾莎的小妹。“嗨，我是安娜。

paras.en: I’ll marry a man I just met.” Anna wanted to melt into the ground.
paras.zh: 我要嫁给一个刚认识的男人。”安娜恨不得融进地里。

paras.en: Although no one there knew who she was, it felt as if they had all been clued in on her biggest, most horrifying secret.
paras.zh: 尽管在场没一个人认识她，却仿佛人人都知道了她最大、最可怕的秘密。

paras.en: She mentally prodded Olaf to move on to another subject. “Elsa’s gonna blow!” Olaf shouted. “Snow!
paras.zh: 她在心里戳了戳雪宝，催他换个话题。“艾莎要炸了！”雪宝大喊。“雪！

paras.en: Snow!
paras.zh: 雪！

paras.en: AAHHH!
paras.zh: 啊啊啊！

paras.en: Run!” Olaf began to hum a wildly off-tune melody that seemed as if it should have been majestic. “Magic pulses through my snowflakes,” he said, and then pulled in a deep breath of air before shouting, “I live!” He held his twig arms over his head.
paras.zh: 快跑！”雪宝哼起一段荒腔走板的调子，本该庄严却全然跑调。“魔力在我的雪花里跳动，”他说着深吸一口气，大喊：“我活着！”他把小树枝胳膊举过头顶。

paras.en: He took a stroll, gesturing like Elsa did when she made magical creations. “Ice palace for one, ice palace for one.
paras.zh: 他踱起步来，比划着艾莎施展魔法造物时的手势。“冰宫殿，单人住，冰宫殿，单人住。

paras.en: Get out, Anna!
paras.zh: 出去，安娜！

paras.en: Pew, pew! ” Olaf spun around and staggered in what Anna felt was a completely fabricated performance. “My heart!” he gasped.
paras.zh: 咻，咻！”雪宝转着圈，踉跄几步——安娜觉得这演得完全是他瞎编的。“我的心！”他倒抽一口气。

paras.en: Mattias’s eyes widened. “Oh my goodness….” “Only an act of true love can save you,” Olaf continued, his voice deepening as he did what he thought was a spot-on impersonation of Grand Pabbie.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯瞪大了眼。“哦，天哪……”“只有真爱之举才能救你，”雪宝继续道，声音低沉下来，自以为是惟妙惟肖地模仿皮比大仙。

paras.en: Kristoff clapped, but after a look from Anna, he let his hands drop to his sides. “Here’s a true-love’s kiss.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫鼓起掌，可看了安娜一眼，又把两手垂回身侧。“来一个真爱之吻。

paras.en: You’re not worth it.
paras.zh: 你配不上。

paras.en: Guess what?
paras.zh: 你猜怎么着？

paras.en: I’m the bad guy!” Olaf exclaimed, as Hans. “What?” Mattias shouted. “Then Anna freezes to death…forever.” Mattias wiped at the tears that sprang to his eyes. “Oh, Anna.” “Then she unfreezes!” Olaf shouted.
paras.zh: 我是大反派！”雪宝扮起汉斯，惊呼道。“什么？”马蒂亚斯喊。“然后安娜冻死了……永远。”马蒂亚斯抹去涌上眼眶的泪。“哦，安娜。”“然后她又解冻了！”雪宝喊。

paras.en: The snowman took a big breath and finished his story. “Oh, and then Elsa woke up the magical spirits, and we were forced out of our kingdom.
paras.zh: 雪人深吸一口气，讲完了故事。“哦，对了，后来艾莎唤醒了魔法之灵，我们被赶出了王国。

paras.en: Now our only hope is to find the truth about the past, but we don’t have a clue how to do that.
paras.zh: 如今我们唯一的希望是找出过去的真相，可我们一点头绪都没有。

paras.en: Except Elsa’s hearing voices.
paras.zh: 除了艾莎听见了声音。

paras.en: So we got that going for us.
paras.zh: 所以这点还算有点指望。

paras.en: Any questions?” The Northuldra and the Arendellians had long since stopped trying to flee.
paras.zh: 还有什么问题吗？”北地人和阿伦黛尔人早就不逃了。

paras.en: They sat where they had fallen, transfixed both by the tale and the living snowman.
paras.zh: 他们坐在摔倒的地方，被这个故事和这个活雪人同时吸引住了。

paras.en: No one knew how to react…to either. “I think they got it,” Olaf whispered loudly to Anna and Elsa.
paras.zh: 谁都不知道该怎么反应……对哪样都不知道。“我觉得他们听懂了，”雪宝大声地小声对安娜和艾莎说。

paras.en: With one motion of her hands, Elsa wiped away the ice on the ground.
paras.zh: 艾莎双手一挥，抹去了地上的冰。

paras.en: The lieutenant took his time getting to his feet.
paras.zh: 中尉不慌不忙地站起身。

paras.en: And when he did, he offered his hand to Yelana.
paras.zh: 站起后，他向耶拉娜伸出手。

paras.en: The Northuldra woman frowned at him but accepted his help nonetheless.
paras.zh: 那北地女子朝他皱了皱眉，却还是接受了他搀扶。

paras.en: As soon as she stood, they parted, as if the assistance had never happened. “Are you really Queen of Arendelle?” Mattias asked as they approached the sisters. “I am,” Elsa said. “Why would nature reward a person of Arendelle with magic?” Yelana asked, her expression showing her confusion. “Perhaps to make up for the actions of your people,” Mattias responded as he turned to face her.
paras.zh: 她一站稳，两人便分开，仿佛那次搀扶从未发生。“你真是阿伦黛尔的女王？”他们走近姐妹俩时，马蒂亚斯问。“我是，”艾莎说。“自然为何要把魔法赏给阿伦黛尔的人？”耶拉娜一脸困惑地问。“或许是为了弥补你们族人的所作所为，”马蒂亚斯转向她答道。

paras.en: Yelana’s eyes hardened. “My people are innocent.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜目光一凛。“我的族人是无辜的。

paras.en: We would never attack first.” Anna and Elsa watched the decades-old enemies rehash an argument they seemed to have had many times before.
paras.zh: 我们绝不会先动手。”安娜和艾莎看着这对几十年的老对头，重提似乎吵过许多次的争执。

paras.en: But it still bothered Anna that she couldn’t recall where she knew Mattias from.
paras.zh: 可安娜还是想不起来在哪儿见过马蒂亚斯，这让她有点在意。

paras.en: She framed the lieutenant’s face with her fingers, making a square.
paras.zh: 她用手指在脸前比了个方框，框住中尉的脸。

paras.en: She closed one eye and looked through the square at him, changing the angle and size of the square as well as her position. “May the truth be found,” he said.
paras.zh: 她闭上一只眼，透过方框看他，不断调整方框的角度、大小，还有自己的位置。“愿真相被找到，”他说。

paras.en: Then he caught sight of Anna. “Hi.
paras.zh: 这时他看清了安娜。“嗨。

paras.en: I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 抱歉。

paras.en: What’s happening?” Anna didn’t answer, too intent on her task. “This is different,” he said. “To the left,” Anna instructed. “Right.” “Okay…this?” he asked, trying to follow her directions. “This side?” “No, left,” she corrected him. “Sure?” Mattias moved again. “Ugh.” “Now look like you have just a little bit of indigestion,” she said.
paras.zh: 怎么回事？”安娜没答，只顾着手上的事。“这样不对，”他说。“往左，”安娜指挥。“右边。”“好……是这样吗？”他试着照她的话做。“这边？”“不，左边，”她纠正。“确定？”马蒂亚斯又挪了挪。“呃。”“现在摆出一副有点消化不良的样子，”她说。

paras.en: Mattias made one last move. “That’s it!” Anna shouted in excitement, causing a few people nearby to jump at her sudden burst of energy. “Lieutenant Mattias!
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯最后挪了一下。“就是了！”安娜兴奋地喊，突如其来的一嗓子把旁边几个人吓了一跳。“马蒂亚斯中尉！

paras.en: Library, second portrait on the right!
paras.zh: 图书馆里，右边第二幅画像！

paras.en: You were our father’s official guard.” Mattias’s eyes narrowed as what Anna was saying sank into his head.
paras.zh: 你是我们父亲的御前侍卫。”马蒂亚斯眯起眼，安娜的话慢慢渗进他脑海。

paras.en: Then he looked right at her, and at Elsa, who had walked up behind her sister.
paras.zh: 接着他直直看向她，又看向走到妹妹身后的艾莎。

paras.en: He suddenly realized who the two of them were. “Agnarr…he was lost at sea?” “Yes,” Anna said, sadness creeping into her voice, as it always did when she thought about the loss of her parents. “Our parents’ ship went down in the Southern Sea six years ago.” The four Arendellian soldiers and Mattias bowed their heads out of respect to their fallen king and queen.
paras.zh: 他忽然认出了她们是谁。“安格瑞……他是葬身大海了？”“是的，”安娜说，声音里又泛起哀伤——每次想到父母的离去都是如此，“六年前，我们父母的船在南大洋沉了。”四名阿伦黛尔士兵和马蒂亚斯垂下头，向逝去的国王和王后致哀。

paras.en: When Mattias looked up, he regarded the sisters with compassion. “I see him,” he said, looking back and forth between the two of them. “I see him in your faces.” Anna was flattered to hear his words.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯抬起头，怜爱地看着姐妹俩。“我看见他了，”他说，在两人之间来回打量，“我在你们脸上看见他了。”安娜听了这话受宠若惊。

paras.en: She looked at her sister, gauging her excitement before meeting Mattias’s gaze.
paras.zh: 她望向姐姐，先揣摩她的激动，才迎上马蒂亚斯的目光。

paras.en: She was thrilled to know she reminded someone of her father. “Really?” said Anna. “He’d have been so happy to know you’re okay.” “Soldiers,” Mattias commanded with a signal.
paras.zh: 想到自己让人想起父亲，她满心欢喜。“真的吗？”安娜说，“知道你们平安，他该多高兴啊。”“士兵们，”马蒂亚斯打了个手势下令。

paras.en: The soldiers and shield maiden fell into a formation behind Elsa.
paras.zh: 士兵们和持盾女战士在艾莎身后列队。

paras.en: They had recognized her as their queen, and with their formal military stance, they offered their support.
paras.zh: 他们认出她是自己的女王，以正式的军姿表达效忠。

paras.en: But the atmosphere of the camp shifted dramatically when the Arendellians moved into formation.
paras.zh: 可阿伦黛尔人一列队，营地的气氛骤变。

paras.en: The Northuldra whispered and paced nervously, even though Mattias smiled at Yelana.
paras.zh: 北地人交头接耳，不安地踱步，尽管马蒂亚斯还朝耶拉娜微笑。

paras.en: Elsa felt the discomfort as well as saw it. “Please,” said Elsa, her tone soothing as she tried to calm them all. “Someone called me here.
paras.zh: 艾莎既看在眼里，也感同身受。“求你们，”艾莎语气轻柔，想安抚所有人，“是有人把我召唤到这里的。

paras.en: If I can just find them, I believe they have answers that may help free this forest.” Elsa smiled, hoping her words would raise everyone’s spirits. “Trust me, I just want to help.” But the Northuldra had trusted before, and it had been to their detriment. “We only trust nature,” said Yelana. “When nature speaks—” Yelana was interrupted by a fireball shooting up behind Elsa, catching the leaves of a tree on fire.
paras.zh: 只要我找到他们，相信他们有答案，能帮这片森林获得自由。”艾莎微笑着，希望这话能鼓舞大家。“相信我，我只想帮忙。”可北地人曾经信过别人，结果吃了大亏。“我们只信自然，”耶拉娜说，“当自然开口——”耶拉娜的话被艾莎身后窜起的一颗火球打断，火苗点着了树叶。

paras.en: Yelana waited a beat, then finished. “We listen.”
paras.zh: 耶拉娜顿了一下，把话说完。“我们就听。”

paras.en: Suddenly, a bright flash of fire whipped out from behind a nearby tree in a blur, then vanished as quickly as it had appeared.
paras.zh: 忽然，一道明亮的火光从附近一棵树后疾掠而出，一闪即逝，快得和出现时一样。

paras.en: Everyone stood on guard, looking around, trying to see where it had gone.
paras.zh: 人人严阵以待，四下张望，想看清它去了哪里。

paras.en: BOOM!
paras.zh: 轰！

paras.en: The tree it had come from behind lit up, blazing with flames. “FIRE SPIRIT!” Yelana shouted.
paras.zh: 它身后那棵树瞬间燃起熊熊火焰。“火灵！”耶拉娜喊道。

paras.en: Olaf backed away.
paras.zh: 雪宝连连后退。

paras.en: While he didn’t know what a Fire Spirit was, and even though he was now made of permafrost, he was still aware that it wasn’t a good idea to be too close to fire.
paras.zh: 虽然他不知道火灵是什么，尽管如今他由永冻冰做成，他仍清楚离火太近绝不是好事。

paras.en: But this fire looked different from any he had ever seen.
paras.zh: 可这火看上去和以往见过的都不一样。

paras.en: The flames weren’t purely red and orange—Olaf saw hints of purple, too.
paras.zh: 火焰不单是红与橙——雪宝还看出了紫色。

paras.en: And the flames were as terrifying as they were fascinating. “This will all make sense when I am older,” Olaf said to himself. “Get back, everyone!” Yelana ordered, wanting nothing more than to keep her people safe.
paras.zh: 而这火焰既恐怖又迷人。“等我长大就都明白了，”雪宝对自己说。“大家都退后！”耶拉娜下令，她只想着保族人平安。

paras.en: All around, the Northuldra grabbed their children and their essentials, trying to keep away from the fire as much as they could. “Head for the river!” Mattias yelled.
paras.zh: 四周的北地人抱起孩子和要紧物事，尽量远离火焰。“往河边跑！”马蒂亚斯大喊。

paras.en: The Fire Spirit began to move, leaving a trail of the magical fire in its wake.
paras.zh: 火灵动了起来，身后拖出一道魔法之火。

paras.en: There appeared to be no logic to its direction.
paras.zh: 它行进的方向似乎毫无章法。

paras.en: Arendellians and the Northuldra ran around in confusion, having no idea which way the fire trail would go.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔人和北地人慌乱地四处奔逃，根本不知道火线会往哪儿烧。

paras.en: Elsa raced after them, wanting to help any way she could.
paras.zh: 艾莎追在他们后面跑，想尽己所能帮忙。

paras.en: The trail sparked and popped in the dry brush, and stray flames began new paths of their own.
paras.zh: 火线在干枯的灌木丛中噼啪迸溅，零星的火苗又自己开辟出新路。

paras.en: Flames sped up a shrub, then a tree.
paras.zh: 火苗窜上一丛灌木，又窜上一棵树。

paras.en: They appeared in the grasses.
paras.zh: 草丛里也冒出了火。

paras.en: They consumed and the fire grew, taking on a life of its own.
paras.zh: 火越烧越旺，仿佛有了自己的生命。

paras.en: The heat and the crackling flames added to the confusion.
paras.zh: 热浪和噼啪作响的火焰更添混乱。

paras.en: The Northuldra reindeer pawed the ground nervously.
paras.zh: 北地人的驯鹿不安地刨着地面。

paras.en: One of them panicked and ran off.
paras.zh: 其中一头受惊跑开了。

paras.en: The rest of them followed, their hooves thundering as they galloped past. “No, no, no!
paras.zh: 其余的跟着跑，蹄声如雷，奔腾而过。“不不不！

paras.en: The reindeer!” a Northuldra man named Ryder shouted as their movement caught his attention. “That’s a dead end!” Kristoff turned and saw that the reindeer had bolted out of the area, and he knew there wasn’t any time to waste. “Come on, Sven.
paras.zh: 那些驯鹿！”一个叫莱德的北地男子见状大喊，“那是死路！”克里斯托夫转头看见驯鹿已冲出那片地方，知道一刻也不能耽误。“快，斯文。

paras.en: We’ll get them!” With a quick leap, he hopped on Sven and they raced after the runaway reindeer, even as fire threatened to close their path.
paras.zh: 我们去拦住它们！”他纵身一跃跳上斯文，朝逃跑的驯鹿追去，哪怕火焰正要封住去路。

paras.en: But Elsa saw what was happening.
paras.zh: 可艾莎看出了端倪。

paras.en: She spun around and blasted her ice, widening the opening through the fire in front of them.
paras.zh: 她转身喷出冰霜，把前方火焰间的缺口拓宽。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven leaped through it.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文一跃穿过。

paras.en: Anna, who had been helping the Northuldra gather up their things and get to the river, turned to find that Elsa wasn’t directly behind her.
paras.zh: 安娜一直在帮北地人收拾东西、往河边撤，这时转身发现艾莎不在自己正后方。

paras.en: Instead, her sister was in the heart of the fire, her face intent as she used her power to battle the flames. “Elsa!
paras.zh: 相反，姐姐正身处火心，神情专注地用魔力对抗烈焰。“艾莎！

paras.en: Get out of there!” Anna shouted.
paras.zh: 快出来！”安娜喊。

paras.en: Anna struggled against the waves of people running for their lives as she headed closer to the flames instead of away from them.
paras.zh: 安娜逆着四散逃命的人潮，不往外却往火边挤去。

paras.en: She was determined to get back to her sister. “Elsa!” she called again.
paras.zh: 她打定主意要回到姐姐身边。“艾莎！”她又喊了一声。

paras.en: The heat of the raging fire got stronger the closer she got to her sister, and the smoke flooded her lungs with every breath she took.
paras.zh: 离姐姐越近，烈火的热浪越猛，每吸一口气，烟都灌满她的肺。

paras.en: But she continued.
paras.zh: 可她脚步不停。

paras.en: Anna refused to leave Elsa.
paras.zh: 安娜不肯丢下艾莎。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven caught up with the terrified reindeer.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文追上了受惊的驯鹿。

paras.en: They pranced and grunted nervously in a small area where the exits were blocked by fallen trees and fire.
paras.zh: 在出口被倒木和火焰堵死的一小块空地上，它们不安地腾跃、哼叫。

paras.en: Their unease, and the closeness of the flames, bothered Sven as well.
paras.zh: 它们的不安，加上近在咫尺的火焰，也让斯文烦躁。

paras.en: Kristoff patted his neck to reassure him. “Come on, buddy,” Kristoff coaxed.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫拍拍他的脖子安抚他。“来吧，老伙计，”克里斯托夫哄道。

paras.en: There was something about the interaction between Sven and Kristoff that calmed the other reindeer—at least enough that the duo was able to lead them safely away from the flames that were starting to sprout up at the dead end.
paras.zh: 斯文和克里斯托夫之间的互动，不知怎的让其他驯鹿也平静下来——至少足以让这俩人带着它们安全避开死路上窜起的火苗。

paras.en: They raced back at full speed.
paras.zh: 他们全速往回冲。

paras.en: Kristoff felt an urgency to make sure his friends were safe. “We can do this.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫心急如焚，只想确保朋友们平安。“我们能做到。

paras.en: Hiya!” One by one, the reindeer jumped through the flaming bushes until they were safely in the clearing.
paras.zh: 驾！”驯鹿一头接一头跳过燃烧的灌木，直到全部安全落到空地上。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven had done it!
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文成功了！

paras.en: Ryder and a few of the other Northuldra rushed forward to care for the reindeer.
paras.zh: 莱德和另外几个北地人冲上前照料驯鹿。

paras.en: Ryder looked at Kristoff gratefully.
paras.zh: 莱德感激地看着克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Kristoff smiled.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫笑了。

paras.en: Now it was time to find Anna.
paras.zh: 现在该去找安娜了。

paras.en: Kristoff looked around the flames and smoke, searching everywhere for a glimpse of her.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫在火焰与浓烟中四下张望，拼命寻找她的身影。

paras.en: When he finally found her, what he saw terrified him. “Anna!” Kristoff yelled, frightened for her life.
paras.zh: 当他终于找到她时，眼前的景象令他胆寒。“安娜！”克里斯托夫为她的安危惊恐大喊。

paras.en: Flames surrounded Anna and were closing in.
paras.zh: 火焰围着安娜，正不断收紧。

paras.en: Only one person could help Kristoff save her: Elsa.
paras.zh: 能帮克里斯托夫救她的，只有一个人：艾莎。

paras.en: She had been so busy trying to control the fire that she hadn’t seen the danger her sister was in.
paras.zh: 她一直忙着控制火势，没看见妹妹身陷险境。

paras.en: When she finally saw the threat to Anna, she changed her tactics. ­ Nothing can happen to her!
paras.zh: 等她终于看到安娜的危情，立刻改变策略。她绝不能有事！

paras.en: Elsa thought, spinning around and throwing out her magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎想，转身释放出魔力。

paras.en: She created a hole in the flames just large enough for Kristoff and Sven to get through and reach Anna.
paras.zh: 她在火焰中开出一个刚好够克里斯托夫和斯文穿过、够到安娜的洞。

paras.en: It was getting harder and harder for Anna to breathe as she lay on the forest floor, wondering how to get to Elsa.
paras.zh: 安娜躺在林地上，呼吸越来越困难，一心想着怎么到艾莎身边。

paras.en: She didn’t hear the sounds of hooves and Kristoff’s voice.
paras.zh: 她没听见蹄声，也没听见克里斯托夫的声音。

paras.en: She didn’t even know they were there until Kristoff grabbed her, swung her up onto Sven, and the three of them exited the same way that Sven and Kristoff had come in. “Get her out of here!” Elsa shouted.
paras.zh: 直到克里斯托夫一把抓住她、把她甩上斯文，三人顺着斯文和克里斯托夫进来的路撤出，她才知道他们在。“把她带出去！”艾莎喊。

paras.en: She had been filled with fear, knowing all she could do was watch as Kristoff went after Anna.
paras.zh: 她满心恐惧，知道自己只能眼睁睁看着克里斯托夫去救安娜。

paras.en: Now that her sister was safe, she wanted her to run. “No, Elsa!” Anna cried, her voice hoarse from the smoke.
paras.zh: 既然妹妹安全了，她想让她快跑。“不，艾莎！”安娜哭喊，声音被烟呛得沙哑。

paras.en: They couldn’t just leave her sister behind!
paras.zh: 她们不能就这么把姐姐丢下！

paras.en: But Kristoff didn’t stop, and neither did Sven.
paras.zh: 可克里斯托夫没停，斯文也没停。

paras.en: The fire had been too close to Anna, and they wouldn’t let anything happen to her.
paras.zh: 火离安娜太近了，他们绝不让她出半点差池。

paras.en: Elsa ran toward the flames.
paras.zh: 艾莎朝火焰跑去。

paras.en: She hadn’t even heard Anna call after her.
paras.zh: 她甚至没听见安娜在身后喊她。

paras.en: It was up to HER to put out the fire, and she would do whatever she could to stop it.
paras.zh: 灭火只能靠她自己，她会不惜一切把它扑灭。

paras.en: The inferno tore through the Northuldra camp, relentless and unforgiving.
paras.zh: 那场烈火席卷北地人的营地，毫不留情。

paras.en: Elsa fought to control as much of the damage as possible.
paras.zh: 艾莎奋力把破坏控制到最小。

paras.en: And then she saw it…the fireball that had started everything.
paras.zh: 接着她看见了它……那颗引发一切的火球。

paras.en: It danced, it darted, it circled, and she followed it.
paras.zh: 它蹦跳、疾窜、打转，她就一路跟着。

paras.en: She had been blasting the flames it had left behind, and they hadn’t gone out, at least not all the way.
paras.zh: 她一直在喷射它留下的火苗，可火没灭，至少没全灭。

paras.en: She hadn’t been able to make a dent in the blaze.
paras.zh: 她根本没能伤那大火分毫。

paras.en: It was time for a new plan.
paras.zh: 是时候换套新法子了。

paras.en: Elsa threw the full force of her powers on the fireball’s blazing trail.
paras.zh: 艾莎把全身魔力倾泻在火球燃烧的轨迹上。

paras.en: She chased it until it was contained beneath a rocky overhang, where the flames seemed to lessen.
paras.zh: 她一路追，直到把它逼到一处岩石悬檐下，那里的火势似乎弱了些。

paras.en: Curious, Elsa bent down and studied what was left of the fire.
paras.zh: 艾莎好奇地弯下腰，端详火剩下来的东西。

paras.en: Two tiny, terrified eyes stared up at her.
paras.zh: 一双小小的、惊恐的眼睛抬头望着她。

paras.en: This is the Fire Spirit? she asked herself.
paras.zh: 这就是火灵？她暗自问。

paras.en: The powerful, fearsome Fire Spirit?
paras.zh: 那个强大、可怕的火灵？

paras.en: It looked just like a little salamander.
paras.zh: 它看上去就像只小蝾螈。

paras.en: But if anyone knew that appearances could be deceiving, it was Elsa.
paras.zh: 但若说有谁懂得“人不可貌相”，那便是艾莎。

paras.en: The salamander whimpered, and a blast of fire shot from its mouth, aimed directly at a tree behind Elsa.
paras.zh: 小蝾螈呜咽一声，喷出一道火，直冲艾莎身后一棵树。

paras.en: But she was quick, and she froze the fire in midair, creating a spectacular display that hung there for the briefest of moments and was gone.
paras.zh: 但她手疾眼快，把那道火冻在半空，凝成一场转瞬即逝的奇景。

paras.en: The salamander looked from their joint creation and back to her.
paras.zh: 小蝾螈看看他们共同的“作品”，又看看她。

paras.en: With one webbed foot raised, it took a hesitant step toward Elsa, moving ever so slowly, like a frightened puppy.
paras.zh: 它抬起一只带蹼的脚，朝艾莎迟疑地迈了一步，慢得像个受惊的小狗。

paras.en: Elsa was deeply touched.
paras.zh: 艾莎深受触动。

paras.en: She wondered if the creature had been hurt in the past, or misunderstood.
paras.zh: 她猜想，这小家伙是不是曾经受过伤，或被误解。

paras.en: Those were feelings she could easily relate to.
paras.zh: 这些感受，她太能共鸣了。

paras.en: She crouched down closer to the rock and leaned in, then stretched a hand out to the Fire Spirit.
paras.zh: 她蹲得更低，凑近岩石，然后向火灵伸出一只手。

paras.en: The salamander slowly came forward and climbed onto her hand.
paras.zh: 小蝾螈慢慢上前，爬上她的手。

paras.en: It appeared to be relieved by the touch of Elsa’s cold skin, making itself comfortable as it settled in, sizzling on her palm. “Oh!” Elsa yelped in surprise. “Ow, ow.” She winced from the salamander’s heat, but the most important thing was for the creature to feel safe.
paras.zh: 碰上艾莎冰凉的皮肤，它似乎松了口气，舒舒服服地安顿下来，在掌心嘶嘶作响。“哦！”艾莎惊讶地叫。“嗷，嗷。”被蝾螈烫到，她龇牙咧嘴，可眼下最重要的是让小家伙感到安全。

paras.en: A thought came to her.
paras.zh: 她冒出一个念头。

paras.en: She created snowflakes on the tips of her fingers and let them drift down to the Fire Spirit.
paras.zh: 她在指尖凝出雪花，让它们飘落到火灵身上。

paras.en: The salamander looked at them curiously before darting out its tongue and catching them.
paras.zh: 小蝾螈好奇地看着，随后吐出舌头把雪花卷住。

paras.en: As the Fire Spirit ate them, the flames on its back eased and the fire in the trees around them lessened.
paras.zh: 火灵吃着雪花，背上的火焰渐弱，四周树上的火也小了。

paras.en: It playfully shot out a tiny burst of fire to pop another snowflake, then snuggled in the crevices of Elsa’s hand.
paras.zh: 它顽皮地喷出一小簇火，炸开另一片雪花，然后蜷进艾莎手心的纹路里。

paras.en: The fire went out in the other areas of the forest.
paras.zh: 森林其他地方的大火也灭了。

paras.en: Footsteps crept up behind Elsa.
paras.zh: 艾莎身后响起了轻轻的脚步声。

paras.en: She sighed.
paras.zh: 她叹了口气。

paras.en: The moments she had just shared with the Fire Spirit had been so…magical. “They’re all looking at us, aren’t they?” she whispered to her new friend.
paras.zh: 方才与火灵共度的片刻，如此……神奇。“他们都在看我们，对吧？”她对新朋友耳语。

paras.en: She turned her head and glanced over her shoulder.
paras.zh: 她转过头，从肩上看了一眼。

paras.en: A crowd stood about five feet away, looking and whispering.
paras.zh: 大约五步开外站着一群人，正望着、窃窃私语。

paras.en: More people were approaching, many of them with their eyes wide in amazement. “Got any advice?” Elsa whispered to the Fire Spirit, who stared at her unblinkingly. “No?
paras.zh: 更多人正走过来，许多人瞪大了惊奇的眼。“有啥建议没？”艾莎对火灵耳语，火灵一眨不眨地盯着她。“没有？

paras.en: Nothing?” The Fire Spirit licked its eye. “Hmm, should I know what that means?” Then the mysterious voice broke through, haunting and eerie, pushing to the front of everything that was happening.
paras.zh: 啥也没有？”火灵舔了舔眼睛。“嗯，这动作是什么意思我该懂吗？”这时，那神秘的声音穿透而来，诡谲而幽远，盖过了周遭一切。

paras.en: It became the only thing Elsa could focus on.
paras.zh: 它成了艾莎唯一能专注的东西。

paras.en: And she noticed that for the first time, someone else was focused on it, too.
paras.zh: 她注意到，这是头一回，还有别人也在专注着它。

paras.en: The Fire Spirit looked around, searching for the source of the voice.
paras.zh: 火灵四下张望，寻找那声音的来源。

paras.en: And then just as quickly as it had begun, it stopped.
paras.zh: 然后，它停了——停得和开始时一样突然。

paras.en: Elsa turned to her friend. “You hear it, too?” she asked. “Somebody’s calling us.
paras.zh: 艾莎转向朋友。“你也听见了？”她问，“有人在召唤我们。

paras.en: Who is it?
paras.zh: 会是谁？

paras.en: What do we do?” The salamander hopped out of her hand and ran up a rock, its head angled to look at something far in the distance.
paras.zh: 我们该怎么办？”小蝾螈从她手上跳下，跑上岩石，歪着头望向远方某处。

paras.en: Then the Fire Spirit turned back to her. “Okay, keep going north,” Elsa interpreted.
paras.zh: 接着火灵转回身对着她。“好吧，继续往北走，”艾莎会意道。

paras.en: The salamander glowed bright for a moment, then disappeared over the top of the rock. “Elsa!” She turned at the sound of her sister’s voice, and the smile that crossed her face when Anna appeared was brilliant.
paras.zh: 小蝾螈亮了一下，便从岩顶消失了。“艾莎！”她循声转头，安娜出现时，她脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。

paras.en: Elsa moved toward her and wrapped her arms around her little sister, relieved that she was okay. “Oh, thank goodness,” Anna said, hugging Elsa back just as tightly. “Anna,” Elsa reprimanded.
paras.zh: 艾莎迎上去，双臂搂住小妹，为她平安而宽慰。“哦，谢天谢地，”安娜说，同样紧紧回抱。“安娜，”艾莎嗔怪道。

paras.en: Now that she knew her sister was safe, she was angry that Anna had been foolish to not get to a safe part of the forest with the others.
paras.zh: 既然知道妹妹平安，她便恼火安娜竟傻得没和别人一起撤到森林安全处。

paras.en: She pulled away and frowned. “What were you doing?
paras.zh: 她退开一步，皱起眉。“你刚才在干什么？

paras.en: You could have been killed.
paras.zh: 你差点就没命了。

paras.en: You can’t just follow me into fire.” “You don’t want me to follow you into fire,” Anna argued, “then don’t run into fire!
paras.zh: 你不能就这么跟着我进火里。”“你不想我跟着你进火里，”安娜反驳，“那你就别往火里冲！

paras.en: You’re not being careful, Elsa.” Elsa took a deep breath and actually heard the words Anna said.
paras.zh: 你太不小心了，艾莎。”艾莎深吸一口气，真的听进了安娜的话。

paras.en: That helped her calm down.
paras.zh: 这话让她平静下来。

paras.en: Anna always had her best interests in mind, and she would have done the same thing. “I’m sorry.
paras.zh: 安娜总是为她着想，换作她也会一样。“对不起。

paras.en: Are you okay?” “I’ve been better,” Anna responded.
paras.zh: 你还好吗？”“比现在好不到哪去，”安娜答。

paras.en: Kristoff and Olaf remained silent as they came up behind the girls with Sven.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和雪宝默默跟在女孩们身后，带着斯文走来。

paras.en: It was not the time or place for them to interrupt.
paras.zh: 此刻此景，不是他们插话的时机。

paras.en: But they had never seen the girls fight before, and their concern was evident on their faces. “Hmm, I know what you need.” Elsa reached for the satchel that Anna carried and tugged on the corner of their mother’s scarf dangling from the side.
paras.zh: 可他们从没见女孩们吵过架，脸上写满担忧。“嗯，我知道你需要什么。”艾莎伸手去够安娜背的挎包，拽出垂在侧边的母亲围巾一角。

paras.en: She pulled it out of the bag and wrapped it around her sister’s shoulders.
paras.zh: 她把围巾从包里抽出来，披在妹妹肩上。

paras.en: The Northuldra around them gasped, turning to one another and whispering.
paras.zh: 周围的北地人倒吸一口气，转头彼此低语。

paras.en: Yelana moved through the crowd, approaching Elsa and Anna before raising a hand as a signal for everyone to calm down.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜穿过人群，走近艾莎和安娜，然后举起一只手示意大家安静。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa turned to them, wondering why everyone was staring. “Where did you get that scarf?” Yelana asked.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎转向他们，纳闷大家为何都盯着看。“那条围巾你从哪儿来的？”耶拉娜问。

paras.en: A young Northuldra man and woman moved closer.
paras.zh: 一男一女两个年轻的北地人凑近了些。

paras.en: They seemed curious to hear the answer to Yelana’s question.
paras.zh: 他们似乎很想听耶拉娜这个问题的答案。

paras.en: Anna stared at the young woman until it hit her…she was the one who had challenged them initially, with her staff.
paras.zh: 安娜盯着那年轻女子，忽然想起来了……最初用杖拦住他们的，就是她。

paras.en: They nodded to each other in greeting. “I’m Honeymaren,” she said. “And that is my brother, Ryder.” Ryder stepped forward—with a smile, but also with curiosity all over his face. “That’s a Northuldra scarf,” he said.
paras.zh: 两人点头致意。“我是霍妮玛伦，”她说，“那是我哥哥，莱德。”莱德上前一步——面带微笑，脸上却也写满好奇。“那是北地人的围巾，”他说。

paras.en: “What?” Anna asked in surprise. “Scarves like these,” Honeymaren said, gesturing to the scarf that Anna wore, “were given to a child at birth.
paras.zh: “什么？”安娜惊讶地问。“像这样的围巾，”霍妮玛伦指了指安娜身上的围巾，“是孩子一出生就收到的。

paras.en: This is from one of our oldest families.” Anna and Elsa stared at one another, both feeling overwhelmed. “It was our mother’s,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 这条出自我们最古老的家族之一。”安娜和艾莎对视，都心潮起伏。“这是我们母亲的，”安娜说。

paras.en: Elsa had an idea coming to her.
paras.zh: 艾莎心里冒出一个念头。

paras.en: She grabbed her sister’s hand and pulled her through the brush.
paras.zh: 她抓住妹妹的手，拉着她穿过灌木。

paras.en: The others followed, wondering where they were going.
paras.zh: 其他人跟在后面，不知她们要去哪儿。

paras.en: The sisters rushed up to the ice sculpture of the young Northuldra girl holding their father as a boy. “Elsa…,” Anna said as she touched the icy face of the girl and the scarf she wore.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩冲到那座冰雕前——正是扶着少年父亲的北地少女。“艾莎……”安娜摸着少女冰冷的脸和她戴的围巾，开口道。

paras.en: Elsa examined the sculpture more closely. “I see it.
paras.zh: 艾莎更仔细地打量冰雕。“我看到了。

paras.en: That’s Mother.” They turned to each other, a realization hitting them. “Mother saved father’s life that day,” Anna said, announcing the truth for the very first time.
paras.zh: 那是母亲。”两人面面相觑，恍然大悟。“那天是母亲救了父亲的命，”安娜说，第一次道出这个真相。

paras.en: After a moment, Elsa turned to Yelana, and the rest of the people gathered around them. “Our mother was Northuldra.” The silence was widespread as everyone tried to understand what they had just heard. “What?” Mattias asked softly. “I knew she was Northuldra,” Ryder said to no one in particular. “I could just feel it.
paras.zh: 片刻后，艾莎转向耶拉娜和围拢过来的众人。“我们的母亲是北地人。”全场陷入沉默，人人都在消化刚听到的话。“什么？”马蒂亚斯轻声问。“我早知道她是北地人，”莱德也不知在对谁说，“我就是感觉得到。
