paras.en: I have…I have a way.” And then the wind stirred through the trees, creating a harmony of nature as it wound through the leaves and branches.
paras.zh: 我……我有这种感应。”接着，风穿过树林，在枝叶间缠绕，奏出自然的和鸣。

paras.en: The ice sculptures twinkled and glistened with a magical glow, drawing everyone’s attention to them.
paras.zh: 冰雕闪烁着魔法般的光辉，把大家的目光都吸了过去。

paras.en: Even Olaf began to glow as the owls and animals of the night called out to the forest in song.
paras.zh: 连雪宝也泛起光来，夜里的猫头鹰和野兽以歌声回应森林。

paras.en: Olaf sang along. “Oooohhh …” Yelana was speechless.
paras.zh: 雪宝跟着唱。“哦——哦——”耶拉娜说不出话来。

paras.en: An elder Northuldra put a hand on the shoulder of another Northuldra.
paras.zh: 一位年长的北地人把手搭在另一个北地人肩上。

paras.en: That person then reached for the person in front of him and placed his hand on her shoulder.
paras.zh: 那人又伸手搭在前面那人的肩上。

paras.en: The others followed, all of them connecting with each other one by one.
paras.zh: 其他人纷纷效仿，一个接一个地彼此相连。

paras.en: They began to sing a song of their people that filled the forest with a deep sense of belonging and hope.
paras.zh: 他们唱起本族人的歌，让森林充满深沉的归属感与希望。

paras.en: The Arendellian soldiers stood on the outer edges, on guard.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的士兵守在外围，保持警戒。

paras.en: Olaf put one hand on Kristoff and the other on Sven.
paras.zh: 雪宝一只手搭在克里斯托夫身上，另一只搭在斯文身上。

paras.en: He wasn’t exactly sure what the Northuldra were doing, but he wanted to make sure they were a part of it, too.
paras.zh: 他不太确定北地人在做什么，但想确保自己这边也没被落下。

paras.en: He even sang along, though he didn’t know what the words were.
paras.zh: 他甚至跟着唱，尽管根本不知道词儿。

paras.en: He was happy that the danger of the Fire Spirit was gone.
paras.zh: 他高兴火灵的威胁总算过去了。

paras.en: Ryder and Honeymaren were near the front of their group.
paras.zh: 莱德和霍妮玛伦站在队伍的靠前位置。

paras.en: They each put a hand on Yelana’s shoulder.
paras.zh: 他们各自把一只手搭在耶拉娜肩上。

paras.en: Yelana looked at Anna and Elsa.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜看向安娜和艾莎。

paras.en: She reached for their hands and held them in her own. “We are called Northuldra.
paras.zh: 她伸手握住她们的手。“我们叫北地人。

paras.en: We are the people of the sun,” she said, accepting that these people were part of her family.
paras.zh: 我们是太阳的子民，”她说，承认这些人也是她的族人。

paras.en: Anna and Elsa nodded, filled with emotion.
paras.zh: 安娜和艾莎含泪点头。

paras.en: Mattias stepped forward, seeing the feelings on their faces.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯上前，看出了她们脸上的神情。

paras.en: He stopped and waited. “I promise you,” Elsa said to Yelana, “I will free this forest and restore Arendelle.” She turned to Mattias to acknowledge him as well.
paras.zh: 他停下脚步等着。“我向您保证，”艾莎对耶拉娜说，“我会让这片森林重获自由，也会重建阿伦黛尔。”她又转向马蒂亚斯，也向他表明心迹。

paras.en: Anna was surprised by Elsa’s promise.
paras.zh: 安娜对艾莎的承诺感到意外。

paras.en: It was a vow for her sister to keep, not the two of them.
paras.zh: 这本该是姐姐一人的誓言，不是她们两人的。

paras.en: Something in her stomach twisted. “That’s a pretty big promise, Elsa,” she said, trying to keep the hurt to herself.
paras.zh: 她心里一阵纠结。“这可是个不小的承诺，艾莎，”她说，把受伤的感觉藏了起来。

paras.en: The rumble of voices started low at first, Arendellian mixing with Northuldra, then got louder as the hope of the mist falling spread through the crowd. “We’re getting out of here!” Ryder shouted, and people all around him laughed gleefully. “What!
paras.zh: 低低的议论声先起，阿伦黛尔话混着北地话，随后越来越高——迷雾将散的希望传遍人群。“我们要出去了！”莱德大喊，周围的人开心地笑起来。“什么！

paras.en: I’m excited about it!” He turned to Krisotff. “It’s just…some of us were born in here.
paras.zh: 我兴奋还来不及呢！”他转向克里斯托夫，“只是……我们当中有的人生在里头。

paras.en: We’ve never even seen an open sky.” “Hey, I get it,” Kristoff said, patting his new friend on the shoulder. “Thanks,” Ryder said. “Thank you for saving the reindeer.” “You bet,” said Kristoff. “I heard the voice again,” Elsa said, smiling at Yelana. “We need to go north.” “But the Earth Giants now roam the north at night,” Honeymaren warned. “They sleep by day,” Yelana advised. “You can leave in the morning.”
paras.zh: 我们连开阔的天空都没见过。”“嘿，我懂，”克里斯托夫拍拍新朋友肩膀说。“谢了，”莱德说，“谢谢你救了驯鹿。”“没问题，”克里斯托夫说。“我又听见那声音了，”艾莎对耶拉娜微笑着说，“我们得往北走。”“可大地巨人如今夜里在北面游荡，”霍妮玛伦提醒。“它们白天睡觉，”耶拉娜建议，“你们早上再出发。”

paras.en: As everyone returned to the Northuldra camp, they were relieved to see that the damage from the Fire Spirit was not what they had imagined.
paras.zh: 大家回到北地人的营地，松了口气——火灵造成的破坏并不像想象中那么严重。

paras.en: Many hands tidied up in an atmosphere of celebration and thanks, relief and joy.
paras.zh: 许多双手在庆祝、感恩、宽慰与喜悦的气氛中收拾打扫。

paras.en: The Northuldra and the Arendellians gathered to take a moment to recognize how important life is and how grateful they should be for each day.
paras.zh: 北地人和阿伦黛尔人聚在一起，静心体味生命的可贵，感念每一天。

paras.en: As music filled the air, everyone enjoyed warm drinks and bowls of steaming stew.
paras.zh: 乐声洋溢，人人喝着热饮，吃着热气腾腾的炖菜。

paras.en: Near where the cooking was taking place, some of the Northuldra toddlers gathered around Olaf.
paras.zh: 在煮食的附近，几个北地小孩围住了雪宝。

paras.en: At first they just looked at him curiously.
paras.zh: 起初他们只是好奇地打量他。

paras.en: He was quite different from anyone they’d ever seen before.
paras.zh: 他和他们见过的任何人都不一样。

paras.en: Then one bold little girl moved forward and poked his body.
paras.zh: 接着一个胆大的小女孩走上前，戳了戳他的身子。

paras.en: She seemed surprised that he was cold to the touch.
paras.zh: 摸到他冰凉的身子，她似乎很意外。

paras.en: Olaf was thrilled to spend time with the little ones.
paras.zh: 雪宝能和小朋友们待在一起，开心极了。

paras.en: And as they got more comfortable being around him, they drifted closer and began pulling at his arms, legs, and even at his nose.
paras.zh: 他们跟他越来越熟，凑得更近，开始扯他的胳膊、腿，甚至鼻子。

paras.en: Olaf talked to them the whole time. “Hey, let me ask you,” he began, “how do you guys cope with the ever-increasing complexity of thought that comes with maturity—” Olaf was interrupted when one of the kids grabbed his carrot nose and stuffed it up his own nose.
paras.zh: 雪宝一直跟他们说话。“嘿，问你们个事，”他开口，“你们是怎么应对随着年龄增长、思想越来越复杂这档子事的——”一个小孩一把抓过他的胡萝卜鼻子，塞进自己鼻孔里，打断了他。

paras.en: All the kids giggled. “Brilliant!” Olaf said. “It is so refreshing to get to talk to the youth of today.
paras.zh: 孩子们咯咯笑。“妙啊！”雪宝说，“能跟如今的年轻人聊聊天，真让人耳目一新。

paras.en: Our future is in bright hands.” But the children didn’t respond with words.
paras.zh: 我们的未来交到一双双灵巧的小手里了。”可孩子们没用话回应。

paras.en: Some of them began to chew on him.
paras.zh: 有几个开始啃他。

paras.en: Others took his feet off and placed them on top of his head.
paras.zh: 别的把他的脚拆下来，顶在脑袋上。

paras.en: That made them laugh, too.
paras.zh: 这把他们也逗笑了。

paras.en: Then a girl took a foot from his head and began to bite on it. “No, no, no, don’t chew that,” he warned. “You don’t know what I’ve stepped in.” Kristoff and Ryder were in a different part of the camp, near makeshift tables made from old barrels.
paras.zh: 接着一个女孩从他头上取下一只脚开始咬。“不不不，别啃那个，”他警告，“你不知道我都踩过什么。”克里斯托夫和莱德在营地另一头，靠近用旧木桶搭的临时桌子。

paras.en: Kristoff fumbled in his pocket and pulled out the ring he planned to give to Anna.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫在兜里摸索，掏出那枚打算送给安娜的戒指。

paras.en: He showed it to Ryder. “The mountain trolls mined it out of the core of the Black Mountains,” Kristoff said.
paras.zh: 他给莱德看。“这戒指是山地地精从黑山脉的矿芯里挖出来的，”克里斯托夫说。

paras.en: Ryder was shocked. “You know mountain trolls?” “I was raised by mountain trolls,” Kristoff announced proudly. “Oh, I’ve got to get out of this forest,” Ryder said.
paras.zh: 莱德大吃一惊。“你认识山地地精？”“我是被山地地精养大的，”克里斯托夫骄傲地宣布。“哦，我非得走出这片森林不可了，”莱德说。

paras.en: It wasn’t a bad life, but he had never been out of the forest because of the mist and had always wondered what he was missing on the other side of it. “I can’t seem to get her attention,” Kristoff complained, “or even say the right thing.” “Well, you’re in luck; I know absolutely nothing about women, but I do know that we have the most amazing way of proposing,” Ryder said. “It’ll definitely get her attention.
paras.zh: 这日子不算差，可因为迷雾，他从没出过森林，总好奇外面错过了什么。“我好像总引不起她注意，”克里斯托夫抱怨，“连句对的话都说不好。”“那你走运了；我对女人一窍不通，但我知道我们有最绝的求婚方式，”莱德说，“绝对能让她注意你。

paras.en: If we start now, you’ll be ready by dawn.” “Really?” Kristoff asked in amazement.
paras.zh: 现在开始练，天亮前你准能准备好。”“真的？”克里斯托夫惊讶地问。

paras.en: Ryder grabbed his new friend’s arm and pulled him. “Let’s just say it involves a lot of reindeer.” Kristoff’s eyes widened and he broke into a grin. “Ooohhh.” They sneaked past Anna and Mattias, who stood at the edge of the encampment eating stew.
paras.zh: 莱德一把抓住新朋友的胳膊拽他走。“这么说吧，少不了好多驯鹿。”克里斯托夫瞪大眼，咧嘴一笑。“哦——”他们悄悄从安娜和马蒂亚斯身边溜过，那两人正站在营地边喝炖菜。

paras.en: Mattias was alert, always watching, always scanning.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯保持警觉，眼观六路。

paras.en: He never seemed to let down his guard. “He was about your height,” Anna said to the lieutenant.
paras.zh: 他似乎从不懈怠。“他大概到你这么高，”安娜对中尉说。

paras.en: She was happy to stand with him and eat stew while he kept watch.
paras.zh: 她乐意陪他站着，趁他放哨时吃口炖菜。

paras.en: She respected him because she would never have been born if he hadn’t saved her father all those years before.
paras.zh: 她敬重他，因为若非多年前他救了父亲，她根本不会来到这世上。

paras.en: And she was grateful that Mattias had taken such good care of her father when he was a young men.
paras.zh: 她也感激马蒂亚斯在父亲年轻时把他照顾得那么好。

paras.en: It was hard for Anna to believe that he’d been stuck in the Enchanted Forest for longer than she had been alive. “That tall, huh,” Mattias asked, thinking back to the boy he used to know.
paras.zh: 安娜难以相信，他被困魔法森林的时间比她整个生命还长。“那么高啊，”马蒂亚斯回想当年那个少年，问道。

paras.en: There were moments when it was hard for him to reconcile his own memories of Agnarr with the information Anna and Elsa shared with him. “You meant a lot to him.
paras.zh: 有时他很难把记忆中的安格瑞，和安娜、艾莎告诉他的事对上号。“你对他意义重大。

paras.en: Whenever we’d get butter biscuits from Blodgets’ Bakery, he’d say, ‘Mattias could never get enough of these.’ ” “It’s the butter…,” Mattias said.
paras.zh: 每次我们从布洛杰特面包房买黄油饼干，他都说：‘马蒂亚斯吃这些永远吃不腻。’”“是因为黄油……”马蒂亚斯说。

paras.en: He had given up hope long before of ever getting back to the things he loved.
paras.zh: 他早就放弃希望，以为再也回不到心爱的一切身边。

paras.en: But now with Anna and Elsa there in the forest…the hope had returned. “Hey, back at home—Halima still over at Hudson’s Hearth?” “She is,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 可如今安娜和艾莎就在森林里……希望又回来了。“嘿，老家那边——哈丽玛还在哈德逊壁炉馆吗？”“在的，”安娜说。

paras.en: Mattias couldn’t believe it.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯不敢相信。

paras.en: So many years had passed! “Really?
paras.zh: 这么多年过去了！“真的？

paras.en: She married?” He asked.
paras.zh: 她结婚了？”他问。

paras.en: Anna shook her head no. “Oh, wow.
paras.zh: 安娜摇头说没有。“哦，天。

paras.en: Why doesn’t that make me feel better?” “What else do you miss?” Anna asked. “My father,” he answered without hesitation. “He passed long before all this.
paras.zh: 怎么这反而没让我好受点？”“你还想念什么？”安娜问。“我父亲，”他不假思索，“他早在这一切之前就过世了。

paras.en: He was a great man.
paras.zh: 他是个了不起的人。

paras.en: Built us a good life in Arendelle, but taught me to never take the good for granted.
paras.zh: 他在阿伦黛尔给了我们好日子，却教我永远别把好运当成理所当然。

paras.en: He’d say, ‘Be prepared—just when you think you’ve found your way, life will throw you onto a new path.’ ” “What do you do when it does?” Anna asked. “Don’t give up,” he said. “Take it one step at a time, and…” “Just do the next right thing?” Anna added, remembering what Grand Pabbie had told her. “Yeah,” Matthias said with a smile. “You got it.” Then he saw the concern on Anna’s face as she watched Elsa walk past with Honeymaren.
paras.zh: 他常说：‘做好准备——就在你以为找到了方向时，生活会把你抛上一条新路。’”“遇到这种事你怎么办？”安娜问。“别放弃，”他说，“一步一步来，还有……”“就是做下一件对的事？”安娜接话，想起皮比大仙对她说过的。“对，”马蒂亚斯微笑着说，“你说到点子上了。”这时他看到安娜脸上写满担忧——她正望着艾莎和霍妮玛伦走过。

paras.en: Honeymaren and Elsa walked over to the logs around a campfire and sat down.
paras.zh: 霍妮玛伦和艾莎走到篝火边的木头旁坐下。

paras.en: A baby reindeer ran up, nuzzling and rubbing its head on them.
paras.zh: 一只小驯鹿跑过来，用脑袋蹭她们。

paras.en: Elsa stroked the little reindeer’s back as she thought about everything that had happened since they’d entered the forest. “I want to show you something.
paras.zh: 艾莎抚摸小驯鹿的背，回想他们进森林后发生的一切。“我想给你看样东西。

paras.en: May I?” Honeymaren asked.
paras.zh: 可以吗？”霍妮玛伦问。

paras.en: Elsa nodded.
paras.zh: 艾莎点点头。

paras.en: Honeymaren reached for one end of the beautiful burgundy scarf that had belonged to Elsa’s mother and gestured to the snowflakes on it.
paras.zh: 霍妮玛伦伸手拈起艾莎母亲那条酒红色美丽围巾的一端，指向上面的雪花图案。

paras.en: She identified the symbols on the points of one snowflake. “You know air, fire, water, earth.” “Yes,” Elsa said. “But look.” Honeymaren touched a diamond in the center of the snowflake, a symbol Elsa had never noticed before. “There’s a fifth spirit.” Honeymaren smiled at the surprised expression on Elsa’s face. “Said to be a bridge between us and the magic of nature.” Elsa was shocked. “A fifth spirit?” “Some say they heard it call out the day the forest fell,” Honeymaren said.
paras.zh: 她指出一片雪花尖角上的符号。“你知道的，风、火、水、土。”“嗯，”艾莎说。“可你看。”霍妮玛伦点了点雪花中心的一颗菱形，那是个艾莎从没注意过的符号。“还有第五种精灵。”霍妮玛伦看着艾莎惊讶的表情笑了。“据说它是我们与自然魔法之间的桥梁。”艾莎震惊了。“第五种精灵？”“有人说，森林崩落那天听见它呼喊过，”霍妮玛伦说。

paras.en: She had Elsa’s full attention. “My father heard it,” said Elsa. “Do you think that’s who’s calling me?” Elsa asked. “Maybe.” Honeymaren smiled. “Alas, only Ahtohallan knows.” Elsa smiled back, recalling that her mother had said the same thing to Anna and herself when they were children. “Ahtohallan—” She drew the scarf tightly around her shoulders, remembering the words to the lullaby her mother had soothed them with.
paras.zh: 这下她彻底抓住了艾莎的注意力。“我父亲听见了，”艾莎说，“你觉得在召唤我的，就是它吗？”艾莎问。“也许吧。”霍妮玛伦微笑，“唉，只有阿托哈兰知道。”艾莎回以微笑，想起小时候母亲也曾对她们姐妹说过同样的话。“阿托哈兰——”她把围巾紧紧裹在肩上，想起母亲哼来哄她们入睡的摇篮曲歌词。

paras.en: She half sang and half spoke the words aloud.
paras.zh: 她半唱半念，把词儿轻声吐出。

paras.en: Honeymaren smiled again, recognizing the song and singing along with Elsa. “Why do lullabies always have to have some terrible warning in them?” Honeymaren asked once they had finished. “I wonder that all the time,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: 霍妮玛伦又笑了，认出这首歌，跟着艾莎一起唱。“为什么摇篮曲里总得带点可怕的警告？”唱完后霍妮玛伦问。“我也一直在想这事，”艾莎说。

paras.en: Suddenly, the ground shook from a distant boom like thunder.
paras.zh: 忽然，远处一声闷雷般的巨响震得大地发颤。

paras.en: But no lightning followed to electrify the sky. “Earth Giants,” Honeymaren said.
paras.zh: 却没有闪电划破天空。“大地巨人，”霍妮玛伦说。

paras.en: Everyone panicked and scattered in different directions.
paras.zh: 人人慌了神，朝不同方向散开。

paras.en: They doused the cooking fires and grabbed the children.
paras.zh: 他们扑灭炊火，抱起孩子。

paras.en: They searched for places to hide from the looming threat. “What are they doing down here?” Yelana whispered sharply to Elsa.
paras.zh: 他们寻找藏身之处，躲避逼近的威胁。“它们到下面来干什么？”耶拉娜急切地低声问艾莎。

paras.en: The ground shook again, as if feet the weight of mountains stomped on it.
paras.zh: 地面又震了一下，仿佛有山一般重的脚踩在上面。

paras.en: The giants were close; tree limbs wavered from their heavy breathing.
paras.zh: 巨人很近了；树枝随着它们沉重的呼吸摇曳。

paras.en: A huge nose parted the limbs and sniffed loudly, searching for a specific scent. “Hide,” Honeymaren instructed.
paras.zh: 一只巨大的鼻子拨开枝叶，大声嗅着，搜寻某种特定的气味。“藏起来，”霍妮玛伦吩咐。

paras.en: Olaf quickly ducked behind a rock, trying to make himself as small as possible.
paras.zh: 雪宝迅速蹲到岩石后，尽量把自己缩成一团。

paras.en: And then he noticed the Fire Spirit.
paras.zh: 这时他注意到了火灵。

paras.en: He waved his hands at the salamander, trying to shoo it away.
paras.zh: 他朝小蝾螈挥手，想把它赶走。

paras.en: His gestures had the opposite effect: the Fire Spirit ignited!
paras.zh: 他的动作适得其反：火灵点燃了！

paras.en: He gasped in horror. “No, no, shhh,” he said, trying to soothe it.
paras.zh: 他惊恐地倒吸凉气。“不不，嘘——”他说着想安抚它。

paras.en: Taking a deep breath, he blew on the crackling flames, but the flames expanded, engulfing the Fire Spirit. “They’re coming.
paras.zh: 他深吸一口气，朝噼啪作响的火苗吹气，火却蔓延开，把火灵整个吞没。“它们来了。

paras.en: They’re coming!” He tried blowing on the flames again, yet they continued to spread.
paras.zh: 它们来了！”他又朝火吹，可火仍在扩散。

paras.en: Olaf reached for the Fire Spirit. “Ooh.
paras.zh: 雪宝伸手去够火灵。“嗷。

paras.en: Ooh.
paras.zh: 嗷。

paras.en: Hot.
paras.zh: 烫。

paras.en: Hot,” he said as he tossed the creature back and forth between his hands.
paras.zh: 烫，”他一边说，一边把小家伙两手来回倒。

paras.en: Finally, he put the salamander back down on the rock and looked at it pleadingly. “Unlight that fire,” he begged.
paras.zh: 终于，他把小蝾螈放回岩石上，恳求地望着它。“把火熄掉，”他央求。

paras.en: Without warning, the Fire Spirit jumped onto Olaf’s head, turning around three times before lying down on the cold permafrost with a smile.
paras.zh: 火灵毫无预兆地跳上雪宝的脑袋，转了三圈，然后笑眯眯地趴在冰凉的永冻冰上。

paras.en: At first Olaf winced in pain.
paras.zh: 起初雪宝疼得龇牙。

paras.en: Then he gave a sigh of relief—the fire on the salamander had gone out.
paras.zh: 接着他松了口气——蝾螈身上的火灭了。

paras.en: BOOM, BOOM, BOOM.
paras.zh: 轰，轰，轰。

paras.en: Everyone in the Earth Giants’ path held their breath and prayed they would just go away.
paras.zh: 大地巨人途经之处的每个人，都屏住呼吸，祈祷它们快快离开。

paras.en: Elsa, intrigued, peeked out from behind the tree.
paras.zh: 艾莎好奇，从树后探出头。

paras.en: The nose of the one closest to her turned slowly toward her, as if it had caught her scent.
paras.zh: 离她最近那只的鼻子缓缓转向她，仿佛嗅到了她的气味。

paras.en: A shadow crossed over her as the whole Earth Giant emerged.
paras.zh: 整只大地巨人现身，阴影笼罩了她。

paras.en: Before ducking behind the tree, she looked up at its face, intrigued by its sheer size and the velocity with which it moved toward her.
paras.zh: 躲回树后之前，她抬头望向它的脸，被它庞大的体型和朝自己冲来的速度吸引住了。

paras.en: Then, without warning, it turned in a different direction and continued walking.
paras.zh: 接着，它毫无预兆地转向别处，继续前行。

paras.en: Elsa peeked out from behind the tree again.
paras.zh: 艾莎又从树后探出头。

paras.en: Realizing the Earth Giant was moving away from their camp, she stepped out and started after it.
paras.zh: 她发现大地巨人正远离营地，便走出去，跟了上去。

paras.en: Anna jumped into her path, her face full of questions. “Tell me you were not about to follow them,” she whispered. “What if I can settle them like I did the wind and fire?” Elsa asked. “Or what if they can crush you before you even get the chance?
paras.zh: 安娜跳出来挡住她，脸上写满疑问。“告诉我你不是要跟上去，”她低声说。“要是我能像驯服风与火那样安抚它们呢？”艾莎问，“可要是它们没等你靠近就把你碾碎呢？

paras.en: Remember, the goal is to find the voice, find the truth, and get us home,” Anna reminded her sister.
paras.zh: 记住，我们的目标是找到声音、找到真相，然后回家，”安娜提醒姐姐。

paras.en: Olaf ran up just as the Earth Giants faded into the distance.
paras.zh: 大地巨人渐渐远去时，雪宝跑了过来。

paras.en: The Fire Spirit was still relaxing comfortably on his head. “Hey, guys—that was close!
paras.zh: 火灵还舒舒服服趴在他头上。“嘿，各位——好险！

paras.en: But, bright side: the Fire Spirit and I are fast friends.
paras.zh: 不过好的一面是：火灵和我也成铁哥们了。

paras.en: We’re going with the name Bruni.
paras.zh: 我们决定叫它布鲁尼。

paras.en: Either that or Sally.
paras.zh: 不然就叫萨莉。

paras.en: Aren’t we, Bruni…or Sally?” Elsa smiled and Bruni jumped onto her arm and sat on her shoulder. “Good.
paras.zh: 你说是不是，布鲁尼……还是萨莉？”艾莎笑了，布鲁尼跳上她的胳膊，坐在她肩上。“好。

paras.en: Watch your twigs, though, Olaf.” She turned to Anna. “The giants sensed me.
paras.zh: 不过当心你的树枝，雪宝。”她转向安娜，“那些巨人感应到了我。

paras.en: They may come back here.
paras.zh: 它们可能会回来。

paras.en: I don’t want to put anyone at risk again.
paras.zh: 我不想再让任何人冒险。

paras.en: And you’re right, Anna; we’ve got to find the voice.
paras.zh: 而且你说得对，安娜；我们得找到那个声音。

paras.en: We’re going now.” Anna hesitated. “Okay.
paras.zh: 我们现在就走。”安娜犹豫了。“好吧。

paras.en: We’re going.
paras.zh: 我们走。

paras.en: Let me just—” But Elsa didn’t wait another second for her sister to finish.
paras.zh: 让我先——”可艾莎没等妹妹说完。

paras.en: She went through the camp, with Olaf at her heels, determined to continue her journey north.
paras.zh: 她穿过营地，雪宝紧随其后，决心继续北行。

paras.en: Anna looked around the camp. “Where are Kristoff and Sven?” she asked in a panic. “Oh, yeah.
paras.zh: 安娜环顾营地。“克里斯托夫和斯文呢？”她慌了，“哦，对。

paras.en: I think they took off with that Ryder guy and a bunch of reindeer,” Olaf said. “They left?” Anna asked, confused. “Just…just left?
paras.zh: 我想他们是跟那个莱德，还有一群驯鹿一起走了，”雪宝说。“他们走了？”安娜不解，“就……就这么走了？

paras.en: Without saying anything?” What could be so important that Kristoff would leave me behind?
paras.zh: 什么都没说？”什么事这么要紧，克里斯托夫竟把我丢下？

paras.en: Olaf shrugged. “Who knows the ways of men?” He turned and followed Elsa.
paras.zh: 雪宝耸耸肩。“谁搞得懂男人的心思？”他转身去追艾莎。

paras.en: Anna glanced back at her sister, getting farther away with each second.
paras.zh: 安娜回头望姐姐，姐姐正一秒比一秒远。

paras.en: Anna didn’t want to leave without Kristoff.
paras.zh: 安娜不想没等克里斯托夫就走。

paras.en: But she’d promised to keep Elsa safe.
paras.zh: 可她答应过要护艾莎周全。

paras.en: She raced off and caught up with Olaf.
paras.zh: 她拔腿追赶，赶上了雪宝。

paras.en: Elsa was ahead of them, pushing through the forest with determination, always aware of the potential dangers all around.
paras.zh: 艾莎走在前面，坚定地穿过森林，始终留意着四周潜在的危险。

paras.en: Anna did her best to hold her head up and not cry.
paras.zh: 安娜努力昂起头，不让自己哭。

paras.en: And when Olaf reached his hand up to her, she gladly took it.
paras.zh: 雪宝伸手够她时，她欣然握住。

paras.en: Kristoff was excited for the day ahead as he stood in a beautiful cove full of wildflowers, watching the sun rise. Stray sunbeams fell on his hair, highlighting the white lichen sprinkled there. He had even put some on Sven, for good luck.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫站在一片开满野花的美丽小水湾里，望着朝阳冉冉升起，对即将到来的一天满心期待。缕缕阳光洒落他的发间，映出点缀其中的白色地衣。他甚至还往斯文身上也撒了些，讨个好彩头。

paras.en: “Okay,” he said. “Everybody ready?”
paras.zh: “好了，”他说，“大家都准备好了吗？”

paras.en: Among the trees, reindeer surrounded Kristoff in a spiral formation.
paras.zh: 林间，驯鹿们呈螺旋队形把克里斯托夫团团围住。

paras.en: Ryder was there, too and knew how to have fun with them. “Ready,” he said in the voice of one of the reindeer.
paras.zh: 莱德也在那儿，他最懂得怎么跟它们玩儿了。“准备好了。”他学着一只驯鹿的嗓音说。

paras.en: He changed his voice again. “Um, I could use a rehearsal.”
paras.zh: 他又换了个声音。“呃，我可得先彩排一下。”

paras.en: In another voice, Ryder said, “I love love.”
paras.zh: 接着莱德用另一种声音说：“我爱爱情。”

paras.en: Kristoff was shocked. “Wait. You talk for them, too?”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫惊呆了。“等等。你连它们的心声也替它们说？”

paras.en: Ryder, not ashamed, said, “I do.”
paras.zh: 莱德毫不害臊：“我当然替它们说。”

paras.en: “It’s like you can actually hear what they’re thinking.” Kristoff beamed. The reindeer looked at each other as if they thought the two men were crazy.
paras.zh: “就好像真能听见它们在想什么似的。”克里斯托夫乐开了花。驯鹿们面面相觑，仿佛觉得这两个人疯疯癫癫。

paras.en: “Yeah,” Ryder agreed.
paras.zh: “可不是嘛。”莱德附和道。

paras.en: “And then you just say it,” they said simultaneously.
paras.zh: “想到什么就直接说出来呗。”两人异口同声地说。

paras.en: Kristoff was happy to have a friend who thought like him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫很高兴，能有一个跟他想到一块儿去的朋友。

paras.en: They stopped when the sound of footsteps broke the quiet of the morning.
paras.zh: 这时，一阵脚步声打破了清晨的宁静，他们停了下来。

paras.en: “Okay,” Ryder said in his real voice. “Here she comes.”
paras.zh: “好了，”莱德用自己本来的声音说，“她来了。”

paras.en: Kristoff and Ryder launched into motion. They hit triggers that made flowers fly and butterflies soar in a colorful dance through the air. Kristoff hopped onto a boulder in the middle of a big circle of them. He poked one rock with his toe and it nudged the others to fall in a dazzling domino effect around him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和莱德立刻动了起来。他们触动了机关，花儿纷纷飞起，蝴蝶翩然腾空，在空中跳起一支五彩缤纷的舞蹈。克里斯托夫一跃跳上一块巨石，正立在一大圈石头围成的圆心。他用脚尖轻点其中一块石头，石头便接二连三推倒四周的同伴，在他身边倒出一片令人目眩的多米诺阵势。

paras.en: “Princess Anna of Arendelle, my feisty, fearless, ginger-sweet love, will you marry—” he began.
paras.zh: “阿伦黛尔的安娜公主，我那火辣、无畏、姜糖般甜美的爱人，你愿意嫁——”他开口道。

paras.en: He froze when Yelana walked into the clearing. She looked around as if she had no idea what to say. “This is so sudden…,” she said. “Um. The princess left with the queen.”
paras.zh: 叶拉娜走进空地时，他整个人僵住了。她环顾四周，仿佛全然不知该说什么。“这可真是突然啊……”她说。“呃。公主跟王后一起走了。”

paras.en: That didn’t make any sense to Kristoff. Why would Anna and Elsa leave? And more important, why would they leave without him?
paras.zh: 这话让克里斯托夫如坠云雾。安娜和艾莎为什么要走？更要紧的是，她们怎么会丢下他一声不吭地走了？

paras.en: “What?” asked Kristoff. “Wait, what? What?”
paras.zh: “什么？”克里斯托夫问。“等等，你说什么？什么？”

paras.en: Yelana shrugged. The situation was getting really awkward, and she was ready to leave. She was just a messenger.
paras.zh: 叶拉娜耸了耸肩。这场面实在尴尬，她已经准备开溜了。她不过是个传话的。

paras.en: “I wouldn’t try to follow,” she said. “They’re long gone.”
paras.zh: “我劝你千万别去追，”她说，“她们早就走远了。”

paras.en: Kristoff couldn’t move. “Long gone?”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫僵在原地，动弹不得。“走远了？”

paras.en: “Yeah,” she confirmed. “So—we’re heading west, to the lichen meadows. You can come with us if you want.” She turned and walked out of the cove.
paras.zh: “是啊。”她证实道。“所以——我们要往西去地衣草甸。你愿意的话，就跟我们一起走。”说完她转身走出了小水湾。

paras.en: Kristoff was shocked. He couldn’t think. He was too embarrassed to meet Ryder’s eyes, knowing that Ryder knew Anna had left the Northuldra camp without even telling him. They had put so much work into this proposal because he was sure that he and Anna were meant to be together forever.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫惊得说不出话。他脑子里一片空白。他羞得不敢迎上莱德的目光，因为他知道，莱德心里明白，安娜离开北地人的营地时，连一声招呼都没跟他打。他们为这场求婚倾注了那么多心血，只因他深信，他和安娜命中注定要相守一生。

paras.en: “Hey…,” Ryder said, feeling bad for his new friend. “I’m really sorry that—”
paras.zh: “嘿……”莱德说，替这位新朋友难受，“我真的很抱歉——”

paras.en: “No, I’m fine,” Kristoff interrupted, lying.
paras.zh: “不，我没事。”克里斯托夫打断他，嘴上撒着谎。

paras.en: “Yeah. Yup. Okay. I better go pack,” Ryder said. “You coming with?”
paras.zh: “是啊。没错。好。我先去收拾行李，”莱德说，“你一块儿走吗？”

paras.en: “I’ll just, uh— Yeah, I’ll meet you there,” Kristoff promised.
paras.zh: “我就，呃——行，我待会儿在那儿跟你们会合。”克里斯托夫应道。

paras.en: “Okay. You know where you’re going? Right?” Ryder asked.
paras.zh: “好吧。你认得往哪儿走吗？可别走丢了？”莱德不放心地问。

paras.en: “Yeah,” he confirmed. “Yeah. I know the woods.”
paras.zh: “认得。”他答道。“知道。这林子我熟。”

paras.en: Ryder nodded and headed for the camp.
paras.zh: 莱德点点头，朝营地走去。

paras.en: Kristoff’s whole body felt numb. He sat on the boulder he’d been standing on and put his head in his hands. Sven nudged him to offer support and to make sure his best friend was okay.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫只觉浑身发麻。他坐上刚才站着的那块巨石，双手捂住了脸。斯文用脑袋轻轻拱了拱他，想给他打气，也想确认自己最好的朋友是不是还好好的。

paras.en: How could she leave me behind? Should I even follow her? Are we growing apart? Kristoff thought. He felt lost without her.
paras.zh: 她怎么能丢下我？我到底还该不该去追她？我们是不是正在渐行渐远？克里斯托夫心里翻来覆去地想。没有她在身边，他只觉得茫茫然失了魂。

paras.en: Elsa kept a steady pace ahead of Anna and Olaf. It was hard to tell how long they had been walking, but the night had slowly slid into day as they continued moving north. Bruni ran along on the rocks beside Elsa, stopping periodically to make sure everyone was still there.
paras.zh: 艾莎走在安娜和雪宝前头，步子平稳。走了多久已难以分辨，只知夜色渐渐褪入白昼，他们仍在一路向北。布鲁尼在艾莎身旁的岩石上一路小跑，还不时停下来，确认大家都跟得上。

paras.en: Anna could tell that her sister was anxious by the way her eyes darted back and forth, looking at everything. Elsa sang the same haunting melody that had called to her so many times, wanting it to answer back…wanting it to tell her which way to go. Of course, Olaf, not to be left out, tried to copy her, singing in what he thought was the same voice. But it was far from it, and it made Bruni jump into the air and catch fire. The Fire Spirit looked at Olaf grumpily before dousing its flames and scrambling off into the bushes.
paras.zh: 安娜看得出来，姐姐心里发急——她的目光来回逡巡，什么都想看个清楚。艾莎唱起那支曾一次次呼唤她的幽婉旋律，盼着它回应……盼着它告诉自己该往哪儿走。当然，雪宝可不甘被冷落，也学着她的样子唱了起来，还自以为用的是同一种嗓音。可实在差得远了，那歌声把布鲁尼惊得腾空跳起，浑身着了火。火灵气鼓鼓地瞪了雪宝一眼，这才熄灭火焰，慌慌张张钻进了灌木丛。

paras.en: The snowman’s off-key singing made Anna grit her teeth, but she tried to be polite.
paras.zh: 雪人跑调的歌声让安娜直磨牙，但她还是尽量客气。

paras.en: “Hey, Olaf—um, maybe just one of you should do it,” she suggested.
paras.zh: “嘿，雪宝——呃，要不就让你们俩里的一位来唱吧。”她委婉地提议。

paras.en: “I agree,” Olaf said, nodding. He raised a stick hand so he could whisper to Anna behind it. “She’s a little pitchy.”
paras.zh: “我同意。”雪宝点着头说。他举起一根树枝做的手，好凑到安娜耳边压低嗓音。“她有点儿跑调。”

paras.en: A soft breeze whirled around him, announcing that the Wind Spirit had returned.
paras.zh: 一阵轻柔的微风绕着他打转，宣告风灵回来了。

paras.en: “Hey, Gale’s back,” Olaf said happily.
paras.zh: “嘿，盖尔回来了。”雪宝高兴地说。

paras.en: Gale fluttered around Elsa, getting her attention before drawing their eyes to a tattered flag that was barely visible over one of the hills.
paras.zh: 盖尔绕着艾莎翩翩飞舞，引来她的注意，随后把大家的目光引向一座山丘后那面破烂得几乎望不见的旗子。

paras.en: “What…?” Anna said, breathless.
paras.zh: “那是……？”安娜屏住呼吸说。

paras.en: She and Elsa hurried through the trees with Olaf right behind them. They stopped suddenly on the crest of the hill and stared in silence before grabbing each other in shock. It was an Arendellian flag—old and in pieces, and attached to the mast of a ship. The vessel lay shipwrecked and broken in a dry riverbed, its hull ripped open.
paras.zh: 她和艾莎急忙穿过树林，雪宝紧紧跟在后面。他们在山顶上猛地停住脚步，先是一言不发地凝望，随即惊愕地互相抓住了对方。那是一面阿伦黛尔的旗帜——又旧又破，挂在一艘船的桅杆上。那船残破地搁浅在干涸的河床里，船身裂开着大口。

paras.en: Gale swept around the girls and blew toward the ship, pushing against the old, beaten flag, making it wave weakly.
paras.zh: 盖尔掠过两个女孩身边，朝那艘船吹去，拂动那面饱经风霜的旧旗，让它有气无力地飘了飘。

paras.en: “How can it be?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “这怎么可能？”安娜问。

paras.en: Olaf studied the fragmented vessel curiously, not noticing that the girls were upset.
paras.zh: 雪宝好奇地打量着这艘碎裂的船，没有留意两个女孩有多难受。

paras.en: “What is it?” he asked.
paras.zh: “怎么了？”他问。

paras.en: “Mother and Father’s ship,” Anna replied softly, hardly believing it.
paras.zh: “是爸爸妈妈的船。”安娜轻声回答，几乎不敢相信。

paras.en: Olaf was confused. “But this isn’t the Southern Sea.”
paras.zh: 雪宝糊涂了。“可这儿不是南海啊。”

paras.en: “No. No, it isn’t,” Anna said. It didn’t make any sense, and yet there it was. She ran with Elsa down the embankment, desperate to get to the ship, throwing caution behind them. They were too fast for Olaf, but he tumbled after, trying his best to keep up with them.
paras.zh: “是啊，确实不是。”安娜说。这怎么想都说不通，可它偏偏就在眼前。她拉着艾莎冲下河堤，不顾一切地奔向那艘船，把小心谨慎统统抛在了脑后。她们跑得太快，雪宝追不上，只得连滚带爬地跟在后头，拼命想追上她们。

paras.en: The broken hull was jagged, but Elsa and Anna didn’t hesitate as they navigated the splintered beams and climbed into the old wooden ship. More than anything, they hoped to find something of their parents’, anything they may have left behind. But their brief moment of hope was soon gone. Everything inside had been destroyed over the years—tossed and mangled, or washed away. They moved silently through the wreckage in heartbroken shock.
paras.zh: 破裂的船身棱角锋利，可艾莎和安娜毫不迟疑，绕开一根根断裂的横梁，爬进了那艘老旧的木船。她们最盼望的，就是找到父母留下的任何东西，哪怕一星半点也好。可这短短一瞬的希望很快便破灭了。舱内的一切历经岁月早已毁坏殆尽——不是被翻得七零八落、面目全非，就是被冲得无影无踪。她们默默地在残骸间穿行，心碎得说不出话来。

paras.en: “Why is their ship here?” Elsa asked, on the verge of tears. “How is it here?”
paras.zh: “为什么他们的船会在这儿？”艾莎问，眼泪已经在眼眶里打转。“它又是怎么到这儿来的？”

paras.en: They searched deeper, under jagged wooden planks and ripped sails.
paras.zh: 她们往更深处搜寻，翻过一根根锋利的木板，掀开撕裂的船帆。

paras.en: “It must have been washed in from the Dark Sea,” Anna guessed, sorting through the mess, her fingers moving faster and faster.
paras.zh: “准是从暗海冲进来的。”安娜一边猜，一边在那堆乱物里翻找，手指越动越快。

paras.en: “What were they doing in the Dark Sea?” Elsa asked. She didn’t expect her sister to have an answer.
paras.zh: “他们去暗海做什么？”艾莎问。她本没指望妹妹能答上来。

paras.en: “I don’t know,” Anna replied. She stopped and stared at Elsa. Everything felt more mysterious than it had before. “So many secrets.”
paras.zh: “我也不知道。”安娜答道。她停下动作，望着艾莎。一切都比先前更加扑朔迷离了。“这么多秘密。”

paras.en: Olaf’s head popped up over the side of the broken beams. Seeing the girls, he pushed himself the rest of the way in and tumbled into the hull. His head swiveled as he looked around, confused.
paras.zh: 雪宝的脑袋从断裂的横梁边上探了出来。一见到两个女孩，他就一鼓作气往上爬，扑通一声跌进了船舱。他转着脑袋四下张望，一脸茫然。

paras.en: “How did the ship get through the mist?” he said. “I thought nobody could but us. Oh…unless nobody was on it.”
paras.zh: “这船是怎么穿过迷雾的？”他说。“我还以为除了我们谁也进不来呢。哦……除非船上压根儿没人。”

paras.en: Anna needed to concentrate on her sister. “There’s got to be something here…,” she said, refusing to believe they had come this far to find out that all the answers were still hidden. Suddenly, an idea struck her. “Wait. Wait. Look around.” She dropped to her knees and felt around the floor with her hands. “Every Arendellian ship has a compartment. Waterproof.”
paras.zh: 安娜得把心思放回姐姐身上。“这儿一定还藏着什么……”她说，不愿相信她们千里迢迢赶来，答案却依旧深藏不露。忽然，她灵光一闪。“等等。等等。四处瞧瞧。”她跪下来，用双手在船板上摸索。“每艘阿伦黛尔的船都有个暗格。防水的。”

paras.en: Anna’s words pushed Elsa into action. She ran her hands over the walls, looking for any sign of a compartment.
paras.zh: 安娜的话让艾莎立刻行动起来。她的双手沿着船壁一路摸索，寻找暗格的踪迹。

paras.en: “That’s very clever,” Olaf said. “Although it does make me wonder why they don’t just make the whole ship waterproof.”
paras.zh: “真聪明。”雪宝说。“不过这倒让我纳闷，他们干吗不干脆把整艘船都做成防水的。”

paras.en: “Here,” Anna said. Her finger went into a small notch near the floor. It clicked and a hatch opened. Olaf and Elsa went to her in anticipation as Anna reached inside and pulled out a round glass tube. She uncorked it and removed a roll of parchments covered in mysterious text. “What language is this?”
paras.zh: “在这儿。”安娜说。她的手指探进了靠近船板的一个小凹槽。咔哒一声，一扇舱门弹开了。雪宝和艾莎满怀期待地凑到她身边，只见安娜把手伸进去，取出一根圆形的玻璃管。她拔开管塞，抽出一卷写满神秘文字的羊皮纸。“这是什么文字？”

paras.en: “I don’t know,” Elsa said, glancing at some words in the margins. She pointed to them. “But look—this is Mother’s handwriting.”
paras.zh: “我不认识。”艾莎说着，瞥见页边上有几行小字。她指了指那些字。“可你看——这是妈妈的笔迹。”

paras.en: Anna read the words out loud. “ ‘The end of the ice age…The river found but lost…Magic’s source. Elsa’s source?’ ”
paras.zh: 安娜把上面的字大声念了出来。“'冰河时代的终结……寻得又失去的河流……魔法的源头。艾莎的源头？'”

paras.en: Elsa took the parchment from her and read the mention of herself.
paras.zh: 艾莎从她手里接过羊皮纸，读着那句提到自己的话。

paras.en: Anna opened another parchment. “It’s a map,” she said. Anna unrolled it carefully and gently spread it out on the floor. Elsa joined her and they looked at it together.
paras.zh: 安娜打开另一卷羊皮纸。“是张地图。”她说。安娜小心翼翼地把它展开，轻轻平铺在船板上。艾莎凑到她身旁，两人一同端详起来。

paras.en: The map showed Arendelle, the Enchanted Forest, the Dark Sea, and what lay beyond. A crude line marked the mist, with question marks along its northern border. Dotted lines marked a route up the fjord.
paras.zh: 地图上标着阿伦黛尔、魔法森林、暗海，还有海那头的世界。一条粗糙的线标出了迷雾的所在，北面的边界上画着一连串问号。一条虚线标出沿峡湾而上的路线。

paras.en: “They traveled north to the Dark Sea, to—” Anna stopped short when the dotted lines crossed the sea to a small island, labeled again in their mother’s unique handwriting.
paras.zh: “他们一路向北去了暗海，去——”安娜的话戛然而止：虚线穿过海面，指向一座小岛，标注的又是妈妈那独一无二的笔迹。

paras.en: Elsa recognized the word. “Ahtohallan…”
paras.zh: 艾莎认出了那个词。“阿塔霍兰……”

paras.en: “It’s real?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “它是真的？”安娜问。

paras.en: “Ahto-who-what?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: “阿塔—什么什么？”雪宝问。

paras.en: “Ahtohallan,” Elsa corrected him. “It’s a magical river said to hold all the answers about the past.”
paras.zh: “阿塔霍兰。”艾莎纠正他。“那是一条神奇的河，据说藏着关于过去的所有答案。”

paras.en: Olaf felt proud that he had been right. “Reinforcing my water-has-memory theory—”
paras.zh: 雪宝为自己猜对了而得意。“这更印证了我的'水有记忆'理论——”

paras.en: “Water has memory,” Elsa whispered. She closed her eyes and pressed her hands to the floor. She used her power to pull moisture from the old wooden beams, the air, and the floorboards.
paras.zh: “水是有记忆的。”艾莎轻声说。她闭上眼睛，双手按在船板上。她运用魔力，从老旧的木梁、空气和船板中汲取水汽。

paras.en: “Elsa?” Anna said, “What are you doing?”
paras.zh: “艾莎？”安娜问，“你在做什么？”

paras.en: “I want to know what happened to them,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: “我想知道他们到底遭遇了什么。”艾莎说。

paras.en: A lacy, life-size ice sculpture formed in front of them, a perfect replica of their parents, dancing together and looking lovingly at each other. The sisters moved around it, taking in every detail.
paras.zh: 一座蕾丝般精致、与真人等身的冰雕在他们面前成形，正是父母双双起舞、深情对望的模样。姐妹俩绕着冰雕缓缓移动，不放过每一处细节。

paras.en: Gale swept past them again and around the sculpture. As it swirled, echoes of distant voices filled the ship.
paras.zh: 盖尔又一次从她们身边掠过，绕着冰雕盘旋。随着它回旋，遥远的声音在船里回荡开来。

paras.en: “Ahtohallan has to be the source of her magic,” said the distant, distorted voice of the girls’ mother in a memory from long before.
paras.zh: “阿塔霍兰一定是她魔法的源头，”那是许久以前一段记忆里，女孩们母亲的嗓音，缥缈而失真。

paras.en: “If we know why Elsa has powers, we can help her,” their father said.
paras.zh: “只要弄清艾莎为什么拥有魔力，我们就能帮她，”父亲说。

paras.en: Elsa had an idea. She moved through the ship and placed her hands on a wall. Another sculpture formed, a replica of her parents sitting at a table, looking over a map.
paras.zh: 艾莎有了主意。她在船里穿行，把双手按在一面墙上。又一座冰雕成形了，是父母坐在桌前、对着地图商议的模样。

paras.en: “Do you really think the past can save Elsa’s future?” her father asked.
paras.zh: “你真的觉得，过去能拯救艾莎的未来吗？”父亲问。

paras.en: “No,” her mother replied, “but I think understanding what she’s a part of can.”
paras.zh: “不，”母亲答道，“但我想，弄明白她所身属的这一切，就能。”

paras.en: Elsa backed away from the sculpture, realizing that all of this was about her. Gale swept through the ship. Elsa followed it to the helm, understanding what she was supposed to do. She put her hands on either side of the doorframe and closed her eyes.
paras.zh: 艾莎从冰雕前退开，意识到这一切说的都是她自己。盖尔掠过整艘船。艾莎跟着它来到舵位前，明白了自己该做什么。她双手扶住门框两侧，闭上眼睛。

paras.en: A sculpture began to form in front of her from the ground up. It was a wave.
paras.zh: 一座冰雕从地面起，在她面前缓缓成形。那是一道巨浪。

paras.en: “They look so scared,” Elsa said as Gale spun around the sculpture.
paras.zh: “他们看上去怕极了。”盖尔绕着冰雕旋转时，艾莎说道。

paras.en: “The waves are too high,” Queen Iduna said.
paras.zh: “浪太高了！”伊杜娜王后说。

paras.en: “We keep going for Elsa,” King Agnarr replied as a wave crashed onto the deck. “Id una!”
paras.zh: “为了艾莎，我们继续前进！”安格瑞国王答道，话音未落，一个浪头砸上甲板。“伊杜娜！”

paras.en: “Agnarr!” she shouted back.
paras.zh: “安格瑞！”她回喊道。

paras.en: “I love you!” he cried.
paras.zh: “我爱你！”他大声喊。

paras.en: “I love you!” she answered.
paras.zh: “我爱你！”她回应。

paras.en: Elsa’s parents held each other as another wave overtook them. Elsa couldn’t watch anymore and bolted from the ship.
paras.zh: 艾莎的父母紧紧相拥，被又一个巨浪吞没了。艾莎再也看不下去，猛地冲出了船外。

paras.en: “Elsa!” Anna called as she ran after her sister.
paras.zh: “艾莎！”安娜喊着，拔腿追了上去。

paras.en: Elsa doubled over on the dry riverbank, tears running down her face. She felt completely overwhelmed by what she had seen on the ship. She missed her parents more than ever. She had always known they had not survived, but now she had proof.
paras.zh: 艾莎在干涸的河岸边弯下腰去，泪水顺着脸颊滑落。船上看到的一切让她几乎承受不住。她比以往任何时候都更想念父母。她一直都知道他们没能生还，可如今，她有了铁证。

paras.en: Anna came to Elsa’s side, putting a hand on her back as she spoke softly to her. “Hey, hey, hey. What are you doing?”
paras.zh: 安娜来到艾莎身边，一只手抚着她的背，柔声安慰她。“嘿，嘿，嘿。你这是干什么？”

paras.en: “This is my fault,” Elsa confessed, her voice choked with emotion. “They were looking for answers about me.”
paras.zh: “这都是我的错。”艾莎坦白道，声音哽咽得不成样子。“他们是为了寻找关于我的答案。”

paras.en: Anna did what she could to comfort her. “You are not responsible for their choices, Elsa.”
paras.zh: 安娜竭力安慰她。“他们的选择，不该由你来负责，艾莎。”

paras.en: “No, just their deaths,” she lamented.
paras.zh: “不，只该由我对他们的死负责。”她哀伤地说。

paras.en: “Stop,” Anna demanded. “No. Yelana asked why would the spirits reward Arendelle with a magical queen? Because our mother saved our father. She saved her enemy. Her good deed was rewarded with you. You are a gift.”
paras.zh: “别这么说了。”安娜断然道。“怎么不能说。叶拉娜问过，精灵们为什么要把一位拥有魔法的女王赐给阿伦黛尔？因为我们的母亲救了父亲。她救了自己的敌人。这件善举得到的回报，就是你。你是一份礼物。”

paras.en: Elsa looked up at her sister. “For what?” she asked softly.
paras.zh: 艾莎抬起头，望着妹妹。“回报我什么呢？”她轻声问。

paras.en: “If anyone can resolve the past, if anyone can save Arendelle and free this forest, it’s you,” Anna explained. “I believe in you, Elsa, more than anyone or anything.”
paras.zh: “如果有谁能化解过去的恩怨，有谁能拯救阿伦黛尔、解放这片森林，那个人就是你。”安娜解释道。“我信任你，艾莎，胜过任何人、任何事。”

paras.en: Elsa clasped Anna’s hands tightly, grateful for her sister’s words of encouragement. She took a moment to dry her tears as she made a decision. “Honeymaren said there was a fifth spirit, a bridge between the magic of nature and us.”
paras.zh: 艾莎紧紧握住安娜的双手，感激妹妹这番鼓励的话。她拭去眼泪，下定了决心。“霍妮马伦说过，还有第五个精灵，是自然的魔法与我们之间的桥梁。”

paras.en: “A fifth spirit?” Anna asked, surprised that Elsa hadn’t told her about it before.
paras.zh: “第五个精灵？”安娜又惊又问，没想到艾莎先前从未对她提起。

paras.en: “That’s who’s been calling me…from Ahtohallan. The answers about the past are all there.”
paras.zh: “一直呼唤我的就是它……从阿塔霍兰传来。关于过去的所有答案，都在那里。”

paras.en: “So we go to Ahtohallan,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “那我们就去阿塔霍兰。”安娜说。

paras.en: Elsa did have a plan to go to Ahtohallan. But that plan did not involve her sister.
paras.zh: 艾莎确实打算去阿塔霍兰。可那个计划里并没有妹妹。

paras.en: “Not we. Me,” she said.
paras.zh: “不是我们，是我。”她说。

paras.en: Anna didn’t like Elsa’s answer at all. They were supposed to take this journey together. Grand Pabbie had entrusted her to protect Elsa, and even if he hadn’t, Anna would have never let her sister go off alone. And now to hear her say that was exactly what she wanted to do, Anna wanted answers. “What?”
paras.zh: 安娜一点儿也不喜欢这个答案。这趟旅程本该由她们姐妹俩一起走。皮比大仙曾嘱托她保护艾莎，即便没有这层嘱托，安娜也绝不肯让姐姐独自远行。如今听艾莎亲口说，这正是她一心想做的，安娜非要问个明白。“什么？”

paras.en: “The Dark Sea is too dangerous for us both,” Elsa warned.
paras.zh: “暗海对我们俩来说都太危险了。”艾莎警告道。

paras.en: “No,” Anna insisted. “No. We do this together. Remember the song? Who will stop you from going too far?”
paras.zh: “不行。”安娜坚持道。“不行。这件事我们一起做。还记得那首歌吗？谁会拦着你，不让你走得太远？”

paras.en: “You said you believed in me,” Elsa reminded her. “That this is what I was born to do.”
paras.zh: “你说过你相信我，”艾莎提醒她，“说这是我生来要做的事。”

paras.en: “And I don’t want to stop you from that,” Anna assured her. “I don’t want to stop you from being whatever you need to be!” She made one last attempt to make Elsa see things her way. “I just don’t want you dying…trying to be everything for everyone else, too. Don’t do this alone. Let me help you. Please. I can’t lose you, Elsa.”
paras.zh: “我并不想拦着你去做这件事，”安娜向她保证。“我不想阻止你成为你该成为的任何样子！”她做了最后一次努力，想让艾莎体谅她的心意。“我只是不想让你送命……不想让你为了给所有人撑起一切，连自己的命也搭进去。别一个人去。让我帮你。求你了。我不能失去你，艾莎。”

paras.en: Elsa looked at her with weary eyes. “I can’t lose you, either, Anna.” She hugged her sister and motioned for Olaf to join them. “Come on,” she encouraged him.
paras.zh: 艾莎用疲惫的眼神望着她。“我也不能失去你，安娜。”她抱了抱妹妹，又招手唤雪宝过来。“来吧。”她招呼道。

paras.en: After Olaf had joined Anna, Elsa used her powers to quickly blast a small ice path that flowed along the dry riverbed.
paras.zh: 等雪宝到了安娜身边，艾莎便施展魔力，迅速铺出一条顺着干涸河床延伸的小冰路。

paras.en: “Wait, what?” Anna asked, confused.
paras.zh: “等等，什么？”安娜一头雾水地问。

paras.en: But Elsa wasn’t done. Next, she created an iceboat right under Anna’s and Olaf’s feet. They fell back into it. Once they were seated, Elsa waved her hand to send them racing down the icy path she had created.
paras.zh: 可艾莎还没有罢手。接着，她在安娜和雪宝脚底下变出了一艘冰船。两人仰面跌坐进去。等他们坐稳，艾莎一挥手，冰船便载着他们，顺着她铺出的冰路飞驰而下。

paras.en: “What are you doing?” Anna cried. “Elsa!” She threw out her arms and did whatever she could to stop them from sliding along the ice path. “No! No! Olaf, help me stop. GIVE ME A HAND!”
paras.zh: “你在干什么？”安娜大叫。“艾莎！”她张开双臂，想尽办法要拦住他们，不让他们顺着冰路滑走。“不！不！雪宝，快帮我停下。搭把手！”

paras.en: He yanked one of his arms off and gave it to her. Anna stared at it, then she shook it. What was she supposed to do with it? How was it going to help them stop and get back to Elsa?
paras.zh: 雪宝一把扯下自己的一条胳膊，递给了她。安娜盯着那条胳膊看了半天，又摇了摇它。她拿这玩意儿能干什么？它怎么帮他们停下来、回到艾莎身边？

paras.en: Anna spotted a tree with a low-hanging branch up ahead. “Hang on!” she said. She held up Olaf’s arm and let his hand grab the branch. The boat swiveled as it changed course and flew up onto dry land. Anna and Olaf were relieved that her plan had worked!
paras.zh: 安娜看见前头有棵树，一根低垂的树枝横在半空。“抓稳了！”她说。她高高举起雪宝的胳膊，让那只手一把抓住了树枝。冰船转了个方向，斜斜飞上干地。安娜和雪宝松了口气——她的办法成功了！

paras.en: They both breathed a sigh of relief. But neither of them had counted on the speed of their iceboat, which continued to push them over a slope and down a hill. Then they splashed into a river.
paras.zh: 两人都长长地舒了一口气。可谁也没料到冰船速度如此之快，它继续推着他们冲过斜坡，又滑下一道山冈。接着，他们扑通一声溅进了一条河里。

paras.en: “Wait,” Anna said frantically. “Wait. No. No. No!” The boat raced even faster down the river than it had down the ice path. It began to spin. “Oh, come on!” Anna shouted angrily.
paras.zh: “等等，”安娜慌乱地说。“等等。不，不，不！”冰船在河里冲得比在冰路上还要快。它开始打转。“噢，够了！”安娜气恼地喊。

paras.en: “Anna,” Olaf said, “this might sound crazy, but I’m sensing some rising anger.”
paras.zh: “安娜，”雪宝说，“这话听着可能有点儿怪，可我感觉到一股怒气正在升腾。”

paras.en: Anna hit a tree when the boat rotated. “Argh! Well, I am angry, Olaf,” Anna admitted. “She promised me we’d do this together!”
paras.zh: 船身打旋，安娜撞上了一棵树。“啊！好吧，我确实在生气，雪宝。”安娜承认。“她答应过我们，要一起完成这件事的！”

paras.en: That wasn’t what Olaf had meant. “Ya-huh. But what I mean is I’m sensing rising anger in me.”
paras.zh: 雪宝指的不是这个。“呀——哈。不过我的意思是，我感觉到我自己心里也有一股怒气在升腾。”

paras.en: Anna paused in trying to stop the boat and gave the little snowman her full attention.
paras.zh: 安娜停下了阻止冰船的动作，全神贯注地看着这个小雪人。

paras.en: “Wait, you’re angry?” she asked.
paras.zh: “等等，你在生气？”她问。

paras.en: “Um…I think so?” Olaf said uncertainly. “Elsa pushed me away, too. And didn’t even say goodbye.”
paras.zh: “呃……我想是吧？”雪宝拿不准地说。“艾莎也把我推开了。连再见都没说一声。”

paras.en: Anna understood then that Olaf was just like her. “And you have every right to be very, very mad at her.”
paras.zh: 安娜这才明白，雪宝跟她一样。“那你完全有理由对她生好大好大的气。”

paras.en: “And,” he said with panic on his face. “You said some things never change, but since then everything’s done nothing but change.”
paras.zh: “还有，”他一脸慌张地说，“你说过有些事永远不会变，可自那以后，一切偏偏都在变。”

paras.en: Seeing how this had affected her friend, Anna let go of her anger. “I know. But look, I’m still here holding your hand.”
paras.zh: 看到这话对朋友的影响，安娜放下了心头的怒气。“我知道。不过你看，我还在这儿握着你的手呢。”

paras.en: Olaf felt a little better. “Yeah. That’s a good…that’s a good point, Anna. But there’s one more thing. Please, don’t leave me, too. Your parents left you both, and we left Kristoff and Sven, and then Elsa left us…and if you leave, then—”
paras.zh: 雪宝心里好受了些。“是啊。这倒是个……挺在理的说法，安娜。不过还有一件事。求求你，千万别把我也丢下。你父母抛下了你们姐妹俩，我们抛下了克里斯托夫和斯文，然后艾莎又抛下了我们……你要是也走了，那——”

paras.en: She knew he was troubled and she needed to ease his fears. “Hey, hey, hey—I’m not going to leave you, Olaf…. Not ever.”
paras.zh: 她知道他心里不安，得好好宽慰他。“嘿，嘿，嘿——我不会离开你的，雪宝……永远不会。”

paras.en: “Promise?” he asked.
paras.zh: “你发誓？”他问。

paras.en: “I promise.” Anna still had the arm he had given her to try to stop the iceboat. The pinky on the hand wiggled.
paras.zh: “我发誓。”安娜手里还攥着他扯下来、想用来拦住冰船的那条胳膊。那只手的小拇指动了动。

paras.en: “Pinky swear,” he said.
paras.zh: “拉钩发誓。”他说。

paras.en: “Pinky swear,” she confirmed, wrapping her pinky around his and shaking it.
paras.zh: “拉钩发誓。”她应道，用小拇指勾住他的小拇指，晃了晃。

paras.en: An odd thought occurred to Olaf. “Did you ever notice that our smallest finger contains our most positive swear power, while our longest finger contains our most nega—”
paras.zh: 雪宝忽然冒出一个古怪的念头。“你有没有发现，咱们最短的手指，蕴含的誓约力量最正面，而最长的手指蕴含的却是最负——”

paras.en: Anna slammed a hand over his mouth. “Olaf. No. Shhh!” The banks of the river were covered in sleeping Earth Giants.
paras.zh: 安娜一巴掌捂住了他的嘴。“雪宝。别说了。嘘！”河的两岸趴满了沉睡的大地巨人。

paras.en: He didn’t see them at first. “Don’t shush me. That’s rude and—” Then he saw them and lowered his voice to a whisper. “Oh, the giants…. They’re huge.”
paras.zh: 他起初没有看见。“别让我闭嘴。这很没礼貌，而且——”这时他看见了，立刻压低了声音，悄声说，“噢，巨人……好大的个儿。”

paras.en: Anna and Olaf silently glided past them. Anna saw up ahead that the river split into two paths. One path was lined with Earth Giants. The other led to a waterfall.
paras.zh: 安娜和雪宝悄无声息地从他们身边滑过。安娜望见前方的河分成了两条水道。一条水道两岸都是大地巨人。另一条通向一道瀑布。

paras.en: “Hang on, Olaf,” Anna said, having made a split-second decision about which way was best. “Try not to scream.” She reached out and grabbed a branch that redirected them toward the waterfall and away from the giants.
paras.zh: “抓稳了，雪宝。”安娜说，电光石火之间，她已决定走哪条路最好，“尽量别尖叫。”她伸手抓住一根树枝，把他们引向瀑布，避开了巨人。

paras.en: Moments later, they careened down the rushing water toward a pit.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，他们顺着湍急的水流歪歪斜斜地冲向一个深坑。

paras.en: Olaf screamed.
paras.zh: 雪宝尖叫起来。

paras.en: Anna slammed two rocks together and created a spark to light a piece of driftwood. The Lost Caverns that the waterfall had deposited them in lit up. She spotted Olaf’s carrot and reached to grab it out of the water as it floated by. “Found it.”
paras.zh: 安娜把两块石头狠狠相击，迸出火花，点燃了一截浮木。瀑布把他们冲进的迷踪洞窟被照亮了。她瞅见雪宝的胡萝卜顺水漂过，便伸手从水里捞了起来。“找到了。”

paras.en: She carried the torch back to Olaf. He was putting his body back together on the shore of a pool of water. The broken iceboat and Anna’s wet cloak were next to him. Anna pushed Olaf’s carrot back into his face.
paras.zh: 她举着火把走回雪宝身边。他正在水潭边，把自己散落的身子重新拼起来。碎裂的冰船和安娜湿透的斗篷就搁在他旁边。安娜把雪宝的胡萝卜重新按回他脸上。

paras.en: He spit out a fish and a mouthful of river water. “Thank you. Where are we?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他吐出一条鱼和一口河水。“谢谢你。我们在哪儿？”他问。

paras.en: Anna looked up at the waterfall. “In a pit with no way out?”
paras.zh: 安娜抬头望向那道瀑布。“在一个无路可出的坑底？”

paras.en: Olaf spotted a dark opening behind a rock and ran to it. “But with a spooky, pitch-black way in.” He smiled back at her as he pointed to it.
paras.zh: 雪宝发现一块岩石后面有个黑漆漆的洞口，跑了过去。“不过，倒有个阴森森、黑黢黢的入口。”他指着洞口，回头冲她一笑。

paras.en: Anna approached him and looked into the opening. She couldn’t decide if it was worth the risk of whatever was inside. They could wait in the pit for help, but how would anyone ever find them down there?
paras.zh: 安娜走近他，朝洞口里张望。她拿不定主意，里头不知藏着什么，冒这个险值不值。他们可以在坑里等救援，可又有谁能到这地底下来找他们呢？

paras.en: Olaf grabbed her hand and gave a little tug. “Come on,” he said. “It’ll be fun, assuming we don’t get stuck here forever, no one ever finds us, and you starve and I give up.”
paras.zh: 雪宝抓住她的手，轻轻一拽。“走吧，”他说，“肯定很好玩儿——只要我们不永远困在这儿、没人找得到我们、你活活饿死而我放弃挣扎的话。”

paras.en: Anna hesitated and looked around for another way out. But after seeing nothing else, she sighed and gave Olaf a nod. She held tightly to his hand and stepped into the darkness.
paras.zh: 安娜犹豫了，四下张望，想找找别的出路。可看了一圈别无他路，她叹了口气，朝雪宝点了点头。她紧紧攥着他的手，一步步走进黑暗。

paras.en: “But, bright side: Elsa’s gotta be doing a whole lot better than we are,” Olaf said, sounding hopeful.
paras.zh: “不过，往好处想：艾莎眼下肯定比我们顺当多了。”雪宝满怀希望地说。

paras.en: Elsa stood on the shore of a dark, rocky beach that night while the wind whipped her hair around her face. The ferocious waves rose high and crashed before her on the shore like thunder. She gazed out across the waters and saw an icy landmass in the far distance. She had done it. She had made it to the Dark Sea. Now she just had to make it across.
paras.zh: 那天夜里，艾莎站在一片黑黢黢、遍布岩石的海滩上，狂风把她的头发吹得在脸前乱舞。凶猛的浪头高高掀起，在她面前的岸边轰然炸裂，声如雷鸣。她极目远望，看见远方有一片冰封的陆地。她做到了。她抵达了暗海。如今，她只消横渡过去。

paras.en: Determined, Elsa removed her coat and boots. She released her hair from its braid and tied it behind her neck before taking a deep breath. She sprinted toward the tumbling waves. Frozen snowflakes radiated from each footfall, supporting her weight.
paras.zh: 艾莎下定决心，脱下外套和靴子。她解开发辫，把长发在颈后束好，然后深吸一口气。她朝着翻涌的浪涛飞奔而去。每一步落下，都绽开冰晶雪花，稳稳托住她的身躯。

paras.en: Twenty feet from the shoreline, the waves overtook her, knocking her down and shattering the ice she’d made.
paras.zh: 离岸二十尺处，浪头追上了她，把她掀翻在地，也击碎了她造出的冰。

paras.en: Elsa was not going to give up. Dripping wet, she started over. She ran full force at the sea. She got past the first set of waves by leaping onto a large rock that sat a short distance from the shore. Then she froze the seawater that crashed against the rock and used it to make a slide to gain speed for her attack on the second set of waves.
paras.zh: 艾莎绝不认输。浑身湿透的她从头再来。她拼尽全力冲向大海。她纵身跃上离岸不远的一块巨石，越过了第一波浪。接着她冻住拍打岩石的海水，用它造出一道冰滑梯，为冲击第二波浪蓄足了速度。

paras.en: One of those waves was colossal, however. It soared high above her. Elsa tried to freeze it, but it was too powerful. The ice wall she had attempted to create crashed on top of her, plunging her beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 可其中一道浪大得骇人。它高高地凌驾在她头顶。艾莎想把它冻住，可它太凶猛了。她试图筑起的冰墙轰然塌下，压在她身上，把她卷进了水下。

paras.en: In the darkness underwater, waves continued to roll overhead. Lightning flashed, brilliantly illuminating the depths of the sea around her as she headed for the surface. But when the second electrical strike lit up the sky, it also showed what appeared to be a huge, ferocious horse deep in the water below. The horse swam up and looked her in the eye. Lightning struck again and the horse, the Water Spirit, was gone.
paras.zh: 水下的黑暗中，浪头仍在头顶翻滚。闪电划过，将她周遭的深海照得雪亮，她正奋力朝水面游去。可当第二道闪电劈亮天空时，也照出了下方深水里一匹巨大而凶猛的马。那马游上来，直直与她对视。闪电再度劈下，那匹马——水灵——已无影无踪。

paras.en: Elsa clawed her way to the surface. Waves tossed her as she looked down to see the Water Nokk galloping up from the depths, heading straight for her. She created an ice sheet to float on top of the water’s surface, and pulled herself onto it just in time for the Water Spirit to ram her vessel and send her careening into the air.
paras.zh: 艾莎奋力划水，浮出水面。浪头把她抛来掷去，她低头望去，只见水灵诺克正从深处飞驰而上，直冲她而来。她造出一块浮在水面的冰板，刚把自己拉上去，水灵便一头撞碎了她脚下的“船”，把她甩上了半空。

paras.en: Struggling to breathe, Elsa turned to see the horse attacking again.
paras.zh: 艾莎挣扎着喘息，回头看见那马又扑了上来。

paras.en: Its hooves drove her underwater. She tried to break free as it pushed her deeper and deeper. She grabbed onto the Water Nokk’s hooves and froze the horse. It resisted, and then the Water Spirit shattered into billions of particles of ice.
paras.zh: 马蹄将她踩入水下。它把她越压越深，她拼命想挣脱。她一把抓住水灵诺克的马蹄，将马冻住。它奋力抗拒，随后整匹水灵碎成了亿万冰晶。

paras.en: Elsa swam straight up, hoping to get away before the Water Nokk re-formed itself. She reached the surface, but the horse was right there and threw her out of the water.
paras.zh: 艾莎径直向上游，想赶在水灵诺克重组之前逃开。她浮出水面，可那马就在眼前，猛地把她抛出水面。

paras.en: Lightning flashed.
paras.zh: 闪电划过。

paras.en: Elsa created a giant ice wave that collapsed onto the Water Nokk.
paras.zh: 艾莎造出一道巨大的冰浪，朝水灵诺克当头压下。

paras.en: Lightning flashed again.
paras.zh: 闪电再次划过。

paras.en: Underwater, Elsa made an ice shield to block the horse. It burst through the shield as if nothing were there at all.
paras.zh: 水下，艾莎筑起冰盾去挡那马。它如入无人之境，径直撞穿了冰盾。

paras.en: Lightning flashed once more.
paras.zh: 闪电又是一闪。

paras.en: Above the water, the Water Nokk grabbed Elsa’s arm and dragged her through the waves. She fought to breathe. Desperate, she used her magic to throw out an ice bridle. It hooked onto the Water Spirit’s mouth and head. She swung around and landed on the horse’s back.
paras.zh: 水面上，水灵诺克咬住艾莎的手臂，拖着她穿过重重浪涛。她挣扎着，喘不上气来。情急之下，她用魔力甩出一副冰做的马勒。马勒扣住了水灵的嘴和头。她借势一荡，稳稳落在了马背上。

paras.en: The Water Nokk panicked and bucked. But Elsa yanked on the reins and tried to gain control. The horse surfaced and turned toward the icy landmass that Elsa had seen in the distance. It ran, fighting, trying to throw her off, refusing to give in to her commanding hold.
paras.zh: 水灵诺克惊慌地扬起前蹄乱踢。可艾莎猛拉缰绳，竭力要制服它。那马浮出水面，转向艾莎先前望见的那片冰封陆地。它一路狂奔，奋力挣扎，想把她甩下去，不肯向她的掌控屈服。

paras.en: Elsa pulled the reins tighter and pressed her legs down harder until the horse responded. Finally, its stride evened out and she relaxed her grip. They moved together, Elsa and the Water Nokk.
paras.zh: 艾莎把缰绳勒得更紧，双腿夹得更紧，直到那马终于服帖下来。终于，它的步子平稳了，她也松了松手劲。艾莎和水灵诺克合着同一个节拍前行。

paras.en: The icy landmass came into view ahead. It appeared to be an island. As Elsa got closer, she realized it was more than an island. It was a giant glacier that sparkled with magic. She was overwhelmed with joy.
paras.zh: 前方，那片冰封的陆地已渐渐清晰。它看上去像一座岛。艾莎越靠越近，才发觉它远不止是一座岛。那是一块闪耀着魔法的巨大冰川。她喜不自胜。

paras.en: “Of course,” she whispered. “Glaciers are rivers of ice.” The voice she had longed to reach called out to her, closer than ever. “Ahtohallan is frozen.” All she had to do was reach the secret river.
paras.zh: “原来如此，”她轻声说，“冰川就是冰的河流。”她渴望已久的那声音唤起了她，比以往任何时候都近。“阿塔霍兰是冻结的。”她只需抵达那条秘密的河。

paras.en: The voice continued to call to her, filling her ears. It sounded almost joyful, as if it knew she was near.
paras.zh: 那声音不断呼唤着她，灌满她的双耳。它听起来几乎是欢欣的，仿佛知道她已近在咫尺。

paras.en: “I hear you,” Elsa said, “and I’m coming.”
paras.zh: “我听见你了，”艾莎说，“我来了。”

paras.en: She snapped the reins and the Water Nokk quickened its pace.
paras.zh: 她一抖缰绳，水灵诺克加快了步伐。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Elsa couldn’t stop trembling with anticipation as she approached Ahtohallan with the Water Spirit. Knowing the voice that had been calling to her was there gave her comfort.
paras.zh: 艾莎与水灵一同逼近阿塔霍兰，激动得浑身颤抖，怎么也停不下来。想到那一直呼唤她的声音就在那里，她心里便觉得安稳。

paras.en: The Water Nokk turned when they reached the shore, allowing Elsa to leap onto the icy white beach. The ground shimmered when her feet landed. It was a magical response. She felt power emanating all around her. It felt like she was home.
paras.zh: 抵达岸边时，水灵诺克转过身来，让艾莎一跃跳上那片冰白的沙滩。她的双足落地，地面泛起粼粼微光。那是魔法的回应。她感到力量从四面八方涌来。那感觉，就像回到了家。

paras.en: The horse shook its mane and turned back to the Dark Sea, slowly dissipating into the water. Elsa’s eyes moved from it and gazed up at the giant ice cave that stretched endlessly in front of her. She moved toward an opening in the ice that loomed like a fortress.
paras.zh: 那马甩了甩鬃毛，转身游回暗海，缓缓消散在水中。艾莎的目光从它身上移开，仰望眼前那座绵延不绝、望不到尽头的巨大冰洞。她朝那个如堡垒般巍然耸立的冰之入口走去。

paras.en: Elsa shivered as she looked at the glacier ahead of her. Ahtohallan, the secret river from Mother’s lullaby. It’s real, she thought. There was something about it that seemed so…familiar. She wondered if the familiarity came from the calling of the voice, or from the connection of magic. Because of how the colored lights twinkled and danced around the entrance to Ahtohallan, she knew it was full of magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎望着眼前的冰川，不由打了个寒颤。阿塔霍兰，妈妈摇篮曲里那条秘密的河。它是真的，她想。它身上有种东西，让人感到如此……熟悉。她说不清，这份熟悉是来自那声音的呼唤，还是来自魔法的羁绊。阿塔霍兰的入口四周彩光闪烁、流转变舞，她由此知道，那里蕴藏着满满的魔法。

paras.en: Elsa boldly stepped into the opening of the ice cave, instantly feeling like she was finally where she was meant to be. She looked around with wonder at the smooth white walls, wondering what kinds of secrets were inside Ahtohallan. Elsa was nervous, but eager to find out.
paras.zh: 艾莎大步迈入冰洞的入口，顷刻间便觉得，自己终于来到了命中注定的所在。她惊奇地环顾光滑洁白的洞壁，猜想阿塔霍兰里面究竟藏着怎样的秘密。艾莎有些紧张，却又迫不及待想一探究竟。

paras.en: The voice continued to call to Elsa in its haunting melody, and she answered back with confidence. She had always known that the voice wanted to help her, but she’d never imagined it would lead her to Ahtohallan. She moved around the cave’s entrance, following the call, willing to go where it led, ready for the voice to reveal itself. She was ready to learn.
paras.zh: 那声音仍以幽婉的旋律呼唤着艾莎，而她满怀自信地应和着。她一直都知道，那声音是想帮她，却从没想过，它会把自己引到阿塔霍兰。她沿着洞口一路前行，循着呼唤而去，愿意追随它到任何地方，随时准备迎接那声音现出真身。她已准备好去了解真相。

paras.en: The voice guided Elsa to a door in the ice. All she had to do was open it. The voice called to her again, stronger, and Elsa responded. Reaching out without hesitation, she pulled the door open and rushed forward, overcome with emotion and excitement for whatever lay ahead. She would do whatever it took to reach the voice. Every inch of her tingled to be with it as she dodged sharp, beautiful crystals that adorned the walls.
paras.zh: 那声音引着艾莎，来到一扇冰门之前。她只需把它打开。那声音再次呼唤她，比先前更加有力，艾莎应声回应。她毫不迟疑地伸出手，拉开门冲了进去，为前方未知的一切心潮澎湃、激动难抑。为了抵达那声音，她愿付出一切代价。她闪避着洞壁上那些锋利而美丽的冰晶，浑身上下每一寸都因渴望与它会合而微微发颤。

paras.en: Elsa had never been more certain of anything in her life. She was there for a reason—and maybe it was the same reason she had been born. She was different from everyone else, and it was time to find out why. She didn’t tremble anymore. She just needed the voice to show her where she belonged.
paras.zh: 艾莎一生中从未对什么事如此笃定。她来此是有缘由的——而这缘由，或许正是她降生的缘由。她与众人不同，如今是时候弄清缘由了。她不再颤抖。她只需要那声音告诉她，何处是她的归属。

paras.en: The path through the cavern was not an easy one. The voice led Elsa over pillars of ice that tumbled as she leaped from one to the next. It called her to the bottom of a deep ravine, which she reached by creating a long staircase of ice that she ran down. Elsa met every challenge and triumphed.
paras.zh: 穿过洞窟的路并不好走。那声音引着艾莎跳过一根根冰柱，她从一个跃向下一个，冰柱在身后纷纷崩落。它又把她唤向一道深谷的谷底，她造出一道长长的冰梯，一路跑了下去。艾莎迎接每一个挑战，并一一胜过。

paras.en: Finally, she found herself in a giant room with a domed roof, where memories danced along the walls and ceiling. The memories were fuzzy, unclear. Though Elsa tried as hard as she could, she couldn’t make out what they were.
paras.zh: 终于，她来到一间有着穹顶的巨大厅堂，记忆在四壁与穹顶上翩然舞动。那些记忆影影绰绰，模糊不清。艾莎用尽全力，也辨不清它们是什么。

paras.en: But the young queen could see the symbols for the spirits of nature, dancing and swirling around her. She reached for them, forming them into giant diamonds of ice. With her magic, she guided the diamonds to the floor, assembling them in the same snowflake pattern that was knitted into her mother’s scarf. But one was missing: the fifth element, the bridge between nature and people. Elsa stepped into the empty space and fulfilled her destiny.
paras.zh: 可这位年轻的女王看得见自然之灵的符文，正绕着她舞动盘旋。她伸手将它们聚拢，凝成巨大的冰之菱形。她用魔力把菱形引到地面，依照妈妈围巾上织着的那种雪花图案，一一拼合起来。可少了一块：第五元素，自然与人之间的桥梁。艾莎踏入那片空位，完成了自己的使命。

paras.en: The dome above her instantly illuminated with memories, but this time they were sharp and crystal clear. Perhaps it was a reward. The voice called to her again, and Elsa knew it too was one of the memories. When she called back, the memory clarified and came forward, facing her and singing the haunting melody. It all made sense. She stepped toward it and sang alongside the memory of her mother, who, as a young girl, had called out the day the forest fell.
paras.zh: 头顶的穹顶霎时被记忆照亮，而这一次，它们纤毫毕现、清晰如水晶。这或许是一种褒奖。那声音再次呼唤她，艾莎明白了，它自己也是一段记忆。当她应声而唱，那段记忆便清晰起来，向前浮现，面对着她，唱起那支幽婉的旋律。一切都豁然明朗。她朝它走去，与母亲年轻时的记忆合唱——森林陷落的那一天，正是少女时代的母亲发出了呼唤。

paras.en: Elsa understood why her mother had been there. Elsa had risked her life by moving through air, fire, water, and earth to be there. She was born for this and had proven her worth when she’d met up with the spirits of nature.
paras.zh: 艾莎明白了母亲当年为何会在那里。艾莎穿越风、火、水、土，冒死才来到这里。她为这一切而生，并在与自然精灵相遇时证明了自己的价值。

paras.en: As Elsa sang along in harmony with the memory of Iduna, she began to transform into who she was always meant to be. Her dress spun around her body, and her hair fell loose and wildly untamed. A crown of vines and leaves adorned her head as the other elements swirled around her—air, fire, water, and earth. Elsa had transformed into the element Honeymaren had spoken of. Elsa was the fifth spirit, the bridge between nature and people. She was the Snow Queen.
paras.zh: 当艾莎与伊杜娜的记忆和声而唱，她开始蜕变成自己命中注定的模样。她的裙裾绕身飞旋，长发披散开来，肆意而不羁。藤蔓与枝叶编成的冠冕戴上她的头顶，其余的元素——风、火、水、土——绕着她盘旋飞舞。艾莎已然化作霍妮玛伦所说的那个元素。艾莎就是第五个精灵，是自然与人之间的桥梁。她就是冰雪女王。

paras.en: With her hands, Elsa manipulated the giant symbols suspended in the air and used them to build a new snowflake, with the elements as the branches and herself as the center. This was the version of herself that Elsa had been waiting for her entire life, and it was what the other elements had been waiting for as well.
paras.zh: 艾莎用双手拨弄悬浮在空中的巨大符文，以诸元素为枝、以自己为中心，拼出一朵崭新的雪花。这就是艾莎等待了一生的自己，也是其余元素一直在等待的。

paras.en: As Elsa looked around, the memories played out in front of her. It was as if her transformation was the key that had unlocked them.
paras.zh: 艾莎环顾四周，记忆在她面前一幕幕上演。仿佛她的蜕变，正是开启这些记忆的钥匙。

paras.en: Elsa raised her arms and used her magic to draw the memories closer. They landed all around her, the icy reflections of the past. Unlike the sculptures she had made in the forest, these moved and interacted with her. The voices were as clear as if the people in the memories were there in person. At first it seemed she didn’t know them, but as she looked closer, she gasped in surprise.
paras.zh: 艾莎抬起双臂，用魔力把记忆拉近。它们纷纷落在她四周，是往昔岁月的冰之映影。与她在森林里造的那些冰雕不同，这些映影会动，还会与她互动。那些声音清晰得仿佛记忆中人就亲临现场。起初她似乎认不出他们，可定睛细看，她惊讶得倒吸一口气。

paras.en: The first memory was of a young girl twirling high in the wind and a boy looking after her. She recognized them as her parents, on the day the Northuldra and Arendellians had fought in the forest. Her mother was riding on the currents of Gale.
paras.zh: 第一段记忆里，一个小女孩在风中高高盘旋，一个男孩在一旁照看着她。她认出那是她的父母，正是北地人和阿伦黛尔人在森林里交战的那一天。她的母亲正乘着盖尔的气流飞翔。

paras.en: Taking another step, Elsa recognized the memory that had solidified into a statue in the forest—it was her mother holding her father as she saved him. Elsa gasped when she realized why the image was suspended in the air; the Wind Spirit had lifted them out of the Enchanted Forest while others were locked in. It was Gale. Gale had always been there to protect Elsa’s family, even before she was born.
paras.zh: 再迈一步，艾莎认出了那段在森林里凝成雕像的记忆——正是母亲救起父亲时抱住他的情景。艾莎恍然明白这影像为何悬在半空，不由倒吸一口气：是风灵把他们托出了魔法森林，而其他人却被困在其中。是盖尔。盖尔一直在守护着艾莎的家人，早在她出生之前便是如此。

paras.en: Elsa walked faster as new memories appeared with every step she took. She saw her mother in an orphanage in the woods outside Arendelle. “No one knew who you were,” she heard. “You didn’t have any family with you.”
paras.zh: 艾莎越走越快，每迈一步，都有新的记忆浮现。她看见母亲在阿伦黛尔城外林中的一所孤儿院里。“没人知道你是谁，”她听见，“你身边一个亲人也没有。”

paras.en: She passed the next memories in a hurry—there were so many to see. Anna riding by as a child, standing on the seat of her bike. The bishop announcing the day Elsa took the throne: “Presenting Queen Elsa of Arendelle.” Elsa’s mother studying old documents in the library of the castle: “What have you found?” asked her father. “I think we’ve been looking on the wrong side of the sea,” her mother replied.
paras.zh: 接下来的几段记忆她匆匆掠过——要看的东西实在太多。童年的安娜骑车经过，站在车座上。艾莎登基那天，主教高声宣告：“阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王陛下！”艾莎的母亲在城堡书房里翻检旧文献：父亲问：“你发现了什么？”母亲答道：“我想，我们一直找错了海的那一边。”

paras.en: Elsa moved through crowds while continuing to watch her family. She spotted Hans talking to Anna. “I’m great, actually,” she said to him. He bowed and introduced himself. “Prince Hans of the Southern Isles.” Elsa threw a blast of power, shattering that memory, before walking on.
paras.zh: 艾莎穿过攒动的人群，目光始终追随着自己的家人。她瞥见汉斯正和安娜说话。“其实我好得很，”她对他说。他鞠了一躬，自报家门：“南方群岛的汉斯王子。”艾莎甩出一道魔力，击碎了那段记忆，继续前行。

paras.en: She watched a younger version of herself and her sister, fascinated. “Conceal, don’t feel; conceal, don’t feel….” Elsa kept moving.
paras.zh: 她入迷地看着年幼的自己和妹妹。“藏起来，别去感受；藏起来，别去感受……”艾莎继续走着。

paras.en: Anna’s voice rang out: “I love you, Olaf!”
paras.zh: 安娜的声音朗朗响起：“我爱你，雪宝！”

paras.en: Elsa smiled when she saw her parents’ wedding. “To have and to hold, from this day forward—” her father promised. Then there were her parents when they were younger. She laughed as she watched her mother drop from a tree and sit next to her father. “Iduna,” said Agnarr. “What are you reading, Your Majesty?” a teenage version of her mother asked. “Some new Danish author,” he said.
paras.zh: 看到父母的婚礼，艾莎笑了。父亲许诺：“无论顺境逆境，从今以后，执手相守——”接着是更年轻的父母。她看着母亲从树上跳下、坐到父亲身旁，不禁笑出声来。“伊杜娜，”安格瑞唤道。“陛下在读什么呢？”少女时代的母亲问。“一位丹麦新作家的书，”他说。

paras.en: Elsa blasted the memory with her magic and continued walking. This time she found her parents as adults, and they were embracing. “I need to tell you about my past, and where I am from,” Iduna said sadly. “I’m here,” said Agnarr, pulling her into his arms.
paras.zh: 艾莎用魔力击碎这段记忆，继续前行。这一次，她看见成年的父母相拥在一起。“我得告诉你我的过去，还有我来自何方，”伊杜娜忧伤地说。“我在这儿，”安格瑞说着，把她拥入怀中。

paras.en: Elsa felt a breeze above her and looked up. The wind carried her father and mother, young teenagers in this memory, and placed them on an Arendellian cart. She watched her mother place a blanket over her father, then drape an Arendellian cloak around herself as soldiers arrived. “Get the prince out of here,” a soldier said to the wagon driver.
paras.zh: 艾莎感到头顶一阵微风，抬头望去。风托起记忆中还是少年的父母，把他们放到一辆阿伦黛尔的马车上。她看着母亲给父亲盖上毯子，又往自己肩头披上阿伦黛尔的斗篷，这时士兵们赶到了。“把王子带离这里，”一名士兵对车夫说。

paras.en: Elsa sensed someone behind her.
paras.zh: 艾莎察觉到身后有人。

paras.en: “Lieutenant Mattias,” a voice said. She turned to see a royal Arendellian walk by with another soldier at his side. A much younger Mattias turned at the sound of his king’s voice.
paras.zh: “马蒂亚斯中尉，”一个声音说。她转过身，看见一名阿伦黛尔的王室侍卫走过，身旁跟着另一名士兵。年轻得多的马蒂亚斯听到国王的声音，转过头来。

paras.en: “Grandfather—” Elsa whispered, seeing King Runeard for the first time.
paras.zh: “祖父——”艾莎低声道，第一次见到了鲁纳德国王。

paras.en: “We bring Arendelle’s full guard,” the king ordered.
paras.zh: “我们带来了阿伦黛尔的全部卫队，”国王下令。

paras.en: “But they have given us no reason not to trust them,” argued Mattias.
paras.zh: “可他们并没有给我们不信任他们的理由，”马蒂亚斯争辩道。

paras.en: Elsa’s grandfather shook his head. “The Northuldra follow magic, which means we can never trust them.”
paras.zh: 艾莎的祖父摇了摇头。“北地人信奉魔法，这意味着我们永远不能信任他们。”

paras.en: His words hurt and deeply troubled Elsa. ­“Grandfather?” she said softly.
paras.zh: 这些话刺痛了艾莎，令她深感不安。“祖父？”她轻声说。

paras.en: “Magic makes people feel too powerful, too entitled. It makes them think they can defy the will of a king,” said King Runeard firmly.
paras.zh: “魔法让人自觉太过强大，太过尊贵。让他们以为自己能违抗国王的意志，”鲁纳德国王斩钉截铁地说。

paras.en: Elsa shook her head. “That is not what magic does,” she said. “That’s just your fear. Fear is what can’t be trusted.”
paras.zh: 艾莎摇了摇头。“魔法不是这样的，”她说。“那只是你的恐惧。恐惧才是不可信任的东西。”

paras.en: Her grandfather and the soldier walked right through the glacier wall in front of them. Mattias stayed where he stood and just watched them. Anna desperately wanted to follow to see what happened next. She threw out her hands and used her power to cut a large hole in the ice wall.
paras.zh: 祖父和那名士兵径直穿过了眼前的冰川壁。马蒂亚斯站在原地，只是默默望着他们。安娜急切地想跟上去，看看接下来发生了什么。她伸出双手，用魔力在冰壁上切开一个大洞。

paras.en: In the distance, the faint sounds of her mother’s lullaby filled the air, reminding her that if she went too far into Ahtohallan, she would never be able to return. But Elsa needed to know what had happened in the forest that day. She needed the truth.
paras.zh: 远处，母亲摇篮曲的微弱旋律在空中回荡，提醒着她：若在阿塔霍兰里走得太深，就再也回不去了。可艾莎必须弄清那天森林里发生了什么。她需要真相。

paras.en: She stepped through the hole in the wall that she had created and into a dark, narrow passageway that slowly sloped downward. She walked along it with unsure steps. As her hands rubbed against the wall, memories came alive on it.
paras.zh: 她穿过自己凿开的墙洞，走进一条幽暗狭窄、缓缓下斜的通道。她脚步迟疑地沿通道前行。双手摩挲着洞壁，壁上的记忆随之活了过来。

paras.en: “The dam will weaken their lands,” her grandfather said to the soldier with him. “So they’ll have to turn to me.”
paras.zh: “水坝会削弱他们的土地，”祖父对身边的士兵说，“那时他们便只能来依附我。”

paras.en: On the wall ahead, she saw the mighty dam. Many Northuldra, gathered from far and wide, disappeared down a steep drop at the end of the narrow path. As Elsa approached, echoes from the chamber of memories became more and more distant.
paras.zh: 前方的壁面上，她看见了那座雄伟的大坝。许多北地人从四面八方聚拢而来，在窄道尽头消失于一处陡降的断崖之下。艾莎走近时，记忆之厅的回声越来越远。

paras.en: “They will come in celebration, and then we will know their size and strength,” her grandfather said.
paras.zh: “他们会带着庆典而来，那时我们便可摸清他们的人数与实力，”祖父说。

paras.en: Elsa stopped at the edge of the drop and looked down, wondering if she should go farther. She saw her grandfather addressing the large group of Northuldra in front of him.
paras.zh: 艾莎在断崖边缘停下脚步，朝下望去，思量着是否该再往前走。她看见祖父正对着面前一大群北地人讲话。

paras.en: “As you have welcomed us, we welcome you. Our neighbors. Our friends,” King Runeard said.
paras.zh: “你们欢迎了我们，我们也欢迎你们。我们的邻居，我们的朋友，”鲁纳德国王说。

paras.en: The Northuldra leader stopped him. “King Runeard, the dam isn’t strengthening our waters. It’s hurting the forest. It’s cutting off the north!”
paras.zh: 北地人的首领打断了他。“鲁纳德国王，水坝并没有让我们的水域丰沛。它在伤害森林。它在截断北方！”

paras.en: King Runeard nodded as if he were listening. As if he were concerned. “Let’s not discuss this here. Let’s meet on the fjord. Have tea. Find a solution.”
paras.zh: 鲁纳德国王点了点头，仿佛在倾听。仿佛很是关切。“这事别在这儿谈。我们去峡湾上碰头。喝杯茶，想个解决办法。”

paras.en: “Who will stop you from going too far?” the memory of Anna’s voice reminded Elsa.
paras.zh: “谁会拦住你，不让你走得太远？”安娜声音的记忆提醒着艾莎。

paras.en: Elsa looked back up the path to the magical light of the chamber of memories, debating whether she should return or move forward. She heard voices coming from it.
paras.zh: 艾莎回头望向通道上方记忆之厅的魔法之光，权衡着该折返还是前行。她听见里面传来人声。

paras.en: “No one really knows what happened that day,” someone said. It was when she’d first met the Northuldra. Then her father: “For Arendelle’s sake.” More voices. “You’re trapped here, too!” Yelana shouted. “We’ve never even seen the real sky,” Ryder complained. “A wrong demands resolution,” said Pabbie. “Without it…I see no future.”
paras.zh: “没人真正知道那天发生了什么，”有人说。那是她初次遇见北地人的时候。接着是父亲的声音：“为了阿伦黛尔。”更多的人声。“你们也被困在这里了！”叶拉娜喊道。“我们连真正的天空都没见过，”莱德抱怨道。“冤屈必须昭雪，”皮比大仙说，“否则……我看不见未来。”

paras.en: Elsa decided that moving forward was the only choice there ever was. She let her body fall through the darkness until she landed in a forest made of ice. It felt empty and uninviting. It was so cold that Elsa shivered for the first time in her life. The cold had never bothered her before.
paras.zh: 艾莎认定，向前走是唯一的选择。她任由身体坠入黑暗，落进一片冰雪筑成的森林。那里空空荡荡，了无生气。冷得艾莎平生第一次打起了寒颤。寒冷从未困扰过她。

paras.en: She spotted her grandfather walking determinedly through the forest. She started to follow him and noticed Northuldra festivities in a nearby clearing. She moved quickly, searching for her purpose there, the ground freezing around her feet with each step.
paras.zh: 她望见祖父正神色决然地穿过森林。她开始跟上去，注意到附近的一片空地上正在举行北地人的庆典。她快步前行，寻找着自己来此的目的，每迈一步，脚下的地面便冻结起来。

paras.en: Up ahead, she saw the Northuldra leader sitting on the edge of a rock. Elsa was caught by surprise when a snowy image of her grandfather passed through her, heading for the Northuldra leader with a drawn sword in hand. Elsa was horrified by what he was about to do. She reached out to stop him.
paras.zh: 前方，她看见北地人的首领坐在一块岩石的边缘。一个祖父的雪影从艾莎身上穿过，手持出鞘的利剑朝北地人首领走去，惊得她怔在原地。他即将要做的事，让艾莎惊骇万分。她伸手想去拦他。

paras.en: “No!” she shouted. She was devastated to see what had really happened in the past, and she wanted to change it more than anything. But she couldn’t.
paras.zh: “不！”她喊道。亲眼目睹过去真正发生的事，她心如刀绞，比什么都更想改变它。可她无能为力。

paras.en: Ice crept up her body, slowly covering it. She panicked and focused on breathing. She tried to use her powers to force the ice off her, but it didn’t work.
paras.zh: 寒冰顺着她的身体往上攀爬，缓缓将她覆盖。她慌了，竭力专注于呼吸。她试图用魔力逼退身上的冰，却无济于事。

paras.en: The ice crept up her neck and toward her face. At that point, she knew she had gone too far, just like her mother’s lullaby had warned, and there was no way to return. She gathered all her magic to release in a last-minute signal to Anna. Only one stream of magic escaped, slicing through the air.
paras.zh: 冰爬上她的脖颈，向她的脸庞蔓延。那一刻她明白，自己走得太远了，正如母亲摇篮曲所警示的那样，再也无法回头。她凝聚起全部魔力，要在最后一刻向安娜发出信号。只有一道魔流挣脱而出，破空而去。

paras.en: “Anna…,” she called out desperately. A second later, she was completely encased in ice.
paras.zh: “安娜……”她绝望地呼唤。一秒之后，她被彻底封进了冰里。

paras.en: “Which lucky tunnel do we choose?” Olaf asked as he and Anna reached a fork in their path back in the Lost Caverns.
paras.zh: “我们该选哪条幸运的隧道呢？”雪宝问道。他和安娜在返回迷踪洞窟的路上，走到了一个岔路口。

paras.en: A gust of wind swept across Anna’s face, forcing her to close her eyes. It was even strong enough to make Olaf stumble backward.
paras.zh: 一阵风扫过安娜的脸，逼得她闭上了眼睛。风势之猛，连雪宝都被吹得踉跄后退。

paras.en: “Whoa…,” Olaf said.
paras.zh: “哇哦……”雪宝说。

paras.en: They turned their faces into the wind and witnessed a stream of magic and snow floating on it. Then an ice sculpture formed in front of them.
paras.zh: 他们迎着风转过脸，看见一缕魔法携着雪花在风中飘浮。接着，一座冰雕在他们眼前成形。

paras.en: Olaf stared at it in concern, confused by what it meant. Anna slowly walked around it, examining every detail.
paras.zh: 雪宝忧心忡忡地盯着它，不明白这意味着什么。安娜缓缓绕着它走，细看每一处细节。

paras.en: “Elsa’s found it,” she said.
paras.zh: “艾莎找到了。”她说。

paras.en: “What is it?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: “找到了什么？”雪宝问。

paras.en: “The truth about the past,” Anna answered. It was a sculpture of a man standing with his sword raised over another man, who was sitting. His back was turned to the standing man. The sitting man seemed unaware of the danger as he raised a cup to his lips.
paras.zh: “关于过去的真相。”安娜答道。雕刻的是一个站着的男人，他高举长剑，剑锋直指另一个坐着的男人。坐着的男人背对着他。坐着的人浑然不觉危险临近，正举杯欲饮。

paras.en: Anna realized who the men were. “That’s my grandfather, attacking the Northuldra leader, who wields no weapon.” She knew it had to be true—all the ice sculptures they’d encountered had revealed what had really happened in the past. “The dam wasn’t a gift of peace. It was a trick.”
paras.zh: 安娜认出了这两个男人。“那是我祖父，正在袭击北地人的首领——而他手里根本没有武器。”她知道这必定是真的——他们一路遇到的所有冰雕，揭示的都是过去真实发生的事。“这座大坝不是和平的馈赠。而是一个骗局。”

paras.en: “That goes against everything Arendelle stands for,” Olaf said in shock.
paras.zh: “这可违背了阿伦黛尔的一切立国之本啊。”雪宝震惊地说。

paras.en: “It does, doesn’t it?” Anna agreed. She hung her head as the gravity of the situation took hold. “I know how to free the forest. I know what we have to do to set things right.”
paras.zh: “是啊，不是吗？”安娜说。她垂下头，深深感到事态的沉重。“我知道该怎么解放森林了。我知道该怎么做，才能弥补这一切。”

paras.en: “Why do you say that so sadly?” Olaf asked. He thought it was the most exciting he’d heard all year.
paras.zh: “你为什么说得这么难过？”雪宝问。他觉得这是他一整年来听过的最令人兴奋的消息。

paras.en: Anna slumped on a rock and put her head in her hands. She always did what was best for her people. She’d never thought things would come to this.
paras.zh: 安娜颓然坐倒在岩石上，双手抱住了头。她做的每一件事，都是为了她的子民好。她从没想过事情会走到这一步。

paras.en: “We have to break the dam,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们得毁掉大坝。”她说。

paras.en: Olaf thought that was the worst idea he’d heard all year. He thought maybe Anna had been in the caves too long.
paras.zh: 雪宝觉得这是他一整年来听过的最糟糕的主意。他心想，也许是安娜在洞里待得太久了。

paras.en: “But Arendelle will be flooded!” he said.
paras.zh: “可阿伦黛尔会被淹没的！”他说。

paras.en: Anna had already thought about that, and hated that there was no other way. “That’s why everyone was forced out. To protect them from what must be done.” They hadn’t been forced out of Arendelle because the spirits hated them. They had been forced out so that they could live.
paras.zh: 这个问题安娜早就想过，她痛恨的是，除此之外再没有别的办法。“正因为如此，大家才被迫撤离。是为了保护他们，让他们远离那件不得不做的事。”大家被迫离开阿伦黛尔，并不是因为精灵憎恨他们。他们被赶走，是为了能够活下去。

paras.en: “Oh…. Are you okay?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: “噢……你还好吗？”雪宝问。

paras.en: Anna wasn’t sure that “okay” was the right word. She felt sick to her stomach. “I could really use a bright side, Olaf.”
paras.zh: 安娜不确定“好”这个字眼用在这里是否恰当。她只觉得胃里一阵翻腾。“我现在真的很需要一点好消息，雪宝。”

paras.en: “Um?” He found something that was sure to cheer her up. “Turtles can breathe through their butts. And…I see a way out.”
paras.zh: “嗯？”他找到了一件准能让她高兴起来的事。“乌龟能用屁股呼吸。还有……我看见一条出路。”

paras.en: Anna smiled. “I knew I could count on you.”
paras.zh: 安娜笑了。“我就知道能指望你。”

paras.en: Olaf smiled, too. But as Anna turned away from him, he stumbled backward and put a hand to his forehead.
paras.zh: 雪宝也笑了。可就在安娜转身离开时，他却向后踉跄了一下，伸手扶住额头。

paras.en: “Come on, Olaf,” she said, not noticing he was in distress. “Elsa’s probably on her way back right now. We can meet her, and—” Then she saw snow beginning to flurry off her friend and float into the air. Something was very wrong. “Olaf…?”
paras.zh: “快点，雪宝。”她说，没有察觉他正痛苦难当。“艾莎这会儿说不定已经在回来的路上了。我们去接她，然后——”就在这时，她看见雪花开始从朋友身上纷纷飘散，飞向空中。情况非常不对劲。“雪宝……？”

paras.en: He looked at the snow flying off his body. “What’s this…?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: 他看着自己身上飘飞的雪花。“这是怎么……？”雪宝问。

paras.en: “Are you okay?” Anna asked, having no idea what to do to help him. She had a very bad feeling.
paras.zh: “你还好吗？”安娜问道，全然不知该如何帮他。她心里升起一股强烈的不祥预感。

paras.en: Olaf didn’t understand why his body was literally floating away piece by piece. “I’m flurrying?” he said. Then larger clumps of snow blew off his body and sailed into the sky. “Wait. That’s— That’s not it. The magic in me is fading away. I don’t think Elsa’s okay….” He watched more of his body break apart. “Anna, I think she may have gone too far.”
paras.zh: 雪宝不明白，自己的身体为什么正一片一片地飘走。“我这是……在下雪？”他说。接着，更大团的雪从他身上吹落，飘向天空。“等等。不对——不是这么回事。我体内的魔法正在消散。我觉得……艾莎出事了。”他眼看着自己的身体继续一块块碎裂开来。“安娜，我想她可能走得太远了。”

paras.en: Anna’s eyes widened in alarm. “What? No…no.”
paras.zh: 安娜惊恐地瞪大了眼睛。“什么？不……不会的。”

paras.en: Olaf looked down at his little body, changing with every bit of it that drifted away. He wasn’t sure what it meant, but knew one thing: “Anna…I’m scared.”
paras.zh: 雪宝低头看着自己小小的身体，随着每一片的飘散而不停改变着模样。他说不清这意味着什么，但有一件事他很清楚：“安娜……我害怕。”

paras.en: Anna was struck by the fear on his face as she began to understand what was going on. If something had happened to Elsa, if Elsa didn’t exist anymore, then Olaf couldn’t exist. Anna fell to her knees before him, suddenly terrified but trying not to show it.
paras.zh: 他脸上的恐惧刺痛了安娜，她开始明白发生了什么。如果艾莎出了事，如果艾莎不复存在，那雪宝也就无法存在了。安娜跪倒在他面前，心里骤然涌起恐惧，却拼命不表现出来。

paras.en: “No, no, no,” she said. “It’s okay. It’s okay.” She pulled Olaf into her arms, holding back tears. “You don’t have to be scared. I’m right here.”
paras.zh: “不，不，不。”她说。“没事的。没事的。”她把雪宝搂进怀里，强忍着泪水。“你不用害怕。我就在这儿。”

paras.en: “Oh, that’s good,” Olaf said as she held him close. “Remember when you promised not to leave me?” He looked up at her face sadly. “I’m so sorry I forgot to promise not to leave you. You’re gonna have to do this next part on your own.”
paras.zh: “噢，那太好了。”雪宝被她紧紧抱住，说道。“还记得你答应过我，说不会离开我吗？”他伤心地抬起头，望着她的脸。“真抱歉，我忘了答应你也不离开你。接下来的路，你只能自己走了。”

paras.en: Anna swallowed hard as a single tear slid down her cheek. “You’re not leaving me, Olaf…. Not ever…”
paras.zh: 安娜艰难地咽了一下，一滴泪珠顺着脸颊滑落。“你不会离开我的，雪宝……永远都不会……”

paras.en: “Hey, Anna,” he said weakly, limp in her arms. “I just thought of one thing that’s permanent.”
paras.zh: “嘿，安娜。”他虚弱地说，整个人瘫软在她怀里。“我刚想到了一样永恒不变的东西。”

paras.en: “What’s that?” she asked.
paras.zh: “是什么？”她问。

paras.en: “Love.”
Anna touched her heart. “Warm hugs.” She pulled him close and held on tight.
paras.zh: 安娜抚住心口。“温暖的拥抱。”她把他拉近，紧紧抱住。

paras.en: “I like warm hugs,” Olaf said, returning her embrace.
paras.zh: “我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”雪宝说着，回抱住她。

paras.en: Anna choked on a sob, not wanting to accept what was happening to her friend as snow flurries filled the air. “I love you.”
paras.zh: 空中雪花纷飞，安娜哽咽难言，不愿接受正在朋友身上发生的一切。“我爱你。”

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven approached the ice sculpture of young Iduna saving young Agnarr in the ice garden that Elsa had created after their interaction with the Wind Spirit. As Kristoff watched, all of Elsa’s icy imagery flaked away. He held on to Sven, worried about what it meant for Elsa and Anna.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文走近一座冰雕——那是艾莎与风灵接触之后，在冰之花园里造出的景象：少女伊杜娜救起了少年安格瑞。克里斯托夫眼看着艾莎造出的冰之影像纷纷剥落。他紧紧扶住斯文，担心这对艾莎和安娜来说意味着什么。
