paras.en: Outside the forest, Elsa’s ice palace began to melt. Warm water dripped from the dome ceiling and down the walls into the main room downstairs. The stairs and pillars crumbled into chunks of crushed ice. The magnificent ice chandelier that lit up the whole ground floor fell with a resounding crash. Then the second floor collapsed onto the first floor in a watery splash.
paras.zh: 森林之外，艾莎的冰宫开始融化。温热的水从穹顶滴落，顺着墙壁淌进楼下的大厅。楼梯和立柱崩裂成一块块碎冰。照亮整个底楼的那盏华美冰吊灯轰然坠落，发出震耳的碎裂声。紧接着，二楼轰然塌落在一楼上，水花四溅。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Grand Pabbie stood on the cliff overlooking Arendelle Castle and the village. The townspeople had set up camp behind him, waiting for Elsa and Anna to return with answers. He watched as the icy castle broke apart and floated into the sky. He took a deep breath and hung his head, understanding and fearing what it meant for Elsa. He looked over his shoulder, knowing he needed to tell the villagers the truth about their queen, but he wasn’t sure where to begin.
paras.zh: 皮比长老站在悬崖上，俯瞰着阿伦黛尔城堡和村庄。镇民们在他身后扎营等候，等待艾莎和安娜带回答案。他望着那座冰城堡碎裂开来，飘向天空。他深吸一口气，垂下头，既明白又害怕这一切对艾莎意味着什么。他回头望去，知道自己必须把有关女王的真相告诉村民们，却不知该从何说起。

paras.en: Anna curled up on the cold, wet ground and sobbed. Her heart was broken. How could she go on without her sister? Without Olaf? She had failed them both. Even after Grand Pabbie had warned her to keep Elsa safe, she hadn’t. Anna felt hopeless.
paras.zh: 安娜蜷缩在冰冷潮湿的地上，低声啜泣。她的心碎了。没有了姐姐，她要怎么活下去？没有了雪宝呢？她辜负了他们两个。即便皮比长老嘱咐过她要护艾莎周全，她也没能做到。安娜感到万念俱灰。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: It had been a long time since Anna had moved. A cold breeze drifted over her and she shuddered. She had no idea how many hours she had been there. With a deep sigh, she sat up and brushed at the tearstains on her cheeks. She looked around for any sign of hope.
paras.zh: 安娜已经很久没有动过了。一阵寒风拂过，她打了个寒颤。她不知道自己已经在这儿待了多久。她深深叹了口气，坐起身，擦去脸颊上的泪痕。她环顾四周，想找到一丝希望的迹象。

paras.en: “Olaf, Elsa,” she called out, in case somehow they could hear her. “What do I do now?” There was no answer. But Anna hadn’t expected one. She knew without a doubt that along with Olaf, her sister was gone.
paras.zh: “雪宝，艾莎。”她喊道，万一他们能听见呢。“我现在该怎么办？”没有回答。可安娜本来也没指望有回应。她毫不怀疑，姐姐已经和雪宝一样，不在了。

paras.en: Anna had seen and felt darkness before, but nothing like what was in the life that lay in front of her. That life felt cold, empty, numb. The life she had always known was gone forever. There was no light left in her world, and she needed to accept her fate.
paras.zh: 安娜见过黑暗，也感受过黑暗，却从没有哪一次，比得上摆在她面前的人生里这一片。那样的人生，冰冷、空虚、麻木。她所熟知的那个世界，永远地逝去了。她的世界再没有光亮，她必须接受自己的命运。

paras.en: She had always followed Elsa, but now Elsa had gone to a place she could not find. Anna was overcome with grief, but a tiny voice whispered in her mind that even though she was lost and it was hard for her to feel hope, she still needed to keep going. She couldn’t just stop—there was more work to do. Anna simply needed to do the next right thing. And that was break the dam that had been built by her grandfather in hatred.
paras.zh: 她一向追随着艾莎，可如今艾莎去了一个她再也找不到的地方。安娜被悲伤淹没，可心底有个细微的声音在低语：即便她已迷失，即便难以怀抱希望，她仍要继续走下去。她不能就此停下——还有事要做。安娜只需去做眼前正确的事。那就是毁掉那座她祖父出于仇恨筑起的大坝。

paras.en: Anna clutched her satchel to her chest and tried to stand, but she didn’t have the strength to even lift herself off the ground. Though she wasn’t sure it was worth it without Elsa to guide her, she tried again and stood on her unstable legs by balancing her weight on the cave wall. All she had to do was put one foot in front of the other. If she didn’t think about it, if she just kept moving, maybe she could do it.
paras.zh: 安娜把行囊紧抱在胸前，想站起来，却连从地上撑起身子的力气都没有。虽然她不确定，没有了艾莎的指引，这一切是否还值得，她还是又试了一次，靠着洞壁稳住重心，用发软的双腿站了起来。她要做的，只是一步接着一步往前走。如果不去多想，只管向前，也许她能做到。

paras.en: Anna summoned all the determination she had left in her to begin her climb out of the pit, one step at a time. She couldn’t worry about any danger ahead—it was too much to take in. Every step was a choice to keep going. Anna turned her mind to the goal that was bigger than herself. She would focus on that, because thinking about what she had lost was unbearable.
paras.zh: 安娜汇聚起残存的全部决心，一步一步，开始攀出深坑。前方的危险她无暇去想——那实在超出了她能承受的极限。每走一步，都是一次继续前行的抉择。安娜把心思转向那个比自己更重大的目标。她要专注于此，因为一旦去想失去的一切，她就会崩溃。

paras.en: Step after step moved Anna forward and upward. She soon came to a steep cliff. There were only two ways to proceed—by taking a leap of faith off the cliff and hoping she landed on the ground on the other side of a ravine, or by climbing down. Before, she would have taken a breath and a moment of thought, but not today. She had to keep moving forward. She ran to the end of the precipice and jumped as far as she could, landing hard with a thud. Fog surrounded her, so thick that she couldn’t see her hands in front of her. But Anna continued forward, refusing to quit.
paras.zh: 一步又一步，安娜向前走着，向上爬着。她很快来到一处陡峭的悬崖。只有两条路可走——要么纵身一跃，凭信念相信自己能落进深谷另一侧的地面上，要么顺着崖壁往下爬。若是往日，她会先深吸一口气，思忖片刻，可今天不会。她必须不停向前。她奔到悬崖尽头，拼尽全力一跃，重重地摔落在地。浓雾将她包围，雾气浓得连伸在眼前的手都看不见。可安娜继续向前，拒绝放弃。

paras.en: She soon emerged from the darkness of the caverns and out into the light. Anna shielded her eyes as she walked through the long waving grass on a cliff overlooking the forest. As she looked out, she knew she had to do what no sane person would ever do. She had to destroy one of the only things she had left that she loved—Arendelle. As much as it hurt, it was the right thing to do.
paras.zh: 她很快走出洞窟的黑暗，来到了光亮之中。安娜走在俯瞰森林的悬崖上，穿过大片摇曳的长草，抬手遮在眼前。放眼望去，她知道，自己必须去做一件任何头脑清醒的人都不会做的事。她必须亲手毁掉自己仅存的挚爱之一——阿伦黛尔。纵然痛彻心扉，这也是正确的选择。

paras.en: Regaining her strength, Anna climbed down into the fields and walked as fast as she could to the shores of the river. It was the same river she and Olaf had sailed down in their iceboat, where the Earth Giants had been sleeping…and still were. Determined, Anna took a deep breath.
paras.zh: 缓回几分力气，安娜爬下悬崖，进入田野，加快脚步朝河岸赶去。这正是她和雪宝乘冰船漂下的那条河，大地巨人当时就沉睡在这里……此刻依旧沉睡。安娜下定决心，深吸一口气。

paras.en: “WAKE UP! WAKE UP!” she shouted.
paras.zh: “醒醒！醒醒！”她大喊。

paras.en: A giant groaned and attempted to stand, clasping his head, disoriented. He couldn’t get his bearings and stumbled, crashing onto the other sleeping giants, waking them all up.
paras.zh: 一个巨人呻吟着，抱住脑袋，晕头转向地想站起来。他辨不清方向，踉跄着摔倒，压在其他沉睡的巨人身上，把他们全都惊醒了。

paras.en: Anna’s eyes widened as she wondered if her idea had been a good one after all. It had to be—it was the only way for her plan to work.
paras.zh: 安娜瞪大了眼睛，开始怀疑自己的主意到底好不好。一定是好的——这是她的计划能够奏效的唯一办法。

paras.en: “That’s it,” she said. “Come and get me. Come on!”
paras.zh: “就是这样。”她说。“来抓我呀。来啊！”

paras.en: Another giant slammed his hand down on the riverbank as he pulled himself up onto the mainland, rising to his full monstrous height. His brothers rose after him and rubbed the sleep from their eyes. They all turned to look at Anna and let out bone-rattling roars.
paras.zh: 另一个巨人一掌拍在河岸上，撑起身子爬上陆地，直起他那骇人的高大身躯。他的兄弟们跟着站起，揉去眼中的睡意。他们齐齐转头看向安娜，发出震彻骨髓的咆哮。

paras.en: Anna turned and sprinted through the woods as the force of the roar blew her off her feet. “Over here—ahh!” She quickly got up and glanced back to make sure the giants were still coming after her. “That’s right! Keep coming! Keep coming!”
paras.zh: 安娜转身冲进树林，咆哮的气浪把她掀翻在地。“这边——啊！”她迅速爬起来，回头确认巨人还在追她。“没错！继续追！继续追！”

paras.en: She ducked in and out of trees, dodging the massive fists slamming down toward her. One giant threw a massive boulder that landed way too close. She looked at the heavy rock as she kept running.
paras.zh: 她在树间穿梭躲闪，避开一记记朝她砸下来的巨拳。一个巨人掷出一块巨石，落点近得吓人。她一边狂奔，一边瞥了一眼那块巨石。

paras.en: “That’ll work,” she said. “This way, guys!”
paras.zh: “那个够用了。”她说。“这边走，伙计们！”

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Mattias and his men stood on a high ridge and watched Anna lead the Earth Giants—who crushed everything in sight—toward them.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯和手下站在高高的山脊上，眼看着安娜把见什么毁什么的大地巨人朝他们这边引来。

paras.en: “What the—” he said. He didn’t know why she would invite such wrath upon them, but he let his eyes follow the path she was leading the giants down. When he realized what she was doing, his heart nearly stopped. “No, no, no, no. She’s leading them to the dam!” He raced in that direction with his soldiers following right behind.
paras.zh: “搞什么——”他说。他不明白她为什么要把这样的怒火引到大家头上，但目光还是顺着她引领巨人的路线望去。当他看明白她在做什么时，心脏几乎停跳。“不，不，不，不。她要把他们引到大坝去！”他朝那个方向飞奔而去，士兵们紧随其后。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Kristoff rode Sven as they meandered through the woods with their heads hanging down, not paying attention to anything around them. But Kristoff’s head shot up when he heard thundering booms and caught a glimpse of the Earth Giants lumbering past them through the trees.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫骑着斯文，垂着头在林中漫无目的地走着，对四周的一切浑不在意。可当雷鸣般的轰响传来、大地巨人的身影从树间蹒跚掠过时，克里斯托夫猛地抬起了头。

paras.en: Anna burst unexpectedly out of the bushes in front of him, and Kristoff saw the shadow of a giant’s foot cast over her. Kristoff spurred Sven on, slipped under the giant’s foot as it began to lower, and quickly scooped Anna up. Sven galloped away with them.
paras.zh: 安娜突然从他面前的灌木丛里冲了出来，克里斯托夫看见一只巨人的脚投下的阴影正笼罩着她。克里斯托夫一夹斯文冲了上去，趁那只巨脚还未落尽从底下钻过，一把将安娜捞起。斯文驮着他们疾驰而去。

paras.en: “Kristoff!” She couldn’t believe he was there, but she had never been so happy to see someone before. She tried to catch her breath. All the running and scrapes and scratches from bushes and tree limbs left her weak and in pain. Yet her heart hurt worse than any physical pain. Her eyes teared up as she looked at him. “Olaf and Elsa—”
paras.zh: “克里斯托夫！”她不敢相信他就在眼前，可她从来没有这么高兴见到过谁。她努力喘匀了气。一路狂奔，再加上被灌木和树枝刮出的道道伤痕，让她虚弱又疼痛。可心口的痛，远比身上的伤更烈。她望着他，眼眶湿润了。“雪宝和艾莎——”

paras.en: “I know,” he answered, “I know.” He could feel that something bad had happened to them, but he wasn’t going to let anything happen to Anna. And she had clearly been running through the shrubbery, pursued by the Earth Giants, with a purpose in mind. “What do you need?”
paras.zh: “我知道，”他答道，“我知道。”他能感觉到他们遭了不测，但他绝不让安娜再出任何事。况且，她显然是带着目的，才一路穿过灌木丛、被大地巨人追赶至此的。“你需要什么？”

paras.en: “To get to the dam!” she said without explanation.
paras.zh: “去大坝！”她答道，来不及解释。

paras.en: Kristoff couldn’t make sense of the situation, but he trusted the woman he loved. The Earth Giants trying to crush them didn’t matter. “You got it. I’m here.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫理不清眼下的状况，但他信任自己深爱的这个女子。就算被大地巨人碾扁也顾不上了。“交给我。我在这儿。”

paras.en: “Thank you.” Anna held on to Sven’s mane as they ran under a canopy of trees, disappearing from the giants for a moment. This allowed the friends to get ahead while the giants blindly searched for them. Sven emerged from under the cover of the brush and galloped up a slope that led to the decades-old dam. Anna saw the dam wasn’t in very good shape. She hadn’t noticed it the day they’d entered the Enchanted Forest, and this new information lit a flare of hope in her. Now her plan had an even better chance of working.
paras.zh: “谢谢你。”安娜抓着斯文的鬃毛，他们从树冠下疾驰而过，暂时躲开了巨人的视线。这让几个伙伴抢到了前头，巨人还在盲目地搜寻他们。斯文从灌木的掩蔽下冲出，奔上一道斜坡，直通那座历经数十年风雨的大坝。安娜看出，大坝的状况已经很糟了。他们初进魔法森林那天她并没有注意到这一点，这个新发现让她心里燃起一线希望。如今她的计划更有把握成功了。

paras.en: Sven skidded to a halt when they reached a raised bank of land he was unable to cross.
paras.zh: 斯文在一处高起的土坡前急停，那坡他跨不过去。

paras.en: “Help me up!” Anna said.
paras.zh: “拉我上去！”安娜说。

paras.en: Kristoff assisted Sven as he tossed Anna into the air, high enough so she could grab on to the edge of the cliff. Kristoff waited long enough to make sure she had pulled herself up and was safe, then he said, “I’ll meet you around!”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫帮着斯文，把安娜抛向空中，高得足以让她抓住崖边的沿口。克里斯托夫等到确认她已攀上崖顶、安全无虞，才说：“我绕过去跟你汇合！”

paras.en: Anna nodded and ran for the hill. The dam was so close, and as she lengthened her stride, again hope flashed through her. She could do this. She WOULD do this.
paras.zh: 安娜点点头，朝山丘跑去。大坝近在咫尺，她迈开大步，希望又一次掠过心头。她能做到。她一定能做到。

paras.en: Nothing was going to stop her now. Anna raced toward the dam…to find Mattias and his soldiers on guard. She slid to a halt, breathing heavily. “Lieutenant Mattias.”
paras.zh: 如今，没有什么能拦住她了。安娜朝大坝飞奔而去……却看见马蒂亚斯和士兵们正在把守。她急急刹住脚，气喘吁吁。“马蒂亚斯将军。”

paras.en: He stood firmly in his spot. “Your Highness, what are you doing?”
paras.zh: 他站在原地，纹丝不动。“殿下，您这是在做什么？”

paras.en: “The dam must fall,” she advised him. “It’s the only way to break the mist and free the forest.” Even as Anna said it, she felt her shattered heart crack a little more. But it was the right thing to do, no matter how devastating it felt.
paras.zh: “大坝必须倒。”她告诉他。“这是破除迷雾、解放森林的唯一办法。”话一出口，安娜就觉得自己那颗破碎的心又裂开了几分。可这是正确的事，无论感觉多么撕心裂肺。

paras.en: Mattias was conflicted. He felt he could not disobey an order from someone in the royal family, even though the order was in direct opposition to his ultimate directive.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯内心交战。他觉得不能违抗王室成员的命令，尽管这道命令与他最终的职责直接相悖。

paras.en: “But we have sworn to protect Arendelle at all costs,” he said. His soldiers stood at the ready.
paras.zh: “可我们发过誓，要不惜一切代价保卫阿伦黛尔。”他说。他的士兵们严阵以待。

paras.en: “Arendelle has no future until we make this right,” Anna declared. She didn’t have enough time to explain everything—the Earth Giants would soon be there. “King Runeard betrayed everyone. He built the dam out of hate. Hate cannot stand. Please, before we lose anyone else.”
paras.zh: “不把这一切纠正过来，阿伦黛尔就没有未来。”安娜宣告。她没时间把一切解释清楚——大地巨人马上就到了。“鲁纳德国王背叛了所有人。他出于仇恨修筑了大坝。仇恨是无法长存的。求你了，趁我们还没失去更多人。”

paras.en: Mattias took a deep breath as he studied her face and saw her desperation, her weariness. He nodded and banged his sword on his shield. His troop mirrored his action. The soldiers immediately fanned out and made as much noise as they could, shouting and yelling to lure the giants to them.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯深吸一口气，端详着她的脸，看见了她的绝望与疲惫。他点了点头，用剑敲响盾牌。他的部下也照做。士兵们立刻散开，拼命制造声响，又喊又叫，把巨人引向自己。

paras.en: Mattias and Anna headed for the entrance to the dam. A loud whistle announced a flying boulder coming straight for them. Anna ran forward while Mattias pushed a soldier out of the way to protect him from being smashed.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯和安娜朝大坝的入口走去。一声呼啸响起，一块巨石直冲他们而来。安娜向前猛冲，马蒂亚斯则把一名士兵推开，保护他不致被砸中。

paras.en: “Look out!” he called to the others.
paras.zh: “小心！”他朝其他人喊道。

paras.en: The boulder landed, smashing the top of the dam and separating Anna from the soldiers. She was the only one on the actual dam—the soldiers were stranded outside it. She was the only one who could finish the job. Full of renewed energy, she ran out to the center and faced the Earth Giants, who stomped toward her.
paras.zh: 巨石轰然落下，砸碎了大坝顶部，把安娜和士兵们隔开了。坝体上只剩下她一个人——士兵们都被困在外面。只有她能完成这件事。她重新蓄满力气，跑到坝中心，直面朝她踏来的大地巨人。

paras.en: “Destroy the dam!” she shouted at them with all her might. “Throw your boulders!”
paras.zh: “毁掉大坝！”她用尽全力朝他们喊。“把石头朝我扔！”

paras.en: The giants lobbed huge rocks at her, determined to crush the person who had intruded upon their territory and woken them from their sleep.
paras.zh: 巨人们朝她掷来一块块巨石，决意碾碎这个闯入领地、惊扰他们沉睡的家伙。

paras.en: “That’s it,” she said as she raced back to where she had come from.
paras.zh: “就是这样。”她说着，朝来路狂奔回去。

paras.en: But one of the giants had great aim, and the colossal stone it threw crashed in front of her, destroying her escape route. She quickly turned and ran in the opposite direction, doing whatever she could to not be an easy target. Boulders continued to crash behind her, and the dam began to splinter. The heavy weight of the water pushed against the weakened spot, aiding in the dam’s destruction. Anna struggled to run faster than she had ever run before to outpace the crashing dam and reach the safety of land.
paras.zh: 可其中一个巨人瞄得极准，它掷出的巨石在她面前轰然砸落，堵死了她的退路。她迅速转身朝反方向跑去，想方设法不让自己变成活靶子。巨石接连在她身后砸落，大坝开始绽裂。洪水的重压顶向坝体薄弱之处，加速了大坝的崩毁。安娜拼尽全力狂奔，跑得比以往任何时候都快，想抢在崩塌的大坝前头，冲上安全的陆地。

paras.en: As she felt the ground she was standing on slip beneath her foot, Anna leaped in desperation, her hands grasping for anything.
paras.zh: 脚下的大地突然从脚底塌陷，安娜绝望地纵身一跃，双手在空中乱抓。

paras.en: But there was nothing for her to grab on to, and she felt herself falling…until a hand reached out and grabbed her arm just before she vanished forever.
paras.zh: 可什么也抓不到，她感觉自己正在坠落……直到一只手猛地伸出，在她永远消失之前抓住了她的手臂。

paras.en: It was Mattias! At first he struggled not to plunge into the cascading waters that had burst over the dam, and then he was able to brace himself. He held Anna tightly, refusing to let go as Kristoff ran up to him.
paras.zh: 是马蒂亚斯！起初他拼命稳住自己，不让自己跌进漫过大坝的滔滔激流，随后才撑住了身形。他紧紧抓住安娜，说什么也不肯松手，这时克里斯托夫奔了过来。

paras.en: “I’ve got her,” Mattias assured him. “Hang on.”
paras.zh: “我抓住她了。”马蒂亚斯向他保证。“撑住。”

paras.en: “Anna!” Kristoff yelled, terrified to see his love in such danger. He reached around Mattias, and the two of them pulled her up together. Anna melted into Kristoff’s embrace, unable to hold back her tears.
paras.zh: “安娜！”克里斯托夫大喊，看见心爱的人身陷险境，他惊恐万分。他从马蒂亚斯身侧伸过手去，两人合力把她拉了上来。安娜瘫进克里斯托夫的怀抱，泪水再也止不住。

paras.en: But the tears weren’t for herself, or for the predicament she had been in. They were for everything she had lost that day…Elsa, Olaf, and now her beloved Arendelle.
paras.zh: 可这泪水不是为她自己，也不是为方才的险境。而是为那一天她失去的一切……艾莎、雪宝，还有如今她挚爱的阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Mattias slowly got to his feet and brushed off his well-worn uniform. He saw the way Anna gravitated to Kristoff, and how the burly mountain man had done whatever he had to do to save her. Mattias knew without a doubt that they were meant to be together. He put a hand on Kristoff’s shoulder. “Hold her tight.”
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯慢慢站起身，掸了掸那身磨损的旧制服。他看见安娜怎样依偎向克里斯托夫，也看见这个魁伟的山里人为救她怎样奋不顾身。马蒂亚斯毫不怀疑，他们注定要在一起。他把手搭在克里斯托夫的肩上。“抱紧她。”

paras.en: Kristoff was already doing just that. He held Anna as close as he could without hurting her, never wanting to let her go. He kissed her forehead and swore he would never lose her again.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫早就在这么做了。他尽所能把安娜搂紧，却又不弄疼她，再也不想放开。他吻了吻她的额头，发誓绝不再失去她。

paras.en: The dam crumbled as raging water tore the rest of it apart and raced into the fjords, making the land around them shake violently.
paras.zh: 大坝崩塌了，狂怒的洪水撕碎残垣，冲进峡湾，四周的大地剧烈震颤。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Across the Dark Sea in Ahtohallan, an immense crack formed in the chunk of ice Elsa was encased in. As the crack spread across the surface of the ice, the chunk took on the form of a large snowflake. Crude representations of each of the elements were etched into every point. And in the snowflake’s center, at its heart, lay Elsa.
paras.zh: 暗海彼岸的阿塔霍兰，封冻着艾莎的那块巨冰上，裂开了一道巨大的缝。裂缝在冰面上蔓延开来，那块冰渐渐显出一朵巨大雪花的形状。每一个冰角上都镌刻着四大元素的粗朴图形。而在雪花的中心、它的核心处，正是艾莎。

paras.en: From the top of the glacier, a symbol of light shot into the sky, illuminating it. The Earth Giants and Bruni, the Fire Spirit, turned and saw the symbol.
paras.zh: 从冰川顶端，一道光的符号射向天空，照亮了天际。大地巨人和火灵布鲁尼转过身，看见了那道符号。

paras.en: With a thunderous CRACK, the ice that held Elsa finally split, and she slipped down into the cold waters below—as the Water Nokk watched.
paras.zh: 伴随着一声雷霆般的脆响，囚住艾莎的寒冰终于迸裂，她滑落进下方的冰冷湖水——水灵诺克正注视着这一切。

paras.en: High up on the cliffs above Arendelle, the villagers, the mountain trolls, and the castle residents wandered about. They talked to one another and tried to remain patient as they waited for Elsa, Anna, and the rest of the group to return from the Enchanted Forest. They wanted to know what had happened in their village.
paras.zh: 在阿伦黛尔上方的高崖上，村民们、山地地精和城堡里的居民正四处走动。他们彼此交谈，努力耐着性子，等待艾莎、安娜和其余同伴从魔法森林归来。他们想知道，村庄里究竟发生了什么。

paras.en: Then a dull roar filled the air, growing louder with every moment. The people and trolls looked at each other, curious.
paras.zh: 这时，一声低沉的轰鸣响彻空中，而且一刻响过一刻。人们和地精面面相觑，满心好奇。

paras.en: “There!” a child shouted.
paras.zh: “那儿！”一个孩子喊道。

paras.en: Some Arendellians screamed and others fell to their knees, seized with dread and devastation as a monstrous wave tore down the fjord without mercy toward their beloved kingdom and homes. Any hope they had of returning to their houses was being ripped apart piece by piece as the raging water shredded every tree in its path and blasted boulders out of the way like they were tiny pebbles. Soon there would be nothing left but memories of the kingdom and the lives they had built there with love.
paras.zh: 一些阿伦黛尔人放声尖叫，另一些跪倒在地，恐惧与绝望攫住了他们——一道骇人的巨浪正无情地顺着峡湾，朝他们深爱的王国和家园席卷而来。怒水撕碎沿途的每一棵树，把巨石像小石子一样轰开，他们重返家园的希望正被一片一片扯碎。用不了多久，除了对这个王国、对他们在这片土地上以爱筑起的生活的回忆，将什么都不复存在。

paras.en: As the beginning of the tidal wave reached the castle and village, gently pushing at the shoreline before sweeping in with a giant blow…the Water Nokk rose from the fjord’s depths—and on its back rode Elsa!
paras.zh: 当海啸的前沿抵达城堡与村庄，先轻轻推了推岸线，随即化作巨力猛然席卷而入……水灵诺克从峡湾深处升起——艾莎正骑在它的背上！

paras.en: Elsa reached out and magically pulled back the wave with the Water Spirit supporting her. She made the water crest and curl back toward the fjord—where its energy dissipated as the water moved away from the village and castle of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 艾莎伸出手，在水之灵的扶持下，以魔力将浪头拉了回去。她让水峰卷起、回转向峡湾——随着水远离阿伦黛尔的村庄与城堡，它的力量也随之消散。

paras.en: The town now safe, the elements that had deserted Arendelle that night not long before swept back into the village. The waterfalls flowed again, wind fluttered the flags, light returned to the lanterns, and the cobblestones became smooth enough to walk on.
paras.zh: 小镇转危为安，就在不久前那夜弃阿伦黛尔而去的元素们，重新涌回了村庄。瀑布重新流淌，风拂动着旗帜，灯火重新点亮灯笼，鹅卵石路面也变得平整好走了。

paras.en: On the cliff top, the Arendellians watched in amazement, speechless. Grand Pabbie stepped forward and smiled as he bowed to Elsa.
paras.zh: 崖顶上，阿伦黛尔人惊叹地望着，说不出话来。皮比长老走上前，微笑着向艾莎鞠躬。

paras.en: Elsa acknowledged her longtime friend with a nod. The Water Nokk reared up with Elsa still on its back, spun on its hind feet, then raced up the fjord at great speed, toward where the dam in the Enchanted Forest had once stood.
paras.zh: 艾莎颔首致意，答谢这位相识多年的老友。水灵诺克驮着艾莎扬起前身，以后蹄为轴一转，便以惊人的速度沿峡湾疾驰而去，奔向魔法森林里那座大坝曾经矗立的地方。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff stood together, holding each other but not speaking. It wasn’t the time for words. After the destruction of the dam, they had joined the Arendellian soldiers and gone back to the Northuldra camp.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫站在一起，相拥着，谁也没有说话。此刻无需言语。大坝摧毁之后，他们与阿伦黛尔的士兵会合，回到了北地人的营地。

paras.en: What came next happened with almost imperceptible slowness. Anna was staring at the edge of the mist, and she realized it had thinned. Now she was able to make out what was on the other side of the fog. And with every moment that passed, the items on the outside looked clearer and clearer, until the impenetrable mist was nothing but a bad memory. She sighed with relief. Anna would have been devastated if she had broken the dam and allowed the destruction of her beloved Arendelle for nothing. She leaned deeper into Kristoff and he hugged her back.
paras.zh: 接下来的变化，缓慢得几乎难以察觉。安娜凝视着迷雾的边缘，发觉它变薄了。如今，她已经能分辨出雾的那一边是什么了。每过一刻，雾外的景物就清晰一分，直到那道不可穿越的迷雾，只剩下一段糟糕的回忆。她如释重负地叹了口气。若是毁了大坝、任由心爱的阿伦黛尔被摧毁，到头来却是一场空，安娜会痛不欲生。她更紧地依偎向克里斯托夫，他回抱住她。

paras.en: The Northuldra and the Arendellian soldiers basked in the sudden bright sunlight as the mist cleared all around and above them. They became overwhelmed with emotions as they realized they were no longer stuck in the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 迷雾在四周和头顶散去，北地人和阿伦黛尔的士兵沐浴在骤然明亮的阳光里。意识到自己再也不是被困在魔法森林里，他们的心中涌起了难以抑制的激动。

paras.en: Ryder looked up with wonder and amazement at a crystal-blue sky for the first time in his life. “Wow.” He turned to Honeymaren. “Look at the sky.” They gazed together in awe at the wonderful blueness.
paras.zh: 莱德平生第一次仰望水晶般湛蓝的天空，满眼惊奇。“哇。”他转向霍妮马伦。“快看那天空。”两人一同敬畏地凝望着那片美妙至极的蓝。

paras.en: Honeymaren nudged him. “I just didn’t realize there was so much of it.”
paras.zh: 霍妮马伦用胳膊肘碰了碰他。“我只是没想到，天竟然有这么大。”

paras.en: Mattias and Yelana stood together at the edge of the Northuldra camp. “Thirty-four years…,” Mattias said.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯和叶拉娜并肩站在北地人营地的边缘。“三十四年……”马蒂亚斯说。

paras.en: “Five months…,” Yelana continued.
paras.zh: “零五个月……”叶拉娜接着说。

paras.en: “And twenty-three days…,” he finished. They looked at each other with true understanding and compassion for the first time in their long history together. They no longer viewed each other as enemies. And they both thought that perhaps, in time, they could even be friends.
paras.zh: “零二十三天……”他补完了最后一句。在他们漫长的历史上，两人第一次真正怀着理解与体恤，彼此相望。他们不再把对方当作敌人。两人都觉得，假以时日，他们或许还能成为朋友。

paras.en: Anna said to Kristoff, “I’m sorry I left you behind. I was just so desperate to protect her.”
paras.zh: 安娜对克里斯托夫说：“对不起，我把你抛下了。我只是太想保护她了。”

paras.en: “I know,” Kristoff answered, holding her close. “My love is not fragile.”
paras.zh: “我知道。”克里斯托夫紧抱着她，答道。“我的爱可没那么脆弱。”

paras.en: Even the reindeer noticed that the mist had disappeared. As Anna, Kristoff, Honeymaren, and Ryder watched, the herd of Northuldra reindeer ran out of the forest, weaving through the towering monoliths, still etched with the symbols of the elements, and into a clearing. Together they ran, getting behind one another and looping back on themselves until they’d formed a giant circle. The reindeer grunted and bleated with joy, tossing their heads and nudging each other. The Northuldra children ran after them, laughing and yelling with happiness. Even Sven joined in, not wanting to be left out.
paras.zh: 连驯鹿也注意到了迷雾的消散。安娜、克里斯托夫、霍妮马伦和莱德注视着，北地人的驯鹿群跑出森林，穿过那些高耸的、依然镌刻着元素符号的石柱，奔进一片林间空地。它们结伴奔跑，你追我赶，绕出一道道回旋，最后围成了一个巨大的圆圈。驯鹿们欢快地哼叫嘶鸣，甩着脑袋，彼此拱蹭。北地人的孩子们追逐在后面，笑着、喊着，满心欢喜。连斯文也凑了进去，可不愿被落下。

paras.en: Anna stepped over to a tree that had been half scorched by the Fire Spirit and stood by herself. She needed a few minutes alone as she tried to process everything that had happened in the last day. Everyone around her was overcome with joy, and all she could do was stare at them. How would she ever feel happiness again when deep down she knew Elsa was gone forever?
paras.zh: 安娜走到一棵被火灵烧焦了一半的树旁，独自站着。她需要几分钟独处的时光，好消化过去这一天里发生的一切。她身边的每个人都沉浸在喜悦之中，而她只能怔怔地望着他们。心底明知艾莎已经永远地走了，她又怎么会再感到快乐呢？

paras.en: Gale embraced her, forming diamonds of ice. Anna looked at the diamonds silently. What are you trying to tell me? she thought. The Wind Spirit was insistent, so Anna turned and followed Gale to the edge of the fjord, which was no longer brimming with the rushing waters from the broken dam.
paras.zh: 风灵盖尔轻拥住她，凝出一颗颗菱形的冰晶。安娜默默地看着那些冰晶。你想告诉我什么？她心想。风灵执意不肯罢休，安娜便转过身，跟着盖尔来到峡湾边——那里已不再满是破坝奔涌而下的洪水。

paras.en: Anna saw nothing there—not on the ground, not on the water, not hanging in the air. She heaved a great sigh. Gale swept up some leaves and dangled them in Anna’s line of sight, forcing her to look down the fjord toward where Arendelle had been. Something sparkled on top of the water. Anna leaned forward and squinted into the distance. What is that? she thought.
paras.zh: 安娜什么也没看见——地上没有，水里没有，空中也没有。她重重地叹了口气。盖尔卷起几片叶子，悬在安娜的视线里晃来晃去，逼着她顺着峡湾望向阿伦黛尔曾经所在的方向。水面上，有个东西在闪闪发光。安娜探身向前，眯起眼睛望向远方。那是什么？她心想。

paras.en: At first she thought it was a trick of the water. But the glistening continued to grow, as if it were moving closer to her. Anna blinked quickly, her brain denying what her eyes seemed to see. It couldn’t possibly…but it was. The Water Nokk glided over the water, majestic and elegant. And riding on top of it was Elsa!
paras.zh: 起初，她以为那不过是水面的光影。可那片光亮越来越大，仿佛正朝她移近。安娜飞快地眨着眼，脑子里不肯相信眼睛似乎看见的一切。那不可能是……可那就是。水灵诺克优雅而威严地滑过水面。而骑在它背上的，正是艾莎！

paras.en: Anna’s eyes widened, and she scrambled down the rock ledge as fast as she could. The Water Spirit washed Elsa onto the shore and she stood there—tall, glistening, ethereal. Anna stopped before she reached her sister. It looked like her, but she was different.
paras.zh: 安娜瞪大了眼睛，拼尽全力朝石坡下奔去。水之灵把艾莎送上岸，她站在那里——身姿高挑，晶莹剔透，宛若仙子。安娜在离姐姐几步之遥的地方停住了。模样还是她，却又不复从前。

paras.en: “Is it really you?” Anna asked, not sure what to believe, thinking maybe her eyes, or her brain, were playing tricks on her.
paras.zh: “真的是你吗？”安娜问，不知道该相信什么，心想也许是自己的眼睛，或者脑子，在捉弄她。

paras.en: Elsa smiled widely as she nodded and held her arms out. “Anna.”
paras.zh: 艾莎粲然一笑，点了点头，张开双臂。“安娜。”

paras.en: Anna rushed to her and hugged her tightly. “I thought I’d lost you!” Tears ran down her face.
paras.zh: 安娜扑过去，紧紧抱住她。“我以为我失去你了！”泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。

paras.en: “Lost me?” Elsa asked, pushing her sister’s hair away from her face. “You saved me…again.” Anna looked up at her, not knowing exactly what Elsa had meant.
paras.zh: “失去我？”艾莎问，拨开妹妹脸上的头发。“是你救了我……又一次。”安娜抬头望着她，不太明白艾莎这话的意思。

paras.en: “I did?” she asked.
paras.zh: “我救了你？”她问。

paras.en: But Elsa had more to say. “And, Anna—Arendelle did not fall.”
paras.zh: 可艾莎还有话说。“还有，安娜——阿伦黛尔没有陷落。”

paras.en: Anna was speechless. It took her a few moments before she could ask, “It didn’t?” She still wasn’t sure that what Elsa was saying was possible. She had seen the water herself, rushing to destroy the village and the castle.
paras.zh: 安娜说不出话来。好一会儿，她才问得出口：“没有陷落？”她仍不敢相信艾莎说的话是真的。她可是亲眼看见那洪水奔涌而去，要吞没村庄和城堡的。

paras.en: “The spirits all agreed Arendelle deserves to stand…with you,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: “精灵们一致认为，阿伦黛尔值得继续屹立……只要还有你。”艾莎说。

paras.en: “Me?” Overcome with joy, Anna shook her head softly in wonder.
paras.zh: “我？”喜不自胜的安娜轻轻摇着头，满心惊异。

paras.en: “You did what was right—for everyone,” Elsa explained.
paras.zh: “你做了正确的事——为了所有人。”艾莎解释道。

paras.en: In less than ten minutes, Anna had not only regained her sister, but she had discovered that her beloved Arendelle did not fall, and that somehow she was now the queen.
paras.zh: 短短十分钟不到，安娜不仅重新找回了姐姐，还得知挚爱的阿伦黛尔并未陷落，而且不知怎的，如今登上王位的，竟是她自己。

paras.en: But she couldn’t help wondering about Elsa’s quest.
paras.zh: 可她忍不住好奇艾莎的追寻。

paras.en: “Did you find the fifth spirit?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “你找到第五灵了吗？”安娜问。

paras.en: Elsa smiled in a way that let Anna know she had found that and more. And then it hit her. Anna had always known that Elsa was special, that she had always been meant for something more, something greater.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了，那笑意让安娜明白，她找到的远不止于此。紧接着，安娜豁然醒悟。她一直都知道，艾莎与众不同，注定要去做更重要、更了不起的事。

paras.en: “You are the fifth spirit,” Anna said. “You’re the bridge.”
paras.zh: “你就是第五灵。”安娜说。“你就是那座桥。”

paras.en: “Well, actually, a bridge has two sides,” Elsa said. “And Mother had two daughters.” Anna’s face brightened. “We did this together. And we’ll continue to do this together.”
paras.zh: “嗯，其实呢，桥有两端。”艾莎说。“而母亲有两个女儿。”安娜的脸上绽出光彩。“这是我们共同完成的。往后，我们也会一起继续下去。”

paras.en: The sisters looked into each other’s eyes, and a shared understanding passed between them. Anna was humbled by what Elsa was asking of her, but thrilled to have the opportunity.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩四目相对，一份共通的默契在她们之间流淌。艾莎所托付于她的，令安娜深感谦卑，却也让她为有这个机会而心潮澎湃。

paras.en: “Together,” Anna agreed.
paras.zh: “一起。”安娜应道。

paras.en: “Elsa, you’re okay!” the sisters heard Kristoff shout in astonishment. They turned as Kristoff and Sven headed down the slope, excited to see Elsa. She opened her arms, and Kristoff hugged her tightly. He pulled away, feeling slightly out of place. Then he quickly looked her over, confused. “You look different. Did you cut your hair or something?” he asked.
paras.zh: “艾莎，你没事！”姐妹俩听见克里斯托夫惊叫起来。她们转过身，看见克里斯托夫和斯文正顺着坡道奔下来，兴奋地要见艾莎。她张开双臂，克里斯托夫紧紧地抱住了她。他松开身，微微觉得有些不好意思。接着他快速上下打量她，满脸困惑。“你看起来不太一样了。是剪了头发，还是怎么了？”他问。

paras.en: Elsa petted a happy Sven. “Or something,” she said. She smiled as Gale swept in around her. “Anna, I need to ask you a question.”
paras.zh: 艾莎抚摸着欢腾的斯文。“或者别的什么吧。”她说。盖尔绕着她掠过，她笑了。“安娜，我想问你一个问题。”

paras.en: “Okay,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “好啊。”安娜说。

paras.en: “Do you want to build a snowman?” Elsa closed her eyes and focused as Gale swept into the forest, heading northward.
paras.zh: “你想堆个雪人吗？”艾莎闭上眼睛，凝神专注，任盖尔掠进森林，向北而去。

paras.en: Anna was intrigued by whatever Elsa was up to and wondered exactly what powers she now had. “What are you doing?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜对艾莎在做什么充满好奇，也想知道她如今究竟有了怎样的法力。“你在干什么呀？”她问。

paras.en: Elsa smiled sheepishly. She kept her eyes closed and concentrated.
paras.zh: 艾莎不好意思地笑了。她依旧闭着眼睛，专注不已。

paras.en: In the forest, water droplets fell from branches both high and low. Before they reached the ground, they turned into snowflakes. More droplets rose from the rivers and the petals of flowers. The Wind Spirit swept across them all, gathering them up in its breeze, making them spin and flutter as they raced across the land, headed south.
paras.zh: 森林里，水珠从高高低低的枝条上滴落。还没等落到地面，它们就化作了雪花。更多的水珠从河面和花瓣上升起。风灵掠过这一切，用微风将它们尽数聚拢，让它们旋转飞舞，掠过大地，一路向南。

paras.en: Elsa smiled when she sensed she had accomplished something special. The Wind Spirit swept in with the snowflakes.
paras.zh: 艾莎感到自己完成了一件非同寻常的事，露出了微笑。风灵卷着雪花掠了回来。

paras.en: “Thank goodness water has memory,” said Elsa.
paras.zh: “谢天谢地，水是有记忆的。”艾莎说。

paras.en: Gale released the snowflakes, and they fell from the sky haphazardly. When they began to settle into familiar round shapes, Anna knew exactly what was happening. She rummaged through her satchel and pulled out a beat-up carrot, some well-used sticks, and three very special pieces of coal—all of which she had saved. With a few quick movements, Anna had put them in their rightful places on the snow.
paras.zh: 盖尔撒开雪花，它们纷纷扬扬地从天上飘落。当它们渐渐落定，聚成熟悉的圆滚滚的形状，安娜立刻明白发生了什么。她翻遍行囊，掏出一根磕碰得坑坑洼洼的胡萝卜、几根用旧的小树枝，还有三块极为特别的煤块——这些都是她一直好好留着的。几下麻利的动作，安娜就把它们安在了雪堆上该在的位置。

paras.en: Olaf was back.
paras.zh: 雪宝回来了。

paras.en: The snowman’s eyes fluttered open, and he looked at everyone in surprise. “Anna? Elsa? Kristoff and SVEN! You all came back!”
paras.zh: 雪人眨开眼睛，惊讶地望着大家。“安娜？艾莎？克里斯托夫和斯文！你们都回来了！”

paras.en: Elsa and Anna hugged him, relieved that their friend was okay. Sven nuzzled him and playfully bit at his carrot. Olaf giggled.
paras.zh: 艾莎和安娜抱住他，庆幸朋友安然无恙。斯文用鼻子蹭蹭他，还顽皮地咬他的胡萝卜。雪宝咯咯直笑。

paras.en: “Oh, I love happy endings,” he said with a smile. “I mean, I presume we’re done. Or is this putting-us-in-mortal-danger situation gonna be a regular thing?”
paras.zh: “噢，我爱大团圆的结局。”他微笑着说。“我是说，我想我们这就完事了吧。还是说，这种把咱们置于生死险境的戏码，往后要成家常便饭了？”

paras.en: Elsa chuckled. “No, we’re done.”
paras.zh: 艾莎轻声笑了。“不，我们完事了。”

paras.en: “Actually, there is one more thing,” Kristoff insisted as he turned to Anna and knelt in front of her, pulling the ring from his pocket. “Anna, you are the most extraordinary person I’ve ever known. I love you with all that I am. Will you marry me?”
paras.zh: “其实呢，还有一件事。”克里斯托夫坚持道。他转向安娜，在她面前单膝跪下，从口袋里掏出那枚戒指。“安娜，你是我认识的人里最不平凡的一个。我以全部的自己爱着你。你愿意嫁给我吗？”

paras.en: “Yes!” Anna cried, and her face collapsed in a teary mess.
paras.zh: “愿意！”安娜喊道，脸上顿时化作一片泪雨。

paras.en: Kristoff was overwhelmed with love and admiration for her. He slipped the ring on her finger and swept her into his arms.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫心中涌满了对她的爱与倾慕。他把戒指戴在她的手指上，把她揽进怀中。

paras.en: Olaf was touched by their love for each other. “I don’t know about you guys, but while I still don’t know what transformation means, I feel like this forest has really changed us all.”
paras.zh: 雪宝被他们彼此的爱意深深打动。“我不知道你们怎么看，不过，虽然我还是不懂'蜕变'是什么意思，但我总觉得，这片森林真的改变了我们每一个人。”

paras.en: A grand celebration took place in Arendelle. Men, women, and children wore warm coats and hats as the last of the autumn leaves fell from the trees. Olaf moved through the crowd, dragging a wagon piled high with books.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔举行了一场盛大的庆典。秋叶纷纷落尽，男女老少都穿上了暖和的外套，戴上了帽子。雪宝穿行在人群中，拖着一辆堆满书的小车。

paras.en: “Excuse me,” he said to each person he passed. “Coming through.”
paras.zh: “借过一下。”他对每一个擦肩而过的人说。“麻烦让让。”

paras.en: The librarian, Oddvar, greeted Olaf at an open window when he arrived at the village library. “Morning, Olaf. What can I do for you?”
paras.zh: 他到了村庄图书馆，图书管理员奥德瓦尔在敞开的窗口向他打招呼。“早啊，雪宝。有什么能为你效劳的？”

paras.en: “I’d like to return these philosophy books, please,” he said. “Seeing as I am at peace with the idea of change, and just so happened to have found the meaning of life, I won’t be needing them for a while.”
paras.zh: “我想还掉这些哲学书。”他说。“鉴于我已经和'变化'这个念头握手言和，又恰好领悟了生命的意义，这些书暂时就用不上了。”

paras.en: “You found the meaning of life,” the librarian said, intrigued. “Well, do tell!”
paras.zh: “你找到了生命的意义。”图书管理员来了兴致。“快说说看！”

paras.en: “Oh, sorry,” Olaf said, “but each person really needs to find that for him—or herself. Now, do you have any new mystery or romance novels?”
paras.zh: “噢，抱歉，”雪宝说，“可这件事，每个人真的得自己去寻找才行——不论他是谁。对了，有新的悬疑小说或爱情小说吗？”

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Kai, the royal handler, stood outside the royal tent. Trumpets announced that someone important was approaching. “Presenting Her Majesty…Queen Anna of Arendelle.”
paras.zh: 王室侍从官凯站在王帐外。号角声宣告着某位重要人物即将驾临。“有请……阿伦黛尔女王安娜陛下。”

paras.en: But when the curtains parted, no one was there.
paras.zh: 可帷幔拉开，后面却空无一人。

paras.en: “When should I go?” said Anna. “Now? Right now? Okay.” She peeked around the tent flap at the crowd and then stepped out, nervous and excited.
paras.zh: “我该什么时候出去？”安娜说。“现在？就是现在？好。”她从帐帘边探出头，看了一眼人群，然后迈步走出帐外，又紧张又兴奋。

paras.en: Her face lit up with gratitude and love when the crowd cheered for her. She greeted each person by name as she passed them. “Mr. Hylton,” she said to an older gentleman. “Your teeth.” She handed him a napkin with his special present in it. He rewarded her with a toothless smile.
paras.zh: 人群为她欢呼，她的脸上绽满感激与爱意。她经过众人面前，一一叫出每个人的名字。“希尔顿先生。”她对一位上了年纪的绅士说。“您的牙齿。”她递给他一方餐巾，里面包着他那份特别的小礼物。他回以一个没有牙齿的微笑。

paras.en: She continued on and spotted Sven, who was wearing a tie. “Sven, don’t you look nice,” she said, rubbing his head between his antlers. He grunted in thanks.
paras.zh: 她继续前行，一眼看见戴着领带的斯文。“斯文，你今天可真俊。”她说着，揉了揉它两只鹿角之间的脑袋。它哼了一声，表示感谢。

paras.en: Someone nearby cleared their throat, and Anna looked up. “Oh my goodness, Olaf!” she exclaimed. It was the first time she had ever seen the snowman in fancy clothes…or really in any clothes.
paras.zh: 旁边有人清了清嗓子，安娜抬起头。“噢，我的天哪，雪宝！”她惊呼道。这是她头一回看见这个雪人穿上考究的衣裳……或者说，头一回见他穿上任何衣裳。

paras.en: “Charmed, I’m sure,” he answered.
paras.zh: “幸会，幸会。”他答道。

paras.en: Anna laughed with delight. “Charming!”
paras.zh: 安娜开怀大笑。“真迷人！”

paras.en: A familiar voice greeted her. “Your Majesty.” Kristoff stood between Olaf and Sven, dressed like royalty. His hair was slicked back in a polished way, making him look far different than the man who had been raised by trolls.
paras.zh: 一个熟悉的声音向她问候。“陛下。”克里斯托夫站在雪宝和斯文之间，一身王室装束。他的头发油光水滑地向后梳着，和那个由地精养大的山里汉子判若两人。

paras.en: Anna hardly recognized him at first. “Kristoff? Aw, did you boys get all dressed up for me?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜起初几乎没认出他来。“克里斯托夫？哎呀，你们哥儿几个是特意为我盛装打扮的吗？”她问。

paras.en: “It was Sven’s idea,” Olaf said, while Kristoff fidgeted with the discomfort of his formal wear. “One hour. You get this for one hour.”
paras.zh: “是斯文出的主意。”雪宝说，而克里斯托夫正因这身正装浑身不自在，扭来扭去。“就一个小时。你也就受用这一个小时。”

paras.en: She ruffled his hair and kissed his cheek. “That’s okay—I prefer you in leather anyway.” He smiled.
paras.zh: 她揉乱他的头发，亲了亲他的脸颊。“没关系——反正我还是更喜欢你穿皮衣的样子。”他笑了。

paras.en: As she continued on to greet the people, Olaf stepped up beside Kristoff to watch the events, now completely naked. “I’m shocked you can last an hour,” he admitted. “The things we do for love.”
paras.zh: 她继续上前问候众人，雪宝——此刻已一丝不挂——踱到克里斯托夫身旁，一起看着热闹。“你能撑上一个小时，我真是佩服。”他坦承。“这就是我们为爱做的牺牲啊。”

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: Anna approached the steps where Mattias stood with Halima. He was looking at a square card that he held with astonishment.
paras.zh: 安娜走到台阶前，马蒂亚斯正和哈利玛站在那里。他正一脸惊奇地端详着手中的方形卡片。

paras.en: “What is this crazy magic called again?” he asked.
paras.zh: “这疯狂的魔法叫什么来着？”他问。

paras.en: “A photograph,” Halima said, smiling.
paras.zh: “照片。”哈利玛微笑着说。

paras.en: “Photograph. Huh. We look good,” Mattias added.
paras.zh: “照片。嗯。咱们照得挺好看。”马蒂亚斯补了一句。

paras.en: “Halima…General Mattias,” Anna greeted them. She had been honored to promote Mattias to his new position on her first day as queen.
paras.zh: “哈利玛……马蒂亚斯将军。”安娜向他们问候。登基的第一天，她就荣幸地擢升马蒂亚斯就任新职。

paras.en: Mattias snapped to attention, his new uniform brilliant and covered in medals of valor. “Your Majesty,” he said.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯立刻立正，崭新的制服熠熠生辉，胸前挂满了英勇勋章。“陛下。”他说。

paras.en: “Shall we?” she asked him.
paras.zh: “我们开始吧？”她问他。

paras.en: He looked down at the biscuits he also held, then handed them to Halima. “I’ll be right back,” he said. “You can look at our photograph while I’m gone.” He chuckled. “I’m just kidding.” He kept laughing, like a teenager with a crush.
paras.zh: 他低头看看手里还拿着的饼干，把它们递给哈利玛。“我马上回来。”他说。“我不在的时候，你可以看看我们的照片。”他轻声笑了。“我开玩笑的。”他笑个不停，像个怀着暗恋的少年。

paras.en: Mattias extended an arm, which Anna slipped her hand around. He escorted her up the steps to a platform. “How am I doing?” he asked.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯伸出手臂，安娜挽了上去。他护送她走上台阶，来到一座平台。“我表现得怎么样？”他问。

paras.en: “Fantastic,” she said.
paras.zh: “好极了。”她说。

paras.en: A curtain covered something large in the center of the platform. Mattias and Anna stood on either side of the curtain. When they were both in their places, Anna nodded, and they pulled the cords. The curtain fell, revealing a bronze sculpture of young Iduna in the wind saving young Agnarr.
paras.zh: 平台中央，一幅幕帘遮着一件庞然大物。马蒂亚斯和安娜分立帘幕两侧。两人各就各位后，安娜一点头，他们一齐拉动绳索。帘幕落下，露出一座青铜雕像：迎风的少女伊杜娜救起了年幼的安格瑞。

paras.en: The crowd cheered, and Anna couldn’t hold back the tears that flooded her eyes.
paras.zh: 人群欢呼起来，安娜再也止不住眼中涌出的泪水。

paras.en: “Our land and people, now connected by love,” she announced to everyone.
paras.zh: “我们的土地与人民，如今因爱相连。”她向众人宣告。

paras.en: Gale swept around her, as if the Wind Spirit were showing approval of the statue as well. “Hi, Gale. You like it? Oh, and do you mind? I’ve got a message for my sister.”
paras.zh: 盖尔绕着她飞舞，仿佛风灵也在赞许这座雕像。“嗨，盖尔。你喜欢吗？噢，还有一件事，你不介意吧？我要给姐姐捎个信。”

paras.en: Gale twirled to show it didn’t mind. Anna pulled a note out of her pocket that had been cut and folded like a snowflake. Gale pulled the note into one of its currents and swept away.
paras.zh: 盖尔转了个圈，表示毫不介意。安娜从口袋里掏出一张便条，它被剪裁、折叠成雪花的模样。盖尔把便条卷进一道气流，随风而去。

paras.en: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】
paras.zh: ❄ 【原书此处有插图】

paras.en: The note swirled and dipped as it flew across the land. It soared over Arendelle Castle, circled the village, and swept into the Enchanted Forest. It slid from the sky as it neared Elsa, who stood among the trees with Bruni on her shoulder, a smile of contentment curving her lips. Elsa reached up and caught the flying note. She opened it and read the contents.
paras.zh: 便条打着旋儿、忽高忽低，飞越大地。它掠过阿伦黛尔城堡，绕着村庄盘旋一圈，又拂进了魔法森林。临近艾莎时，它从天际滑落——艾莎正站在树间，肩头栖着布鲁尼，嘴角挂着一抹满足的微笑。艾莎抬起手，接住了飞来的便条。她展开便条，读着上面的内容。

paras.en: Charades Friday night. Don’t be late. And don’t worry, Arendelle’s doing just fine. Keep looking after those spirits. I love you.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，来玩比手画脚。别迟到。还有，别担心，阿伦黛尔一切都好。继续照看好那些精灵。我爱你。

paras.en: “I love you too, Sis,” Elsa said as she looked up from the note. “Hey, Gale! We’re going for a ride. Want to come?”
paras.zh: “我也爱你，妹妹。”艾莎读完便条，抬起头说。“嘿，盖尔！我们要去兜风了。一起来吗？”

paras.en: Gale flipped around Elsa with a resounding yes, then swept past her to the Water Nokk, which rose out of a nearby stream. Bruni hopped down and headed for the rocks.
paras.zh: 盖尔绕着艾莎欢快翻飞，响亮地表示愿意，接着从她身旁掠过，奔向从附近溪流中升起的水灵诺克。布鲁尼跳下地，朝岩石那边跑去。

paras.en: “You ready?” Elsa asked her new friend. The Water Nokk stomped its hoof and shook its head yes. Elsa touched its forelock with her power and turned the Water Nokk into a mix of ice and snow. They touched foreheads fondly.
paras.zh: “你准备好了吗？”艾莎问她的新朋友。水灵诺克跺了跺蹄子，点头示意。艾莎以魔力轻触它的额发，把水灵诺克化作冰与雪的化身。他们亲昵地额头相抵。

paras.en: Elsa rode the iced Water Nokk through the trees. She had discovered that by turning it to ice, they were no longer limited to water. Now they could roam wherever their hearts desired.
paras.zh: 艾莎骑着冰封的水灵诺克穿过树林。她发现，只要把它化为冰，他们便不再受限于水面。如今，心之所向，皆可驰往。

paras.en: Elsa passed Honeymaren and Ryder as they herded their reindeer through a field. She waved to them and they waved back.
paras.zh: 艾莎经过霍妮马伦和莱德身边，他们正赶着驯鹿穿过一片田野。她朝他们挥挥手，他们也挥手回应。

paras.en: An Earth Giant woke up and raised the ground beneath Elsa. She and the Water Nokk expertly jumped over the giant and continued on their journey.
paras.zh: 一个大地巨人醒来，托起艾莎脚下的地面。她和冰封的水灵诺克娴熟地跃过巨人，继续踏上旅程。

paras.en: The Fire Spirit ran through the trees, eagerly lapping up the snowflakes Elsa created for it. She formed a snow pile for Bruni to jump into.
paras.zh: 火灵在树林间奔跑，急切地舔舐着艾莎为它造出的雪花。她堆起一座雪堆，好让布鲁尼跳进去玩耍。

paras.en: Elsa and the iced Water Nokk broke through the line of trees at the edge of the forest and rode across the frozen sea, heading toward the horizon. The Snow Queen turned her face to the sky and smiled. Elsa was exactly where she was meant to be…totally free and in her element.
paras.zh: 艾莎和冰封的水灵诺克冲出森林边缘的树线，驰过冰封的海面，朝着地平线疾驰而去。这位冰雪女王仰起脸庞，望着天空，微笑了。艾莎正身处她命中注定的所在……全然的自由，如鱼得水。
